segments.sanskrit: कर्म विष्टयां तु सिध्यति ॥ न कुर्यान्मेगरुं विष्टयां जीवितार्थौ कदाचन ॥
segments.english_translation: Actions performed during Vishti Karana are successful. However, one should never undertake important tasks related to life during Vishti.

segments.sanskrit: डंक मलयेऽने सर्गेऽजातरयेऽङिगे । सरीधलुजकनकरेऽधो भद्रा तत्रैव तत्फलम्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: When the Moon is in Aquarius or Pisces, Vishti resides in the sky. In Aries, Taurus, and Gemini, it resides on Earth. In Virgo, Sagittarius, Libra, and Capricorn, it resides below. The results are given accordingly.

segments.sanskrit: वाप्यारामतडागङकपमवनारंपरतिष् तता- रंभोत्सगेवधूप्रवेशनमहादानानि सोमाष्टके । गोदानाग्रयणग्रपाप्रथमकोपाकरमवेदव्रतं नीलोद्वाहमथातिपनरिषचसंस्कारान्सुरखापनम्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: Do not perform activities like constructing wells, gardens, ponds, houses, or starting new ventures, entering homes, or giving great donations during the eighth day of the Moon. Avoid cow donations, first offerings, and major rituals. Do not conduct weddings or other ceremonies during the blue moon.

segments.sanskrit: दीकषामोजिविवाहयडनमपू देवती्षणं संन्यासाभिपरिग्रौ सृषतिसंदशौभिषेको गमम्‌ । चातुमाखसमादती भ्रवणयो्वधं परीक्षां यजेः उधत्वासशिद्त्व इज्यसितयोन्यूनाधिमासे तथा ॥
segments.english_translation: Initiations, marriages, and other ceremonies should not be performed during the blue moon, nor should one undertake pilgrimages or other auspicious activities. Avoid these during the additional month or when Jupiter is retrograde.

segments.sanskrit: अस्ते बज्यं सिंहनक्रखजीवे वर्ज्यं केचिदवकगे चातिचारे । गुवादि्ये विश्वषसरेऽपि पक्षे प्रोचुसतदरदतरतादिभूषाम्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: When Jupiter is in Leo or Capricorn, or retrograde, avoid auspicious activities. Some say even when Jupiter is in Virgo or Pisces, one should avoid such activities.

segments.sanskrit: यदयप्यनुपचयस्थो जीवः कन्यातिकारमावहति । गुणवद्वरोपर्ब्धौ तथापि पाणिग्रहः कायैः ॥
segments.english_translation: Even if Jupiter is in a non-beneficial position, it can cause obstacles in marriage. However, if the groom is of good quality, the marriage ceremony should still be performed.

segments.sanskrit: एुकरािगतौ सूयैजीवो स्यातां यदा सुनः । बतबंधविवाहादि छभकमौखिं लजेत्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: When the Sun and Jupiter are in the same sign, avoid auspicious activities like marriage and friendship ceremonies.

segments.sanskrit: गुरुशचेत्रगतो भाजुभौुकचेत्रगतो युरः । गु्वदित्यः स विज्ञेयो गर्दितः सर्वैकर्मेसु ॥
segments.english_translation: When Jupiter is in the sign of Sagittarius or Pisces, it is known as Guru-Aditya and should be avoided for all auspicious activities.

segments.sanskrit: सिंह शुरो सिंहर विवादो ने्टोऽथ गोदोत्तरतश यावत्‌ । मामीरथीयाम्यतटं हि दोषो नान्यत्र देशे तपनेऽपि मेषे ॥
segments.english_translation: When Jupiter is in Leo, avoid marriage ceremonies unless it is in the third or fifth Navamsa. There is no defect if the Sun is in Aries.

segments.sanskrit: मघादिष॑चपादेषु गुरः सर्वत्र निंदितः । गंगागोदांतरं हित्वा रेषांधिषु न दोषटत्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: Jupiter is considered inauspicious in the first quarter of Magha Nakshatra. However, there is no defect if it is beyond the Ganga and Godavari regions.

segments.sanskrit: राप गंडकीपविमे च शोणखोद््षिणे नीच इज्यः । वर्ज्यो नायं ककणे मागथे च गोडे सिधौ वर्जनीयः शेषु ॥
segments.english_translation: In the regions east of the Reva river, west of the Gandaki river, and north and south of the Shona river, Jupiter in Capricorn is not considered inauspicious. However, it should be avoided in other regions.

segments.sanskrit: गोऽजांयङ्कमेतरमेऽतिचारगो नो पूर्वरारिं गुरूरेति वक्रितः। तदा बिलुकषाव्द इहातिनिदितः शुभेषु रेवासुरनिश्नगां वरे ॥
segments.english_translation: When Jupiter transits from Taurus, Aries, Pisces, or Aquarius to another sign and returns to the previous sign without completing the transit, it is called 'Bilukta Samvatsara'. This is considered inauspicious for auspicious activities, especially between the rivers Reva and Suranisha.

segments.sanskrit: पादोनरेखापरपूर्वयोजनेः परैुतोनास्तिथयो दिनार्भतः। उनाधिकास्तद्विवरोद्धपैः पठैरूध्वं तथाधो दिनपम्रवेशनम्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: The calculation of the day begins from the meridian line. If the location is east of the meridian, subtract the difference in degrees; if west, add it. This determines the sunrise and the entry of the day.

segments.sanskrit: वबारादेषटिका द्विगुणाः खाकृहच्छेषर्जिताः। सैकासतष्टा नगैः कालरोरेशा दिनपात्करमात्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: From the calculated time of the weekday, double the desired time, divide by five, and subtract the remainder. Add one to the result, divide by seven, and the remainder gives the planetary hour starting from the weekday lord.

segments.sanskrit: वारे प्रोक्तं काशहोरासु तख धिष्ण्ये प्रोक्तं खामितिथ्यं्षकेऽख। यादिक्शलादि विलं शषणेषु नैवोषट॑ध्यः पारिश्वापि दंडः ॥
segments.english_translation: The work prescribed for a particular weekday should be done in the planetary hour of that day. If the Nakshatra is missing, perform the work in the Tithi or Yoga associated with it. Inauspicious times like Parigha and Danda should be avoided.

segments.sanskrit: मन्वाचास्सितिथी मधो तिथिरवी उर्जे छचो दिवितिथी जय्ठेऽन्लये च तिथिसित्पे नवर तपखश्वाः सहसे दिवा। भद्रेऽभिश्च सिते त्वमाष्ट नभसः दृष्णे युगाचयाः सिते मोऽ्री बाहुलराधयोमदनदर्ो भाद्रमाधासिते ॥
segments.english_translation: The Manvantaras and Yugadi days are specified as follows: In Chaitra, the third Tithi; in Kartika, the full moon; in Ashadha, the tenth day; in Jyestha, the ninth day; in Phalguna, the ninth day; in Magha, the sixth day; in Pausha, the eleventh day; in Bhadrapada, the third day; in Shravana, the eighth day. These are considered inauspicious for certain activities.

segments.sanskrit: नासलयान्तकवदहिधावृशशभृद्धद्रादितीञ्योरगा कऋ्षेशाः पितरो भगोऽर्यमरविवष्रा्चगाश्च क्रमात्‌ । शक्राप्री खल मित्रशक्रनिक्रतिक्षीराणि विश्वे विधि- गीरविदो वसुतोयपाजचरणाहिवुश्यपूषाभिधाः ॥
segments.english_translation: The deities of the Nakshatras are as follows: Ashwini - Ashwini Kumaras, Bharani - Yama, Krittika - Agni, Rohini - Brahma, Mrigashira - Chandra, Ardra - Rudra, Punarvasu - Aditi, Pushya - Brihaspati, Ashlesha - Sarpa, Magha - Pitris, Purva Phalguni - Bhaga, Uttara Phalguni - Aryaman, Hasta - Surya, Chitra - Tvashta, Swati - Vayu, Vishakha - Indra and Agni, Anuradha - Mitra, Jyeshtha - Indra, Mula - Nirriti, Purva Ashadha - Apas, Uttara Ashadha - Vishwadevas, Abhijit - Brahma, Shravana - Vishnu, Dhanishta - Vasus, Shatabhisha - Varuna, Purva Bhadrapada - Aja Ekapada, Uttara Bhadrapada - Ahirbudhnya, Revati - Pushan.

segments.sanskrit: उत्तरात्रयरोरिण्यो मास्करश्च धुव सरम्‌ । तत्र सथिरं बीजगेदचां यारामादि सिद्धये ।
segments.english_translation: The Nakshatras Uttara Phalguni, Uttara Ashadha, Uttara Bhadrapada, and Rohini are considered auspicious and stable. They are suitable for planting seeds, building houses, and establishing gardens.

segments.sanskrit: खात्यादिये शरुतेखीणि चद्रधापि चरं चलम्‌ । तसिन्गजादिकारोहौ वारिकागमनादिकम्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: The Nakshatras Krittika, Hasta, and Swati are considered movable. They are suitable for activities like riding elephants and horses, and for journeys.

segments.sanskrit: पूर्वात्रयं याम्यमये उग्रं क्रूरं ुजसतथा । तस्मिन्धाताभिशचाव्यानि विषश्रादि सिध्यति ॥
segments.english_translation: The Nakshatras Purva Phalguni, Purva Ashadha, and Purva Bhadrapada, along with Bharani and Magha, are considered fierce and cruel. They are suitable for activities like poison administration, black magic, and other destructive acts.

segments.sanskrit: विशाखाग्ेयमे सोम्यो मिश्रं साधारणं स्पृतम्‌ । तत्राप्निकायं मिश्रं च व्रपोत्सगोदि सिद्धये ॥
segments.english_translation: The Nakshatras Vishakha, Anuradha, and Krittika are considered mixed and ordinary. They are suitable for activities like fire rituals, mixed ceremonies, and festive celebrations.

segments.sanskrit: दस्ताधिपुष्याभिजितः क्षिप्रं लघु गुरुस्तथा । तसिन्पण्यरतिज्ञानभूषाशिल्पकलादिकम्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: The Nakshatras Ashwini, Pushya, and Abhijit are considered swift and light. They are suitable for trade, enjoyment, learning, adornment, and artistic activities.

segments.sanskrit: मृगांयचितरामिवर् सदु भेत भृगुस्तथा 1 तत्र गीतांबरकरीडाभित्रकायैविभूषणम्‌ ।
segments.english_translation: The Nakshatras Mrigashira, Chitra, and Revati are considered gentle. They are suitable for music, clothing, play, and adornment activities.

segments.sanskrit: भृतिद्राद्रीदिभं सोरिसतीशणं दारुणसं्ञकम्‌ । तत्राभिचारषातोग्रभेदाः पडदमादिकम्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: The Nakshatras Mula, Ardra, and Jyeshtha are considered sharp and fierce. They are suitable for black magic, fierce activities, and breaking enemies.

segments.sanskrit: मूलेति ॥ मूं, अहिः =ाशेषा, मिश्च -कृत्तिकानिराखे, उग्र॑ =पूर्वात्रयमघाभरण्यः, एतानि नव नक्षत्राण्यधोसुखानि जेयानि ।
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras Mula, Ashlesha, Magha, and Bharani, these nine Nakshatras are considered inauspicious for certain activities.

segments.sanskrit: पौप्णध्ुवाधिकरषचकवासवेज्या-दिले भ्रवाररदशंखसुवर्णवसम्‌ । भायं विरिक्तरानिचन्द्रङजेऽदि रक्त भोमे ्रुवादितियुगे सभगा न दध्यात्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras Revati, Rohini, Uttara Ashadha, Ashwini, Hasta, Chitra, Swati, Vishakha, and Anuradha, wearing red or gold is not recommended during Rikta Tithis, when the Moon is in conjunction with Mars, or during unfavorable Yogas.

segments.sanskrit: वच्ाणां नवभागकेषु च चतुष्कोणेऽमरा राक्षसा मध्यत्रयंश्चगता नरास्तु सदशे पारे च मध्यांशयोः । दग्धे वा स्फुटितेऽरे नवतरे प॑कादिर्पि न सद्र-षोऽ सूसुरांशयोः छममसत्सर्वाशकेः प्राततः ॥
segments.english_translation: In the division of nine parts, the gods reside in the four corners, demons in the middle three parts, and humans in the remaining parts. If the cloth is burnt or torn, it is not auspicious in the new cloth, especially in the parts associated with demons.

segments.sanskrit: वि्राज्ञया तथोढाहे राजञा ्रीयापितं च यत्‌। नि्येऽपि धिष्ण्ये वारादौ वस्रं धार्य जगुबुधाः ॥
segments.english_translation: Even on inauspicious days, if a cloth is given by a king or a respected person, it can be worn during the Nakshatra Dhishnya or at the beginning of the day.

segments.sanskrit: राधामूलखरदधुवक्षवरुणक्िरटैतापादपा-रोपोऽ्थो चपदर्शनं शरवसदुधिम्र्रवोवासचैः । ती्णोगरा्बुपभेषु मचयुदितं शिप्रांयवहीन्द्रमा-दिख्रा्बुपवासेषु हि गवां शस्तः क्रयो विक्रयः ॥
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras Ashwini, Bharani, Krittika, Rohini, Mrigashira, Ardra, Punarvasu, Pushya, Ashlesha, Magha, Purva Phalguni, Uttara Phalguni, Hasta, Chitra, Swati, Vishakha, Anuradha, Jyeshtha, Mula, Purva Ashadha, Uttara Ashadha, Shravana, Dhanishta, Shatabhisha, Purva Bhadrapada, Uttara Bhadrapada, and Revati, planting trees and buying or selling cows is auspicious.

segments.sanskrit: लगने शमे चाष्टमश्द्धिसंयुते रक्षा पशूनां निजयोनिभे चरे । रिक्ता्टमीददीङजश्रवोधुवत्वष्षु यान सितिवेशनं न सत्‌
segments.english_translation: In the Lagna, during the eighth house and when the Moon is in conjunction with malefics, protection of animals is auspicious in their own Nakshatras. Travel and entering a new house are not recommended during Rikta Tithis, Ashtami, Amavasya, and when the Moon is in Shravan, Dhanishta, or Rohini.

segments.sanskrit: भैषज्यं सछघुदुचरे मूभे अगर छकरद्विज्ये विदि च दिवसे चापि तेषां रे । शद्धे रिफद्यनश्रतिगहे सत्तिथौ नो जनेभ सचीकमाप्यदितिवसुभत्वा्रमित्राधिधिष्ण्ये ॥
segments.english_translation: Medicinal activities are auspicious in the Nakshatras Ashwini, Pushya, Hasta, Chitra, Swati, Anuradha, Revati, Shravana, and Shatabhisha. However, they are not recommended during Rikta Tithis, when the Moon is in conjunction with malefics, or during unfavorable Yogas.

segments.sanskrit: अदितिर्वासवे व्वा्रमतरभेदववाभिनः। सूकर तजुत्राणमेभिः श्रशस्यते॥
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras of Aditi, Vasava, and others, the act of sewing and making garments is considered auspicious.

segments.sanskrit: ऋयक्षै विक्रयो नेष्टो विक्रयं क्योऽपि न। पौष्णांबुपाश्चिनीवातश्चवधित्राः कये शुभाः॥
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras of Pushya, Anuradha, Swati, and others, buying and selling are not recommended. However, these Nakshatras are auspicious for other activities.

segments.sanskrit: पूथीदरीशङृशालुसार्षयममे कद्रहविकोणे शुभैः पद्म्यायेष्वशचमैविना षटतसं सन्विक्रयः सत्तिथो।
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras of Purva Phalguni, Vishakha, and others, buying and selling are auspicious on auspicious Tithis, avoiding Rikta Tithis.

segments.sanskrit: पि्रात्यवस्िदुमरु्ेशादिलप्रिकतारदिने प्रशस्तम्‌।
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras of Ashwini, Revati, and others, the purchase of horses and similar activities are considered auspicious.

segments.sanskrit: स्थाद्धूषाघटनं व्रि पुष्करचरधिग्रधुवे रलयुक्‌- तततक्ष्णोगरविहीनभे रविजे मेषालििंहे तनौ।
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras of Pushya, Ashwini, and others, the making of ornaments is auspicious, especially when the Moon is in Aries or Leo.

segments.sanskrit: सुद्राणां पातनं सद्धुवदुचरभधिप्रभेवीन घस पूणीजयाख्ये न च गुरुभरगुजास विरमे भः खात्‌।
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras of Dhanishta, Ashwini, and others, the cutting of precious stones is auspicious, avoiding Guru and Bharani.

segments.sanskrit: संधायौः ईतवर्मेष्वसनरशरङृपाणासिपु्यो विरिक्त शकरेजयाकेऽदहि मेतरधुवरघुसहितादित्यशचाक्रहविदेवे।
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras of Pushya, Ashwini, and others, the making of weapons is auspicious, especially when the Moon is in Aries or Leo.

segments.sanskrit: अंधाक्षं रविविश्वमेत्रजरपा छेषा चांद्र भवेत्‌ । मध्याक्षं शिवपित्रजेकचरणत्वष्द्रविध्य॑तकं खं खात्यदितिश्रवोद्हनमादिबभ्यरक्षोभगम्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras starting with Andhaksha, the Sun, Vishva, Maitra, Jarapa, and the Moon are considered. In the middle Nakshatras, Shiva, Pitra, Eka, Charana, Tvashtri, Vidhya, and Antaka are considered. The auspicious Nakshatras are Khata, Aditi, Shravana, and others.

segments.sanskrit: विनषटर्थसख लाभोंऽये शीघं म॑दे प्रयलतः । स्यादूरे ्रवणं मध्ये श्रुयाप्री न सुलोचने ॥
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras where things are lost, they are quickly regained in the Andhaksha Nakshatras. In the middle Nakshatras, the lost item is heard of from afar, but not seen.

segments.sanskrit: तीकष्णमिश्रधुवोगेयद्रव्यं दत्तं निवेशितम्‌ । भ्युक्तं च विनष्टं च विध्यां पाते च नाप्यते ॥
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras mixed with Tikshna, the given, invested, or lost wealth is not regained during Vidhya or Pata.

segments.sanskrit: मित्रार्कशचुववासवांबुपमधातो्यांवयपुष्येदुभिः पापैदीनबरैस्तनो ससुरो जे वा भृगो से विधो । आप्ये सर्वजलाश्चयख खननं व्यभोमधैः सेद्रभै- सैगत्यं दिषुके शभेस्तलुगरे जेन ज्ञराशौ छभम्‌॥
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras of Mitra, Arka, Chuva, Vasava, Ambu, and others, digging of water bodies is auspicious. In the presence of malefics, the work should be avoided.

segments.sanskrit: क्षित्र भेत्रे वित्सितार्कैञ्यवारे सौम्ये रग्रेऽके कजे वा खलामे । योनर्भल्यां रारिषोधापि भेन्यां सेवा कार्या खामिनः सेवकेन ॥
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras of Kshitra, Bhitra, and others, and on the days of Vitsita, Arka, and others, service to the master is auspicious when the birth stars are friendly.

segments.sanskrit: खालयादिलयश्रदुद्विदेवगुरुमे कर्णत्रयाश्वे चरे रपरे धर्मसुताषटशद्धिसहिते द्रव्यप्रयोगः शुभः । नारे प्राम तु संक्रमदिने बद्धौ करेऽैऽद्धि यत्‌ तदंशेषु भवेदृणं न च बुधे देयं कदाचिद्धनम्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras of Khala, Yadi, and others, giving wealth is auspicious. On Sankranti, and during Bhadra, wealth should not be given.

segments.sanskrit: मूरुदवीरमघाचरधुवमदुश्िपरैविनाकं श्नि पायेदीनवरविभौ जलगृहे शक्रे विधौ मांसके । लग्रे देवगुरो हरग्रवहणं शस्तं न सिंहे षरे ककीजेणधटे तनौ क्षयकरं रिक्तासु षष्ठयां तथा ॥
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras of Moola, Rudra, and others, plowing is auspicious. In the presence of malefics, it should be avoided.

segments.sanskrit: एतेषु श्वतिवारुणादितिकिशाखोडनि भौमं विना बीजोषिगदिता शुभा त्वगुभतोऽ्टा्रीदुरार्मेदवः । रा्मेहभियुगान्यसच्छुभकराण्युप दठेऽर्कोज्िता-द्धा द्रामाष्टनवाष्टमानि निभिः प्रोक्तान्यसत्संति च ॥
segments.english_translation: In these Nakshatras, excluding Mars, sowing seeds is auspicious. The auspiciousness is enhanced when the Moon is in these Nakshatras, and the days are ruled by the Sun, Moon, Mercury, Jupiter, or Venus.

segments.sanskrit: त्वा्रान्मित्रकमाहरयेष्वुपरघुभरत्रे धिरामोक्षणं भैमारकैज्यदिने विरेकवमनार्यं स्याहुधाकी विना । मित्रकिप्रचरधुवे रवि्यभाहे रम्ब विदो जीवस्यापि तनो गुरौ निगदिता धर्मक्रिया द्वरे ॥
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras of Swati, Mitra, and Kabhayami, on Tuesdays and Thursdays, bloodletting is recommended. In the Nakshatras of Mitra, Krittika, and Swati, on Sundays, Mondays, and Thursdays, religious activities are advised.

segments.sanskrit: तीध्णाजपादकरवहिवसुश्चतीदुसवातीमधोत्तरजलान्तकतक्षपुष्ये । म॑दाररिक्तरहिते दिवसेऽतिशस्ता धान्यच्छिदा निगदिता स्थिरभे विप्रे ॥
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras of Mula, Jyeshtha, Ashlesha, and others, on days without Rikta Tithi, cutting grains is highly auspicious when the Moon is in a fixed sign.

segments.sanskrit: भाग्यायैमश्ुतिमेद्रविधावमूलमेत्रांयभेषु कथितं कणमरदनं सत्‌ । दइीशाजपाजिक्रतिधाठशतार्यमे सखस रोपणमिहार्षिडजो विना सत्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras of Purva Phalguni, Uttara Phalguni, Rohini, and others, the grinding of grains is recommended. Planting is auspicious in these Nakshatras, excluding Saturn and Mars.

segments.sanskrit: मिधरोग्ररद्रधजगेद्रविभिन्नभेषु ककौजतोरिरदहिते च तनौ शुमाहे । धान्यसितिः शुभकरी गदिता धुवेज्य- द्वीशेद्रदस्लचरभेषु च धान्यब्रद्धिः ॥
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras of Vishakha, Krittika, and others, when the Moon is in Capricorn or Taurus, grain storage is auspicious. In the Nakshatras of Dhanishta, Vishakha, and others, grain growth is enhanced.

segments.sanskrit: क्षिप्रपर्वाण्यचसमेतमघाख्यशस्तं खाच्छांतिकं च सह पौषिकर्मगराभ्याम्। खेऽह विधौ सुखगते तलुगे गुरौ नो मोद्यादिदुष्टसमये शमदं निमित्ते॥
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras of Kshipra, Parva, and Magha, auspicious are the rites of Shanti and Paushtika. When the Moon is in a favorable position and Jupiter is in the fourth house, avoid inauspicious times for peace rituals.

segments.sanskrit: सूर्यमात्रितिमे चरे स्रयविच्छुकर्पगवः। चन्द्रारेज्यागुशिखिनो नेष्टा होमाहतिः खले॥
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras of Sun, Mars, and Mercury, and when the Moon is in Aries, Leo, or Sagittarius, avoid fire offerings. They are not auspicious when the Moon is afflicted by malefic planets.

segments.sanskrit: सेका तिथिर्वारयुता कृतापता शेषे गुणेऽभरे वि वद्धिवासः। सौख्याय होमे शशियुग्मरेषे प्राणार्थनादो दिवि भूतले च॥
segments.english_translation: When the Tithi and weekday are combined and the remainder is auspicious, it is called Vaddhivasa. On such a day, fire offerings bring happiness. If the remainder is one, it is auspicious in the sky; if two, it is auspicious on earth.

segments.sanskrit: नवां खाचरकषप्रखुमे स्तनौ शभम्। विना नंदाविषघटीमधुपौपाकरंभूमिजान्॥
segments.english_translation: Eating new grains is auspicious in the Nakshatras of Kshipra, Charaka, and Magha, except on Nanda Tithi, Vishaghati, during the months of Madhu and Pausha, and on Saturdays.

segments.sanskrit: याम्यत्रयविशसेन्द्रसार्पपिव्येशमिन्मे। भृग्बीज्यारकदिने नोकाषटन सत्तनो छभम्॥
segments.english_translation: Building a boat is auspicious in the Nakshatras of Yama, Vishakha, Indra, and Sarpa, and on Fridays and Thursdays, when the Moon is in a favorable position.

segments.sanskrit: सूलाद्राभरणीपित्यसृगे सौम्ये घटे तनौ। सुखे शक्रेऽषमे शद्धे सिद्धिवीराभिचारयोः॥
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras of Mula, Ardra, Bharani, and Punarvasu, and when the Moon is in the eighth house, the rituals for achieving success in Veera Sadhana and Abhichara are accomplished.

segments.sanskrit: व्यत्यादितिशुवमधानिलसार्षधिष्ण्ये रिक्तातिथो चरतनौ बिकवींदुवारे। खा रुजा विरहितस् जनस्य शस्तं हीने विधौ खलखगे्भवरेद्रकोणे॥
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras of Vyatipata, Shravana, and others, and on Rikta Tithis, when the Moon is in a favorable position, performing rituals for health is auspicious.

segments.sanskrit: सदुुवक्षिप्रचरे जे गुरो बा खरप्गे। विधौ ज्ञजीववगखे शिल्पविद्या प्रशस्यते॥
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras of Sadhya, Kshipra, and Charaka, and when the Moon is in a favorable position, starting the study of arts and crafts is recommended.

segments.sanskrit: मुगेज्यमित्र भाग्येषु चाष्टम्यां तेतिङे हरो। शुक्रच्टे तनौ सौम्यवारे संधानमिष्यते॥
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras of Mula, Jyeshtha, and Magha, and on Ashtami Tithi, when the Moon is in a favorable position, starting reconciliation is recommended.

segments.sanskrit: लक्त्वा्टभूतरानिविषटिकुनाज्ञलुभ- मासो मृतौ रविविधू अपि मानि नाव्याः। गे चरे तुरवे शशिजीवतारा- द्धौ करादितिहरीद्रकपे परीक्षा॥
segments.english_translation: Avoiding the Tithis of Ashtami, Chaturdashi, and others, and when the Moon is in a favorable position, conducting examinations is recommended.

segments.sanskrit: यस्मिन्पुष्यादिके नक्षत्रेऽभिषिक्तो राजा तदभिषेकक्षेमम्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatra starting with Pushya, if a king is consecrated, it ensures the success of the consecration.

segments.sanskrit: वययाष्टञ्चुद्धोपचये लग्रगे श्ुभदग्युते । च्रे तिषद्दशायखे सवौरंभः प्रसिध्यति ॥
segments.english_translation: When the Ascendant is in the 12th or 8th house, and benefic planets are in the 3rd, 6th, 10th, or 11th houses, all auspicious activities will be successful.

segments.sanskrit: खातीद्रपू्ाशिवसार्पमे मतिरज्रेऽल्यमैत्र थिरता भवेदुजः। याम्यश्रमोवारुणतक्चभ शिवा घस्ता दि पक्षो द्वयधिपाकेवासवेऽप
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras Swati, Jyeshtha, Purvashadha, Ardra, and Shravana, diseases become stable. In the Nakshatras Bharani, Hasta, Vishakha, and Dhanishta, diseases last for 15 days.

segments.sanskrit: मूलाभिदासने नव पित्यमे नखा वुश्यार्यमेज्यादितिधादभे नगाः। मासोऽन्जयैशवेऽथ यमाहिमूरमे मिभ्रशपिव्ये फणि्दंशने मृतिः ॥
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras Mula, Ashlesha, and Magha, diseases last for 9 days. In the Nakshatras Uttaraphalguni, Uttarabhadrapada, and Revati, diseases last for 20 days.

segments.sanskrit: रोद्राहिशाक्राडपयाम्यपूरवादविदैवयखभिषु पापवारे । रिक्ताहरिस्कंददिने च रोगे शीघं भवेद्रोगिजनख मृत्युः ॥
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras Rudra, Ashlesha, and Purvabhadrapada, on malefic weekdays, and during Rikta Tithis, diseases lead to quick death.

segments.sanskrit: कषिप्रादिमूरँद्रहरीशवायुमे प्रेतक्रिया खाज्ज्षषङं मगे विधो । रेतस दाहं यमदिग्गमं यजेच्छय्यादितानं गृहगोपनादि च ॥
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras Krittika, Rohini, Hasta, and Shravana, cremation and related rites should be avoided. Avoid traveling south, weaving beds, and covering houses.

segments.sanskrit: साषवव शे । पुष्करो भवति सृतयुिनाशद्धौ ैगुण्यदो द्रिुणङ़दरसुतक्चादे ॥
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras Bharaṇī, Pushya, and Uttara Phalguni, during specific Tithis and weekdays, the Pushkara Yoga occurs, which is auspicious for starting new ventures.

segments.sanskrit: त्रितयं गवां हि दद्यादोषत्रितयापनुक्तये विद्वान्। द्वितयं द्विपुष्करेऽपि च तिरूपिषटर्िप्रसुख्येभ्यः॥
segments.english_translation: A wise person should give three cows to remove threefold defects. Even in the presence of two Pushkaras, two should be given for the prosperity of the threefold form.

segments.sanskrit: शुकराराु दरदीभूतमदने नेदासु तीक्ष्ोगरम पौष्णे वारुणे ब्रिपुष्करदिने न्यूनाधिमासेऽयने। याम्येऽन्दात्परतश्च पातपरिधे देवेज्यश्कास्तके मद्रावैषतयोः शवम्रतिङृतेदहि न पक्षे सिते॥
segments.english_translation: In the presence of Shukra (Venus), on the day of Daradi, Madana, Neda, or in the sharp and fierce Varuna, during the three Pushkaras, in the deficient or additional month, in the southern solstice, after the Yama, during Vyatipata or Parigha Yoga, during Deva Yajna or Shakra's day, in the presence of Madra and Vaishata, cremation should not be performed in the bright fortnight.

segments.sanskrit: जन्मप्रत्यरितारयोर्मृतिसुखांलयेऽन्जे च कर्तुम सन्मध्यो भत्रमगादितिधुवविशाखाव्रैभिमे जञेऽपि च। षठोऽकैज्यविधोिने श्वुतिकरखात्यश्िुष्ये तथा स्वाशौचात्यरतो बिचायमसिरं मध्ये यथासं मवम्॥
segments.english_translation: In the presence of the birth star or its counterpart, during the time of death or happiness, in the middle of the bright fortnight, during Bhadra, Magha, or Vishakha, even during the sixth or eighth lunar day, during the presence of Shutikara or Swati, and in the middle of the Ashaucha period, the cremation should be performed as per the prescribed method.

segments.sanskrit: अथोक्तमूलं घटिकाचतुष्टयं ज्येष्ठां यमूलादिभवं हि नारदः वसिष्ठ एकद्विषरीमितं जगे ब्रहस्पतिस्त्वेकषटीप्रमाणकम्‌।
segments.english_translation: Narada states that the unconsumed Mula is four Ghatikas from Jyestha and Yama. Vasistha mentions it as one or two Ghatikas, while Brihaspati considers it as one-sixth of a Ghatika.

segments.sanskrit: अथोचुरन्ये प्रथमा्टषय्यो मूलसख शाक्रान्तिमपंचनाब्यः। जातं शिशुं तत्र परिखजेदवा मुखं पितास्याष्टसमा न पर्येत्‌॥
segments.english_translation: Others say that the first eight Ghatikas from Mula and the last five from Jyestha are unconsumed. A child born in this period should be abandoned, or the father should not see its face for eight years.

segments.sanskrit: स्व मूले भवेद्राज्यं पाताले च धनागमः। श्युरोके यदा मूलं तदु शल्यं समादिशेत्॥
segments.english_translation: In one's own Nakshatra, there is sovereignty; in the netherworld, wealth is obtained. When Mula is in the sky, it indicates a thorny situation.

segments.sanskrit: गण्डान्तद्रमशूलपातपरिघव्याघातगण्डावमे। संक्रान्तिव्यतिपातवैधृतिसिनीवालीद्रिकुद्ददीके॥ वर्ज्ये कृष्णचतुर्द्दश्यां यमघण्टे दग्धयोगे शस्तौ। विष्टौ सोदरे जन्म पितरं अशस्ता शान्तितः॥
segments.english_translation: In the presence of Gandanta, Drona, Shula, Pata, Parigha, Vyaghata, Gandava, Sankranti, Vyatipata, Vaidhriti, Siniwali, and Rikta Tithis, birth is inauspicious. Avoid Krishna Chaturdashi, Yamaganda, Dagdha Yoga, and Bhadra. Birth in these conditions is harmful to siblings and parents unless pacified.

segments.sanskrit: अश्विनीमघमूलादौ त्रिषङ्कनवनाडिकाः। रेवतीसापशाक्रान्ते मासाश्च ऋतुसायकाः॥
segments.english_translation: In Ashwini, Magha, and Mula, there are three Shankus and nine Nadikas. In Revati and Shatabhisha, the months and seasons are indicated.

segments.sanskrit: अश्विनीमघमूलानां पूर्वार्धं बाध्यते पिता। पूषाहिरब्रघश्चार्धे जननी बाध्यते शिशोः॥
segments.english_translation: In the first half of Ashwini, Magha, and Mula, the father is afflicted. In the second half, the mother is afflicted for the child.

segments.sanskrit: पिबृहा तु दिवाजातो रात्रिजातस्तु मावा। आत्मक संध्ययोजीतो नास्ति गण्डो निरामयः॥
segments.english_translation: A child born during the day in Punarvasu is free from defects, while one born at night in Magha is afflicted. If born at the junction of day and night, there is no Gandanta and the child is healthy.

segments.sanskrit: सर्वेषां गण्डजातानां परित्यागो विधीयते। वर्जयेदशने तावत्तञ्च षाण्मासिकं भवेत्‌॥
segments.english_translation: For all born in Gandanta, abandonment is prescribed. Avoidance should be observed for six months.

segments.sanskrit: अयुक्तेतरजातस्य सूतकांल्यदिने पिता। शांतिं शुभेऽह्वि वा कुर्यात्तावस्पुत्र न रोचयेव॥
segments.english_translation: For those born in inauspicious times, the father should perform Shanti on an auspicious day, so that the child does not face obstacles.

segments.sanskrit: तिथिगण्डे त्वनङ्गां नक्षत्रे धेनुरुच्यते। कांचनं रुस्रगण्डे तु गण्डदोषो विनयति॥
segments.english_translation: In Tithi Gandanta, the Nakshatra is considered barren. Offering gold in the Gandanta of Nakshatra can mitigate the Gandanta Dosha.

segments.sanskrit: अथ ज्येष्ठादां तिथिधिरुच्यते। तत्र प्रयेकं घटिकाषदकुस्य फलान्याह भ्ररद्वाजः--
segments.english_translation: Now, the Jyestha Nakshatra Tithi is described. Bharadvaja speaks of the results of each Ghatika.

segments.sanskrit: श्येष्ठादौ मातृजननी मातामहं द्वितीयके। तृतीये मातं हति चतुर्थे जननीं तथा॥
segments.english_translation: In the beginning of Jyestha, the maternal grandmother is afflicted. In the second Ghatika, the maternal uncle is afflicted, and in the third, the mother is afflicted.

segments.sanskrit: आत्मानं पञ्चमे हंति षष्ठे गोत्रक्षयो भवेत्‌॥ सप्तमे पितृनाशः स्यादष्टमे ज्येष्ठसोदरम्‌।
segments.english_translation: In the fifth Ghatika, the self is afflicted, and in the sixth, the lineage is destroyed. In the seventh, the father is afflicted, and in the eighth, the elder sibling.

segments.sanskrit: नवमे श्वशुरं हंति सर्वस्वं दशमे तथा॥
segments.english_translation: In the ninth Ghatika, the father-in-law is afflicted, and in the tenth, all wealth is affected.

segments.sanskrit: अष्टमेऽहनि चन्द्रमाः क्षीणो भवति। अमावास्याष्टमे भागे पुनः कृत्स्नो भवेदणुः।
segments.english_translation: On the eighth day, the Moon is waning. On the eighth part of Amavasya, it becomes completely new.

segments.sanskrit: आग्रायण्यामावास्या तथा ज्येष्ठस्य या भवेत्। विशेषमाभ्यां ज्ञायते चन्द्रचारविदो जनाः।
segments.english_translation: The Amavasya in Agrahayana and that in Jyeshtha are special. Those knowledgeable in lunar movements understand this distinction.

segments.sanskrit: तदेत एव क्षयमेति कथं एवं ज्योतिष्वक्रविदो वदन्ति।
segments.english_translation: Thus, it is said by those skilled in Jyotish that this is how the waning occurs.

segments.sanskrit: अमावास्यायां चन्द्रदर्शनाभावे द्वयमेव कृत्स्नत्वकुहूत्वरूपं संभवति।
segments.english_translation: In the absence of the Moon's sighting on Amavasya, only two forms occur: complete and Kuhu.

segments.sanskrit: मध्याह्नसमयं यावत्सूर्योदयानुवर्तते। सिनीवालीति सा प्रोक्ता पितृकर्मणि शस्यते।
segments.english_translation: Until midday, as long as it follows sunrise, it is called Siniwali and is considered auspicious for ancestral rites.

segments.sanskrit: ऊटूः सिनीवाली नष्टदृष्टे चन्द्रे।
segments.english_translation: Uttu is Siniwali when the Moon is unseen.

segments.sanskrit: अमावास्यायां चन्द्रदर्शनाभावे द्वयमेव कृत्स्नत्वकुहूत्वरूपं संभवति।
segments.english_translation: In the absence of the Moon's sighting on Amavasya, only two forms occur: complete and Kuhu.

segments.sanskrit: एकस्मिन्नेव नक्षत्रे भ्रातृपुत्रयोः प्रसूतिश्च तयोः शान्त्यै शुभैवेदेकस्य निश्चयः।
segments.english_translation: When both brothers and sons are born under the same Nakshatra, it is auspicious to perform a peace ritual for one of them.

segments.sanskrit: तदोषनाशाय तदा भ्रातृसुतां शान्तिं च कुर्यादभिषेचनं च।
segments.english_translation: To remove the defect, perform a peace ritual and consecration for the brothers and sons.

segments.sanskrit: सवौरुंकारयुक्तानां त्रयाणामभिषेचनम्।
segments.english_translation: Perform the consecration with the three syllables of Om.

segments.sanskrit: अथैकनक्षत्रजज्ञातानां शान्तिविधिरुच्यते।
segments.english_translation: Now, the peace ritual for those born under the same Nakshatra is described.

segments.sanskrit: ग्रहणे चन्द्रसूर्यस्य प्रसूतियदि जायते।
segments.english_translation: If birth occurs during a solar or lunar eclipse.

segments.sanskrit: तदक्चाधिपते रूपं सुवर्णेन प्रकल्पयेत्।
segments.english_translation: Create the form of the ruling planet with gold.

segments.sanskrit: सूर्ये प्रदातव्यं सूर्यप्रीतिकरं च यत्।
segments.english_translation: Offer what is pleasing to the Sun to appease him.

segments.sanskrit: चन्द्रे च पालाशः समिधश्चैव हयान्नरः।
segments.english_translation: For the Moon, offer Palasha wood and grains.

segments.sanskrit: राहवे चेव दातव्यं कृष्णयूपांबराणि च।
segments.english_translation: For Rahu, offer black garments.

segments.sanskrit: अश्विन्यादीनां भानां तारकाः क्रमतो ज्ञेयाः।
segments.english_translation: The stars of the Ashvini and other Nakshatras should be known in order.

segments.sanskrit: अश्विन्यादिरूपं तुरगासुखययोनिष्ठरोऽन एणासुखमणिगदं च।
segments.english_translation: The form of Ashvini and others is described as a horse, a yoke, a chariot, and a gem.

segments.sanskrit: जलाशयारामसुरप्रतिष्ठा सौम्यायने जीवशशाङ्कशयकरे।
segments.english_translation: The establishment of water bodies, gardens, and deities is auspicious during the northern solstice when Jupiter and the Moon are in favorable positions.

segments.sanskrit:
घोराकैसंक्रमणयुग्रसो हि शूद्रा
न्धवांश्षी विशो रघुविधौ च चर्धमोमे ।
चौरान्महोद्रथुता चृपतीन्क्मेत्
मंदाकिनी स्थिरगुरौ खुखयेच्च मेदा ॥
segments.english_translation: If the Sun's transit occurs on a Sunday or in a fierce Nakshatra, it brings happiness to the Shudras. If it occurs on a Monday or in a light Nakshatra, it brings happiness to the Vaishyas. If it occurs on a Tuesday or in a movable Nakshatra, it brings happiness to thieves. If it occurs on a Wednesday or in a friendly Nakshatra, it brings happiness to kings. If it occurs on a Thursday or in a fixed Nakshatra, it brings happiness to the Brahmins.

segments.sanskrit:
विग्रांथ मिश्रमभृगो त॒ पञ्चश्च मिश्रा
तीक्ष्णाकजेऽन्यजसुखा खट राक्षसी च ।
segments.english_translation: If the Sun's transit occurs on a Friday or in a mixed Nakshatra, it brings happiness to mixed castes. If it occurs on a Saturday or in a sharp Nakshatra, it brings happiness to the Rakshasas and the lower castes.

segments.sanskrit: व्य॑दो दिनख च्ुपतीन्प्रथमे निरति मध्ये द्विजानपि विशोऽपरके च शद्रान्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: In the first part of the day, kings are harmed; in the middle, Brahmins; and in the last part, the Shudras.

segments.sanskrit: अस्ते निशाप्रहरके च पिशाचकादी- स्तचरानपि नटान्पशुपालकांश्च ।
segments.english_translation: In the night, during the first quarter, ghosts and spirits are harmed; in the second, nocturnal beings; in the third, actors; and in the fourth, cowherds.

segments.sanskrit: घर्योदये सकलठिंगिजनं च सौम्य- याम्यायनं मकरकर्कटयोनिरुक्तम्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: At sunrise, all heretics are harmed. The transition between Capricorn and Cancer is described as the transition between the Southern and Northern solstices.

segments.sanskrit: पडशीलयाननं चापनृुकन्याक्षपे भवेत्‌ । त॒लाजौ विषुव विष्णुपदं सिंहालिगोषटे ॥
segments.english_translation: The transition in Sagittarius, Gemini, Virgo, and Pisces is called Shadashiti. The transition in Aries and Libra is called Vishuva. The transition in Leo, Scorpio, and Taurus is called Vishnupada.

segments.sanskrit: निशीथतोऽ्वागपरत्र संक्रमे ूर्वापराहांतिमपूरवभागकौ ।
segments.english_translation: If the transition occurs before midnight, the previous day is auspicious. If it occurs after midnight, the following day is auspicious.

segments.sanskrit: र्ण निशीये यदि संक्रमः स्यादिनद्रयं पुण्यमथोदयासतात्‌ ।
segments.english_translation: If the transition occurs at midnight, the following two days are auspicious.

segments.sanskrit: पूष प्र्ताद्यदि याम्यसोम्यायने दिने पूर्वपरे तु पुण्ये ॥
segments.english_translation: If the transition occurs at sunrise, the day before and the day after are auspicious during the Southern and Northern solstices.

segments.sanskrit: याम्यायने विष्णुपदे चाया मध्यास्तुलाजयोः। षडशीत्यानने सौम्ये परा नाव्योऽतिपुण्यदाः॥
segments.english_translation: In the southern solstice (Dakshinayana) and at the Vishnupada, the middle of Libra and Aries, and during the sixteenth lunar day (Shashti), the auspicious times are exceedingly fruitful.

segments.sanskrit: तथायनांशाः खरसाहताथ सय्गत्या विहता दिनैः। मेषादितः प्राक्चलसंकरमाः स्युदोने जपादौ बहु पुण्यदास्ते॥
segments.english_translation: Similarly, the Ayana portions, when multiplied by the solar motion and divided by the days, from Aries onward, result in the movable Sankrantis, which are highly auspicious for donations, recitations, and other rituals.

segments.sanskrit: समं मृदुिप्रबसुश्रवोऽग्निमाग्रिपूर्वास्रपरं बरहन्खात्‌ । बदविदेवादितिभं जघन्यं सारपाबुपाद्रनिलशाक्रयाम्यम्‌ ।।
segments.english_translation: The Nakshatras Mrigashira, Chitra, Anuradha, Shravana, Krittika, Magha, Purva Phalguni, Purva Ashadha, and Purva Bhadrapada are considered auspicious. The Nakshatras Rohini, Uttara Phalguni, Uttara Ashadha, and Uttara Bhadrapada are considered inauspicious. The Nakshatras Ashlesha, Ardra, Swati, Jyeshtha, and Bharani are considered neutral.

segments.sanskrit: जपन्यमे संक्रमणे यहूरतीः शरदो १५ बाणङ्रता ४५ इृहतसु । सराम ३० संख्याः समभे महाधसम्धसाम्यं विधुदशनेऽपि ।।
segments.english_translation: During the transit in inauspicious Nakshatras, the duration is 15 Ghatis; in auspicious Nakshatras, it is 45 Ghatis; and in neutral Nakshatras, it is 30 Ghatis. This applies to lunar eclipses as well.

segments.sanskrit: अकदिवारे संकरो ककैर्ाग्दविंशोपकाः । दिश्षो नखा गजाः श्यौ धरत्योऽष्टाद्च सायकाः ।।
segments.english_translation: On Sunday, the transit is 10 Ghatis; on Monday, 20 Ghatis; on Tuesday, 8 Ghatis; on Wednesday, 12 Ghatis; on Thursday, 16 Ghatis; on Friday, 18 Ghatis; and on Saturday, 24 Ghatis.

segments.sanskrit: खात्तेतिके नागचतुष्पदे रविः सुनो निविष्स्तु गरादिर्पचके । विस्तुघ्र उ शनौ सदौरवेऽनिष्टः समः भरषठ इार्वर्षणे ।।
segments.english_translation: In the Karanas Taitila and Nagava, the Sun is auspicious. In the Karanas Garaja and Vanija, the Sun is neutral. In the Karanas Vishti and Shakuni, the Sun is inauspicious. In the Karanas Bava and Balava, the Sun is neutral.

segments.sanskrit: सिंहव्याघ्रवराहरासभगजावाहद्धिषदरोरकाः श्वाजो गौथरणायुधथ बवतो वाहा रवेः संक्रमे । वस्रं ्ेतसुपीतहारितकयाण्डारक्तकालासितं चित्रं कंबरुदिग्बनाममथ शसं याद्धु्चंडी गदा ।।
segments.english_translation: During the Sun's transit, the vehicles are lion, tiger, boar, donkey, elephant, buffalo, horse, dog, goat, and bull. The clothes are white, yellow, green, red, black, and multi-colored. The weapons are sword, staff, arrow, and spear.

segments.sanskrit: खङ्गो दंडशरासतोमरमथो ढुंतश्च पाशञोऽङयोऽलं बाणस्त्वथ भ्ष्यमन्नपरमानं भेक्षपकान्नकम्‌ । दुग्धं दध्यपि चित्रितान्नगुडमध्वाज्यं तथा शकराऽधो लेपो म्रगनाभिङङममथो पाटीरमृद्रौचनम्‌ ।।
segments.english_translation: The weapons are sword, staff, bow, spear, and club. The foods are milk, curd, sweet rice, sugar, and clarified butter. The ointments are musk, saffron, sandalwood, and turmeric.

segments.sanskrit: यावश्ोतुमदो निशांजनमथो काागुरुश॑द्रको जातिदैवतभूतसर्पविहगाः पशवेणविप्ासततः । शत्तावेश्यकसशद्रसंकरभवाः पुष्पं च पु्ागर्कं जातीबाङलकेतकानि च तथा बिर्वाक॑दूबौबुजम्‌ ।।
segments.english_translation: The perfumes are musk, saffron, sandalwood, and turmeric. The flowers are jasmine, lotus, and ketaki. The animals are cow, horse, and elephant.

segments.sanskrit: खान्मष्टिका पाटलिका जपा च संकरांतिवसराश्चनवाहनादे; । नाशश्च तद्स्युपजीविनां च सितोपविष्टखपतां च नाशः ।।
segments.english_translation: The flowers are jasmine, lotus, and hibiscus. The transit time is auspicious for vehicles and their maintenance. The destruction of enemies and success in endeavors are indicated.

segments.sanskrit: संक्रांतिपिष्ण्याधरधिष्ण्यतचिमे खमे निरुक्त गमन ततोऽङ्गभे। सुखं त्रिमे पीडनमेगभेऽथुकं त्रिभेऽथदानी रसभे धनागमः।।
segments.english_translation: When the Sun transits into a Nakshatra that is in the lower quarter, it is considered inauspicious. In the first three Nakshatras, travel is favorable. In the next three, there is comfort. In the following three, there is bodily pain. In the next three, there is loss. In the last three, there is gain of wealth.

segments.sanskrit: गरेण सर्वकृतिश् संगरः शासं विवाहो गमृदीक्षणे खः। वीरयेऽथ तारारुतः शमो विधुरविंधोबलेऽकोऽकवले कुजादयः।।
segments.english_translation: On a Sunday, all activities are successful. On a Monday, there is peace. On a Tuesday, there is conflict. On a Wednesday, there is marriage. On a Thursday, there is travel. On a Friday, there is initiation. On a Saturday, there is obstruction. The planets Mars and others have their own effects based on their strength and position.

segments.sanskrit: स्पष्टाकं संकरांतिविहीन उक्तो मासोऽधिमासः क्षयमासकस्तु। द्विसंक्रमरत्र विभागयोः स्तसिथेहि मासो प्रथमां यसंजञो।।
segments.english_translation: A month without a clear solar transit is called an Adhika Masa (extra month). A month with two solar transits is called a Kshaya Masa (deficient month). The first half of the month is considered for rituals and ceremonies, while the second half is for other activities.

segments.sanskrit: दुष्टोऽपि खेटो विपरीतवेधाच्छुभो दिकोणे शुभदः सितेऽपि।
segments.english_translation: Even a malefic planet, when aspected by a reverse aspect, becomes benefic in angular houses, even if it is in a benefic sign.

segments.sanskrit: खजन्मरारोरिह वेधमाहुरन्ये ग्रहाधिष्ठितराशितः सः।
segments.english_translation: Some say that the aspect from the natal sign of the planet is considered, while others consider the aspect from the sign occupied by the planet.

segments.sanskrit: जन्म निधनं ग्रहणं जनितो घातः क्षतिः शरीरथा।
segments.english_translation: During an eclipse occurring in the natal sign, it causes death, injury, and bodily harm.

segments.sanskrit:
अथ चन्द्रस्य दोषमनुष्टुभाद्यः।
यापान्तः पापयुग्धूने पापाचन्द्रः शुभोऽप्यसौ।
भांशे चाधिमितरांशे गुरुच्टोञ्छभोऽपि स्यात्‌॥
segments.english_translation: Now, the blemish of the Moon is described in Anushtubh meter. If the Moon is associated with malefics and is in a malefic sign, it is considered inauspicious. However, if it is in a benefic sign or aspected by Jupiter, it becomes auspicious.

segments.sanskrit:
पापांत इति। छभोऽपि छभफरदोऽपि चंद्रः पापांतः पापयुक्‌ चूने। कोऽथः?
पापद्भयमध्यवतीं पापम्रहयुक्छः पापाद्‌ यूने सपमस्थाने वतैमानश्वेरसयाक्तदाजस-
ब्रह्भ पक। यदा स्वछ्छभोऽप्यच्छभफरूदातापि चंद: छभरो सौम्यञहनवारो
स्यादथवाऽधिमिन्रस्य नवांशो स्यात्तथा गुरुणा इहस्पतिना दृष्टः सन्‌ श्युभफल-
दाता भवेद। यदाह राजमार्तंडः--“पापम्रहेण संयुक्तः पापजामित्रसंस्थितः।
-पापद्वयान्तरगतः छभोऽप्बञ्छुमदः शती॥ जनिष्टस्थानसंस्थोऽपि भवेच्छुभ-
करः शद्षी। सौस्यभागेऽधिमिन्रांशे गुरणा वापि वीक्षिते॥' इति॥
segments.english_translation: Even if the Moon is in a malefic sign or associated with malefics, it can still be auspicious if it is in a benefic sign or aspected by Jupiter. As stated by Rajamartanda, if the Moon is associated with malefics but aspected by Jupiter, it becomes auspicious.

segments.sanskrit:
अथ चन्द्रस्य बिधानांतरमनुष्टुभाह।
सितासितादौ सहु चन्द्रे पौ छमाबुभ।
व्यत्यासे चा्चमो प्रोक्तौ संकटेऽल्नबरं त्विदम्‌॥
segments.english_translation: Now, another rule for the Moon is described in Anushtubh meter. If the Moon is full in the bright fortnight and new in the dark fortnight, it is considered auspicious. However, if the Moon is new in the bright fortnight or full in the dark fortnight, it is considered inauspicious.

segments.sanskrit:
वरजं शक्रेऽन्जे सुधुक्ता प्रवारं मौमेऽगौ गोमेदमाक सुनीरम्‌।
कतौ वैडूय गुरो पुष्पकः जे पायिः प्राद्याणिक्यमर्ः तु मध्ये॥
segments.english_translation: For the Navaratna (nine gems), place diamond in the east for Venus, pearl in the southeast for Moon, coral in the south for Mars, hessonite in the southwest for Rahu, blue sapphire in the west for Saturn, cat's eye in the northwest for Ketu, yellow sapphire in the north for Jupiter, emerald in the northeast for Mercury, and ruby in the center for Sun.

segments.sanskrit:
माणिक्यमुक्ताएलविद्धुमाणि गारुत्मतं पुष्पकवजनीरप्‌।
ोमेदैद्यैकमर्कतः स्यू रतान्यथो गख दे सुवर्णम्‌॥
segments.english_translation: Wear ruby for the Sun, pearl for the Moon, coral for Mars, emerald for Mercury, yellow sapphire for Jupiter, diamond for Venus, blue sapphire for Saturn, hessonite for Rahu, and cat's eye for Ketu. If these are unavailable, wear gold instead.

segments.sanskrit: शैलाजावतैकः राहुकेतवो रौप्यं शुको युक्ता गुरोस्तु। लो मंदसखारभान्वोः प्रवारं ताराजन्मकषौत्रिरादृत्तितः स्यात्॥
segments.english_translation: For Rahu and Ketu, use Shailaja and Avataika; for Venus, use silver; for Jupiter, use gold. For Saturn and Mars, use iron. The auspiciousness of a star is determined by the birth star and should be calculated thrice.

segments.sanskrit: जन्माख्वरुपद्विषदः क्षेमप्रयरिसाधकाः। वधमेत्रातिमेत्राः स्युतारा नामसदक्फलाः॥
segments.english_translation: The birth star, the second, and the sixth are beneficial for prosperity and success. The third, fifth, and seventh stars are inauspicious.

segments.sanskrit: मत्यै सर्णतिसान्विष्यपि गुडं शाकं त्रिजन्मखथो। दद्यासयरितारकासु रणं स्ौ विषसयरिः॥
segments.english_translation: In the star of death, offer sesame seeds and gold; in the star of adversity, offer jaggery and vegetables; in the star of birth, offer grains and fruits.

segments.sanskrit: पृष्ट ६० भं गतं धक्तपुरीयुक्तं युगा 9 हतम्‌। शरान्धि ४५ हृष्टम्धतोऽकंरोषेऽवसाः क्रियाद्विधोः॥
segments.english_translation: Multiply the elapsed degrees by 60, add the Nakshatra's Ghatis, and divide by 45 to determine the Moon's phase for auspicious activities.

segments.sanskrit: श्रवासनाशौ मरणं जयश्च हास्यारतिक्री डितसुपेक्ताः। ज्वराख्यकंपसिरता अवसा मेषात्करमान्नामसरक्फराः स्युः॥
segments.english_translation: The Moon's phases are named as Shravan, Nash, Maran, Jaya, Hasya, Rati, Krida, Supeksha, Jwara, Kampa, and Sirata, each with specific effects.

segments.sanskrit: लाजाङुष्ठबलाप्रियगुषनसिद्वर्थनिक्ादारुभिः। पुंखालोधयुतजरेर्मिंगदितं खानं ग्रहोस्थाषहृत्‌॥
segments.english_translation: Using Laja, Kushta, Bala, Priyangu, Siddhartha, and Daru, prepare a remedy to alleviate the malefic effects of planets.

segments.sanskrit: सर्यारसोम्यास्फुजितोशनागसपताद्विषसरान्विधुरभिनाडी;। तमोयमेज्या्ञिरसाश्विमसान्मतन्यराशेः फलदाः पुरस्तात्‌॥
segments.english_translation: The Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, and Saturn give results based on their positions in the zodiac signs from Aries onwards.

segments.sanskrit: सूयैः पंचदिनं शी त्रिघटिकं भौमोऽष्ट वै वासरान्स्ताहानि गुः ससोमतनयो मासद्वयं वै गुरः। षण्मासान्पुरतोऽपि सूर्यतनयो राहुश्च मासत्रयं केतुशरैव ददाति भावि सकलं गंतब्यराोः कलम्‌॥
segments.english_translation: The Sun gives results for five days, the Moon for three Ghatis, Mars for eight days, Mercury for ten days, Jupiter for two months, Venus for six months, Saturn for two and a half years, Rahu for three months, and Ketu for three months, in the transit of signs.

segments.sanskrit: दुष्टे योगे हेम चंद्रे च शंसं धान्यं तिथ्यर्थं तिथ तंडलां ध। वारे रते भ च गां हेम नाल्यां दचाससिभूत्थं च तारा राजा॥
segments.english_translation: In a malefic Yoga, one should give gold; in a malefic lunar day, a conch; in a malefic Tithi, grains; in a malefic weekday, coral; in a malefic Nakshatra, a cow; and in a malefic Nadi, gold.

segments.sanskrit: राश्यादिगौ रविजौ फलदौ सितेज्यौ मध्ये सदा शरिखुवथरमेऽम्नमंदौ। अध्वान्नवहविभयसन्मतिवस्रसोख्य-दुःखानि मासि जनिमे रविवासरादो॥
segments.english_translation: The Sun and Mars give results when transiting from one sign to another. Mercury and Venus give results in the middle of the sign. Saturn and Rahu give results at the end of the sign. The results of travel, fear, good intellect, wealth, happiness, and sorrow are experienced in the month when the birth Nakshatra coincides with the weekday of the Sun.

segments.sanskrit: आय रजः जुम माधमागेराधेषफा्गुने। ज्येष्ठभरावणयोः शङ्के सद्वारे सत्तनौ दिवा॥
segments.english_translation: The first menstruation seen in the months of Chaitra, Magha, Margashirsha, Vaishakha, and Phalguna is auspicious. In Jyeshtha and Bhadrapada, it is inauspicious. It is auspicious on Sundays and in the signs of Aries, Taurus, and Gemini during the day.

segments.sanskrit: शुतित्रयखदुधिप्रभुवखातौ सितारे। मध्यं च मूलादितिभपित्मिभेऽपरेष्वसत्‌॥
segments.english_translation: The first menstruation seen in the Nakshatras of Shravana, Dhanishta, and Shatabhisha is auspicious. In the Nakshatras of Mula, Ashlesha, and Magha, it is of medium result. In other Nakshatras, it is inauspicious.

segments.sanskrit: अद्रानिद्रासंक्रमे दशरिक्तासंष्यापषठीद्राद्चीवैधतेषु। रोगेऽटम्यां चन्द्रशयौपरागे पाते चां नो रजोदशन सत्‌॥
segments.english_translation: Menstruation seen during Bhadra, sleep, Sankranti, Amavasya, eclipse, or during the eighth Tithi is inauspicious.

segments.sanskrit: अष्टमी श्यामा रिक्ता चतुर्दशी संक्रमेऽपि वा। वैटते च व्यतीपाते ग्रहणे चंद्रसूर्ययोः॥
segments.english_translation: The eighth day (Ashtami), the dark fortnight (Shyama), the fourteenth day (Chaturdashi), during the solar or lunar eclipse, and during the Vyatipata and Vaidhriti Yogas are considered inauspicious.

segments.sanskrit: हस्तान्यश्विन्यनुराधाधनिष्ठारोहिण्युत्तरात्रयज्येष्ठाभिः। क्षमतिथौ भद्रा निद्रासंक्रमे शशभवासरे च॥
segments.english_translation: During the Nakshatras Hasta, Ashwini, Anuradha, Dhanishta, Rohini, the three Uttaras, and Jyeshtha, on the auspicious tithis, during the Bhadra, Nidra, and Sankranti, and on the days of the Moon, Mercury, Jupiter, and Venus, conception is auspicious.

segments.sanskrit: गण्डान्तं त्रिविधं यजेन्निधनजन्मक्ष च भूखान्तकं। पौष्णमघोपरागदिवसान् पातं तथा वैधृतिम्‌॥
segments.english_translation: Avoid the three types of Gandanta, the Nakshatras of death and birth, the Bhukanta, the days of Revati, Magha, eclipses, and the Vyatipata and Vaidhriti Yogas.

segments.sanskrit: भद्राष्ठमीपरवरिक्ताश्च संध्या भौमाकौकीं नाचरात्रीशतस्लः। गर्भाधानं स्युततरदकैमैत्रनाहखाती विष्णुवश्वुपे सत्‌॥
segments.english_translation: Avoid Bhadra, Ashtami, Parva, Rikta, Sandhya, Tuesday, and Saturday nights for conception. Conception is auspicious during the Nakshatras ruled by Vishnu and Shiva.

segments.sanskrit: केन्द्रत्रिकोणेषु शुभैः पापैर्यायारिगेः पुंग्रदद्टरमरे। ओजांशगेदावपि युग्मरात्रौ चिघ्रादितीज्याधिषु मध्यमं तत्‌॥
segments.english_translation: Conception is auspicious when the Moon is in Kendra or Trikona with benefics, or in the 6th, 8th, or 12th houses with malefics. It is also auspicious during even nights when the Moon is in an odd sign.

segments.sanskrit: जीवाकौरदिने सृगेज्यनिरतिभ्रोत्ादितिबरभभे रिक्तामाकैरसाष्टवज्यैतिथिमिमासाधिपे पीवरे । समेतोऽटमषष्टमासि शदैः केदरत्रिकोणे खरे- लभिारित्रिषु वा ्ुवांलसदहे मरे च पुंभांशके ॥
segments.english_translation: In the presence of Jupiter, Sun, and Mars, on their respective days, and avoiding the Tithis of Rikta, Amavasya, Ashtami, and Dwadasi, the Simantonnayana ceremony should be performed in the eighth or sixth month of pregnancy, when the Moon is in a favorable position, and the ascendant is in a male sign.

segments.sanskrit: मासेश्वराः सितद्जेज्यरवींदुसौर- चंद्रातमजास्तनुपचंद्रदिवाकराः स्युः ! स्रीणां विधोर्र्चति विवाहग- संस्कारयोरितरकर्मख भवैरेव ॥
segments.english_translation: The lords of the months are Venus, Mars, Sun, Moon, Saturn, Mercury, and the ascendant lord. For women, the Moon is considered for marriage and other ceremonies, while for other rituals, the planetary positions are considered.

segments.sanskrit: पूवोदितैः पंसवने विधेयं मासे दतीये खथ विष्णुपूजा । मासेऽ्टमे विष्णुविधाठ्जीवैरंगर श्चभे मृत्युग्रह च शद्धे ।।
segments.english_translation: In the second month, the Pumsavana ceremony should be performed with the previously mentioned auspicious Tithis and Nakshatras. In the eighth month, Vishnu Puja should be conducted with Jupiter and other benefic planets in favorable positions, avoiding malefic influences.

segments.sanskrit: तज्ञातकमीदि शिशो्िे्यं पर्वाख्यरिक्तोनतिभथौ शभेऽहि । एकादशे द्वादशकेऽपि घस शदुशुवधिप्रचरोडपषु खात्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: The Jatakarma ceremony for the newborn should be performed on an auspicious day, avoiding Rikta and other inauspicious Tithis. It can be done on the eleventh or twelfth day after birth, considering the planetary positions.

segments.sanskrit: पोप्णधुुकरवातहयेषु छतीसानं समित्रभरवीज्यङजेषु स्तम्‌ । नाद्रात्रयश्वुतिमघांतकमिश्रमूलत्वा ञसोरिवसुषद्रविरिक्ततिथ्याम्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras of Revati, Dhanishta, Hasta, Swati, and Ashwini, along with the auspicious days of Sunday, Thursday, and Tuesday, the birth ceremony is considered auspicious. However, it is not recommended during the Nakshatras of Bharani, Krittika, Magha, and Moola, or during the Rikta Tithis (4th, 9th, 14th).

segments.sanskrit: मासे चेसरथमे मवेत्सदश्ननो बालो विनग्येत्खय हन्यात्स करमतोऽ्लुजातभगिनीमात्रग्रनान्यादिके । षादौ ठभते हि भोगमतुरं तातास्सुखं पुषटतां क्षमी सौख्यमथो जनो सदशन बोध्यं खपित्रादिहा ॥
segments.english_translation: If a child is born with teeth in the first month, it is considered inauspicious and may lead to the death of the mother or father. In subsequent months, the effects vary: in the second month, it may harm siblings; in the third, the mother; in the fourth, the father; in the fifth, the elder siblings. From the sixth month onwards, it brings prosperity and happiness.

segments.sanskrit: दोलारोदेऽ्क॑मात्यचशरपंचेषुसमभेः । नैरुज्यं मरणं कार्यं व्याधिः सौख्यं ऋमाच्छिशोः ॥
segments.english_translation: During the installation of a swing (Dola), if the Nakshatras are Ashwini, Bharani, Krittika, or Rohini, it brings health. If the Nakshatras are Mrigashira, Ardra, or Punarvasu, it may lead to death. If the Nakshatras are Pushya, Ashlesha, or Magha, it may cause disease. If the Nakshatras are Purva Phalguni, Uttara Phalguni, or Hasta, it brings happiness.

segments.sanskrit: द॑ंताकंभूपधृतिदिङ्मितवासरे स्या- हारे शभ खदुलघुधुवभेः रिच्लाम्‌ । दोलाधिरूडिरथ निष्कमणं चतुर्थ- मासे गमोक्तसमयेऽर्कमितेऽदहि वा स्यात्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: The installation of a swing (Dola) should be done on auspicious days calculated by the positions of the planets and Nakshatras. The child should be placed on the swing in the fourth month, or on a day calculated as auspicious by the positions of the Sun and other celestial bodies.

segments.sanskrit: खडुवक्षिभ्रमेषु माता वा ऊर्योषितः। योगशायिहारे स्तवा प्राक्डीर्षं विन्यसेच्छिडछम्॥
segments.english_translation: In the case of the confusion of the eyes, the mother or the wife should perform the ritual with the appropriate Yoga and Nakshatra.

segments.sanskrit: उगनढमूलादिशिवाभिवज्यं शसतेदुतारातिथिरुप्रयोगे। विष्टिक्षमात्रयमाहवन्यमांदोरुकारोहणमत्र शस्तम्॥
segments.english_translation: Avoid the Nakshatras starting from Mula and the Tithis that are inauspicious. The auspicious time for the ceremony is when the Nakshatra and Tithi are favorable.

segments.sanskrit: चतुर्थमासे गमोक्तसमये यात्राभिहितसमीचीनतिथिवारनक्षत्रादिसदिते काठे शिद्यूनां निष्क्रमणं निष्कमाख्यसंस्कारं पूर्व गृदाद्हिगेमनं ऊर्यात्।
segments.english_translation: In the fourth month, during the prescribed time, the ceremony of 'Nishkramana' should be performed when the Tithi, Vara, and Nakshatra are favorable.

segments.sanskrit: कवीश्यासतयनाधिमासे न पपे जरं पूजयेरदरतिक मासपूरता। बुधेद्धिज्यवारे विरिकते तिथ दि श्वुतीज्यादितींदकेनेकरतयमत्रः॥
segments.english_translation: In the month of Chaitra, Adhika Masa, or Pausha, the mother should not perform the ritual if the Tithi is Rikta or the day is Wednesday or Thursday.

segments.sanskrit: रिक्तानदाष्टदं हरिदिवसमथो सोरिभैमार्वार् हरं जम्मधैरग्ाष्टमगृहरवगं मीनमेषालिकं च। हित्वा षष्ठात्समे माखथ हि श्रगद्शाँ पचमादोजमासे नक्षत्रैः खारिथिराख्यैः समदुरघुचै्बारुकानाश्ने सत्॥
segments.english_translation: Avoid Rikta Tithis, Haridivas, and the Nakshatras of Moola, Ashlesha, and Jyeshtha. The ceremony should be performed in the sixth or eighth month with favorable Nakshatras.

segments.sanskrit: कद्रिकोणगाः सौम्याः पापाः षष्ठत्रिङाभगाः। उपनिष्करमणे शस्ता मातुलो वाहयेच््छिद्म्॥
segments.english_translation: The planets in the Kendra and Trikona positions are auspicious, while those in the sixth, eighth, and twelfth houses are inauspicious. The maternal uncle should carry the child during the Upanayana ceremony.

segments.sanskrit: त्रिकोणव्ययकेद्राटखितैरुकं फा गैः। भिक्षाशी यजञृदीैजीषरी ज्ञानी च पिचरुक्॥
segments.english_translation: The planets in Trikona, Vyaya, and Kendra positions bring prosperity. The person will be a mendicant, a performer of sacrifices, knowledgeable, and free from ailments.

segments.sanskrit: पृथ्वीवराहमभिषूज्य रिक्ते तिथौ ब्रजति पंचममासि वारम्। वद्धा श्वेऽहि किघ्त्रमथ शवेदु-उयेषठकषमेतरलघुमेरुपवेशषयेत्कौ॥
segments.english_translation: After worshipping the Earth and Varaha, on a non-empty Tithi, during the fifth month, on a suitable day, one should perform the ceremony of seating the child on the ground, considering the auspicious Nakshatras and other factors.

segments.sanskrit: तस्मिन्काले स्थापयेततत्पुरस्तादखं शसं पुस्तकं लेखनीं च। खण रोप्यं यच्च गृह्णाति वरख वृत्तिः प्रदिष्टा॥
segments.english_translation: At that time, place before the child a pen, book, and other items. The item the child grasps indicates their future profession.

segments.sanskrit: वारे भोमारकिहीने धुवगदुरघुभेविष्णुमूलावितीद्र खातीवखमभ्युपेतेरमिुनस्रगसुताकुभगो मीनरग्न। सौम्यैः केद्रत्िकोणैरद्यभगगनगैः शुकाभ्रिसंखे- सतांबूलं साधमासद्वयमितसमये प्रोक्तमन्नाशने बा॥
segments.english_translation: On a day devoid of Mars and Sun, with auspicious Nakshatras like Dhruva, Gada, and others, and with the Moon in Gemini, Virgo, Capricorn, or Pisces, the child should be given betel leaves to chew after six months, considering the positions of benefic planets.

segments.sanskrit: हितवैताशत्रपौषावमहरिश्चयनः जन्ममासं च रिक्तां युग्माग्द्‌ जन्मताराग्रतसुनिवसुभिः संमिते माखथो क। जन्माडात्घयभूषैः परिमितदिवसे हेग्यञ्युकरदुवारे, 'थोजण्दे विष्णुकुमर्विकिशदुलखुमैः फणवेषः प्रशस्तः॥
segments.english_translation: Avoid the months of Ashadha, Shravana, and Pausha for ear-piercing. The ceremony should be done in the sixth or eighth month from birth, on a day with auspicious Nakshatras and benefic planetary positions.

segments.sanskrit: संदधे मरतिभनने त्रिकोणङेदर- च्यायद्येः शुभस्य, करीन्यरपे। पावास्थैररिसष्टनायभेदसंखे- रेखे त्रिदशगुरो श्॒भावहः खात्‌॥
segments.english_translation: When the planets are not in the eighth house, and the Moon is in a benefic sign, the ear-piercing ceremony is auspicious. The ceremony should be performed when the Moon is in a trine or sextile position with benefic planets.

segments.sanskrit: गीकीणांबुपरतिष्ठापरिणयदहनाधानचोलोपवीत- क्षोणीपालाभिषेकोदवसितविशन नैव याम्यायने स्यात्‌। नो वा बार्यासतवाद्छ सुरगुरुसितयोर्नेव केतदये खा- त्य वार्ध च केचिज्ञहति तमयरे यावदीश्षां तदुग्र॥
segments.english_translation: Ceremonies like installation of deities, marriage, fire rituals, and others should not be performed during the Dakshinayana (southern solstice). Some also avoid these during the conjunction of Jupiter and Venus.

segments.sanskrit: कैतोरस्तदिनादृ्वं ससाद मंगलं त्यजेत्‌। यावक्केतूदयस्तावदञ्यदधः समयो हि सः॥
segments.english_translation: Before the rise of Ketu, one should abandon auspicious activities. As long as Ketu rises, that time is considered inauspicious.

segments.sanskrit: पुरः पथाद्धमोरबारयं त्रिदशा च वार्थकम्‌। पक्ष पंचदिरन ते दवे गुरोः पक्षयदाहते॥
segments.english_translation: Before and after the path of Jupiter, the thirteenth day and the day of the week are considered inauspicious. The two fortnights of Jupiter are said to be inauspicious.

segments.sanskrit: ते दशाहं टयोः प्रोक्ते फैधित्सकषदिनं परैः। त्यहं स्वालयपिकेऽप्यन्यरभीडं च व्यहं बिधोः॥
segments.english_translation: For those two, ten days are said to be inauspicious, and for others, the fifth day is considered inauspicious. The day of the week and the day of the fortnight are also considered inauspicious for the Moon.

segments.sanskrit: चूडा बर्पाततृतीयात्पमभवति विषमेऽषटाकरिक्तायपषठी। पर्वोनाहे विचैत्रोदगयनसमये जेदुश्रेज्यकानाम्‌।
segments.english_translation: The tonsure ceremony should be performed in the third year, in odd years, or in the fifth or seventh year. It should be done on a day free from the eighth lunar day, Rikta Tithi, and other inauspicious times, during the northern solstice, and in the month of Chaitra.

segments.sanskrit: शषीणच॑दरकुजसौरिभास्कौभतयुरासश्तिष॑गुताज्वराः। स्युः क्रमेण बुधजीवमा्ैः केदरगेश शुभमिषटतारया॥
segments.english_translation: The Moon, Mars, Saturn, and the Sun, when in the sign of Ketu, cause death, blindness, lameness, and fever respectively. Mercury and Jupiter, however, bring auspicious results when in the sign of Ketu.

segments.sanskrit: पंचमासाधिके मातुर्मे चोरं दिशो सत्‌। पंचवपीधिकस्टं गर्भिण्यामपि मातरि॥
segments.english_translation: If the mother is pregnant, the tonsure ceremony should not be performed before the fifth month. If the child is five years old, it should not be done if the mother is pregnant.

segments.sanskrit: क्षं दग्धं तिथी रिक्ता चंद्राष्टरमसस्था। तत्सर्वं नाशयेत्तारा पर चतुर्ैवमी तथा। जन्माख्या चाष्टमी तरा न छभा नापि निदिवा।
segments.english_translation: The burnt Tithi, the empty (Rikta) Tithi, and the Moon in the eighth house destroy everything. The star (Tara) on the fourth day, the eighth day, and the day of birth should not be considered auspicious.

segments.sanskrit: कऋतुमलयाः छतिकायाः दोश्रोलादि नाचरेत्‌।
segments.english_translation: During the period of impurity due to menstruation or childbirth, one should not perform auspicious activities.

segments.sanskrit: द॑तक्षोरनखक्रियात्र विहिता चौरोदिते बारभे पातंग्याररवीन्विहाय नवर्मं घसं च संध्यां तथा। रिक्तां पर्व निशां निरासनरणग्रामप्रयाणोचत- स्राताभ्यक्तकृता्षनै हि पुनः कार्या हितप्प्ठभिः।
segments.english_translation: Shaving and nail cutting are prescribed on auspicious days, avoiding the days of the thief (Chauradi), the days of the serpent (Patan), and the days of the sun (Ravi). Avoid the empty (Rikta) Tithi, the Parva (junction), night, and activities like sitting, war, village travel, etc. After bathing and anointing, these should be done again with beneficial intentions.

segments.sanskrit: कतुपाणिषीडस्तिेधमोक्षणे क्षुरकर्म च द्विजरपाज्ञया चरेत्‌। शववाहतीर्थगमसिधुमजनक्चुरमाचरे खड गर्भिणीपतिः।
segments.english_translation: Shaving is to be done during the time of marriage, release from captivity, and with the permission of a Brahmin. The husband of a pregnant woman should not perform activities like carrying a corpse, pilgrimage, or shaving.

segments.sanskrit: नृपाणां हितं ्षौरमे इमशरुकरम दिने पंचमे पंचमेऽखोदये बा। पडमिक्धिमैत्रोऽष्टकः पंचपित्यो-ऽब्दतोऽन्ष्यर्यमाक्षौरकृन्र्युमेति।
segments.english_translation: For kings, shaving is beneficial on the fifth day, during the rising of the Moon, and on auspicious days. Avoid the first, Maitra, Ashtaka, and Panchapada days, as they lead to death within a year.

segments.sanskrit: गणेशविष्णुवाग्रमाः प्रपूज्य पंचमान्दके तिथौ शिवादि ग्दिपयशरत्रिके रवाबुदर्‌। लघुश्रयोऽनिलोंखभादितीशतक्षमित्रभे चरोनसत्तनौ शिशोिपिग्रहः सतां दिने॥
segments.english_translation: After worshiping Ganesha, Vishnu, Saraswati, and Lakshmi, on the fifth day, if it is a Tithi like Ekadashi, Dvadashi, or Tritiya, and the Nakshatras are favorable like Hasta, Shravana, or Anuradha, and the day is ruled by the Moon, Mercury, or Jupiter, then the initiation of a child's education is auspicious.

segments.sanskrit: यृगात्कराच्छतेखयेऽधिपूलपूथिकातरये गुरुढयेऽकेजीववित्सितेऽि षदूशरत्निके। शिवारकदिण्डिके तिधो शववांसयमित्रभे पैः छभेरधीतिरुत्तमा त्रिकोणकेद्रगेः स्मृता॥
segments.english_translation: In the presence of the Nakshatras Ashwini, Hasta, and Shravana, and on a day ruled by Jupiter, Mercury, or Venus, the study of scriptures is considered excellent when the Moon is in a Kendra or Trikona position.

segments.sanskrit: किप्रधुवादिचरभूरखदुतरिपूर्वा रद्रेऽविद्धरुसितेदुदिने बतं सत्‌। दविज्ीषुरुद्ररविविक्परमिते तिथौ च छष्णादिमत्निसवकेऽपि न चापरह्॥
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras Ashwini, Pushya, Hasta, and others, and on a day ruled by the Moon, Mercury, or Jupiter, the Upanayana ceremony is auspicious. However, it should not be performed during the inauspicious Nakshatras like Bharani, Magha, and others.

segments.sanskrit: जीवाकेनदूधख्दधौ हरिशयनवहि- मस्किरे चो्रस्मे ्वाण्ययि वेदवरणाधिप इह मदे क्षौरभे नाऽदितौ च! शुकरैज्यकषरम्ने रविमदनतिथिं परोडा षष्ा्टमेहु नो जीवास्तातिचारेऽकैसितगुरुदिने कारौ बते स्यात्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: In the presence of Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury, the day is not suitable for shaving, sleeping, or any auspicious activity. Avoid the sixth lunar day (Shashthi) and the eighth lunar day (Ashtami) when the Sun is in Aries or Leo.

segments.sanskrit: प॑ चशराकाचक्रे, पाणिग्रहणे भवेद्धि बिधिरक्तः । शस्तः छभमित्रहृतः स्शराकाज इतरत्र ॥
segments.english_translation: In the Panchasharakachakra, during marriage ceremonies, the influence of the planets is considered. The presence of benefic planets is auspicious, while malefic planets should be avoided.

segments.sanskrit: कवीज्यचंदरलञ्मपा रिपौ खतो व्तेऽधमाः । व्ययेऽजनमागीवौ तथा तनौ सृतौ सुते खलाः ॥
segments.english_translation: When the Moon is in the 6th, 8th, or 12th house from the Ascendant, it is considered inauspicious. Similarly, when malefic planets occupy these houses, they bring negative results.

segments.sanskrit: वरतर्वेऽटषद्रिःफव्जिताः शोभनाः शुभाः । तरिषडये खलाः पणौ गोकरकक॑खो विधुस्तनौ ॥
segments.english_translation: When benefic planets occupy the 1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th houses, they bring auspicious results. Malefic planets in these houses, however, can cause harm.

segments.sanskrit: विप्राधीदौ भा्गवेन्यो कुजार्कौ राजन्यानामोषधीञ्लो विशां च । शुद्राणां ज्ञश्वां यजानां श्निः खा- * च्छाखेशाः स्युजीवञ्क्रारसोम्याः ॥
segments.english_translation: Jupiter and Venus are the lords for Brahmins, Mars and Sun for Kshatriyas, Mercury for Vaishyas, and Saturn for Shudras. The lords of the Vedas are Jupiter, Mars, and Mercury.

segments.sanskrit: जीवे वा शौ वा चकाराच्छाखेदो वशो वा विजिते युद्धे पराजिते वा नीचे स्वनीचराशिस्थिते सति चतेनालुष्टितेन सता वेदश्याखविधिना वेदो वेदाध्ययने ज्ञां शाख्ाध्ययने चिधिनितयनेमित्तिकश्रौतस्मातेकर्मानुष्टानाख्यस्तेषां समा- हारद्दरसेन रदितो चती स्यात्‌ ।
segments.english_translation: If Jupiter or Saturn is in a defeated or victorious position in battle, or in a debilitated state, or in the sign of its enemy, then the study of the Vedas and its branches should be avoided. The performance of rituals and ceremonies should be done with care.

segments.sanskrit: जन्मर्धमासलग्नादौ वते विद्याधिको वरती । आचगरभेऽपि विप्राणां क्षत्रादीनामनादिमे ॥
segments.english_translation: In the birth month, birth Nakshatra, or birth Lagna, the Upanayana ceremony should be performed for Brahmins, even if it is the second or third year. For Kshatriyas and others, it should not be done in the birth month.

segments.sanskrit: बड्कन्याजन्मराशेखिकोणायद्विसप्तगः । श्रेष्ठो गुरुः खपद््याये पूजयान्यत्र निंदितः ॥
segments.english_translation: When Jupiter is in the 9th, 5th, 11th, 2nd, or 7th from the birth sign of the boy or girl, it is considered auspicious. In other positions, it is not recommended for ceremonies.

segments.sanskrit: खोचे समे खमैत्े वा खांशे वर्गोत्तमे गुरुः । रिःफाष्टतुयंगोऽपीष्टो नीचारिखः श्भोऽप्यसन्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: If Jupiter is in its exalted, own, or friendly sign, or in a Vargottama position, it is considered auspicious even if it is in the 6th, 8th, or 12th house. However, if it is debilitated or in an enemy sign, it is not favorable.

segments.sanskrit: कृष्णे प्रदोपेऽनध्याये शनो निश्यपराहके । भराक्संध्यागनिते नेष्टो तरतब॑धो गलग्रहे ॥
segments.english_translation: The Upanayana ceremony should not be performed during the dark fortnight, at dusk, during prohibited times, on Saturdays, at night, during the afternoon, or when there is thunder in the morning.

segments.sanskrit: विद्यारंभो बतोदेशः क्षौरं चैव विरोषतः। गर्हे न कतैभ्यं यदीच्छेत्पुत्रजीवितम्॥
segments.english_translation: Initiation into learning, marriage, and shaving should not be performed during an eclipse. If one desires the longevity of their son, these should not be done during an eclipse.

segments.sanskrit: क्रूरो जडो भवेत्पापः पटुः पटकर्मकृदवटुः। यज्ञथभाक्तथा मूख रव्यांशे तनौ क्रमात्॥
segments.english_translation: A student born under the Sun's influence in the birth chart will be cruel, dull, sinful, skilled in deceitful acts, and a participant in sacrifices, in order.

segments.sanskrit: विच्यानिरतः श्भराक्षिलवे पापां शगते हि दरिद्रतरः। चंद्रे खरवे बहुटुःखयुतः कर्णादितिभे धनवान्खल्वे॥
segments.english_translation: If the Moon is in its own Navamsha, the person will be devoted to learning. If in a malefic Navamsha, they will be very poor. If in a benefic Navamsha, they will be wealthy.

segments.sanskrit: राजसेवी वैश्यघ्त्तिः शसति पाटकः। प्रजञोऽथवानम्लेच्छसेवी कदरे छयादिखेचः॥
segments.english_translation: A person with the Sun in a Kendra will serve the king, a person with the Moon will be a trader, and a person with Mars will be a thief.

segments.sanskrit: शक्रे जीवे तथा चंद्रे दर्यभोमागिसंयुते। निर्युणः करूरचेषटः खानिरधृणः सघयुते पडः॥
segments.english_translation: If Jupiter is with the Moon, the person will be virtuous. If Mars is with the Moon, they will have cruel actions. If Saturn is with the Moon, they will be poor.

segments.sanskrit: विधो सितांशगे सिते त्रिकोणगे तनो गुरो। समस्तवेदविद्रती यमांशगेऽतिनिधरेणः॥
segments.english_translation: If the Moon is in a benefic Navamsha, the person will know all the Vedas. If in a malefic Navamsha, they will be very poor.

segments.sanskrit: छचिश्क्रपौषतपसां दिगशिरुदरासंर्यसिततिथयः। भूतादित्रितयाष्टमि संक्रमणं च व्रतेष्वनध्यायाः॥
segments.english_translation: The days of Chaitra, Ashadha, Pausha, and Magha, along with the eighth day, Sankranti, and the three days starting from Bhuta, are unsuitable for rituals.

segments.sanskrit: अर्कतरकत्रितिथिषु प्रदोषः स्यात्तदग्रिमेः। रात्यथेसाथप्रहरयाममष्यथितैः कमात्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: In the tithis of Ark, Taraka, and Krittika, Pradosha occurs in the subsequent ones. It is determined by the night, the middle of the night, and the time of the day.

segments.sanskrit: वेदक्रमाच्छरिशिवाहिकरत्रिमूल-पूर्वासु पौष्णकरमेत्रखरगादितीज्ये। धरोवेषु, चाधिवसुपुष्यकरोत्तरेश- कर्णे मृगांयरघुमेत्रभनादितौ सत्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: According to the Vedic order, in the Nakshatras of Shravishtha, Shatabhisha, Purva Bhadrapada, and others, the study of Rigveda is auspicious. In Revati, Hasta, Anuradha, and others, the study of Yajurveda is recommended. In Ashwini, Dhanishta, Pushya, Hasta, and others, the study of Samaveda is advised. In Krithika, Revati, Pushya, Ashwini, Hasta, and others, the study of Atharvaveda is suitable.

segments.sanskrit: नांदीश्राद्धोत्तरं मातः पुष्पे रमां तरेऽसति। शंस्या चौलं वतं पाणिग्रहः कारयोऽन्यथा न सत्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: After the Nandi Shraddha, if the mother is in her menstrual period, or if there is a lunar eclipse, then the rituals like Chudakarana, Upanayana, and marriage should not be performed. Otherwise, they are auspicious.

segments.sanskrit: विचैत्रवतमासादौ बिभौमात्ते विभूमिजे। दरिकार्वधनं शस्तं सपाणां प्रागिवाहतः ॥
segments.english_translation: In the months excluding Chaitra, on days without Tuesday, and in the absence of Mars, the piercing of the ears for Kshatriyas is auspicious before marriage.

segments.sanskrit: केशातं षोडशे बे चोलोक्तदिवसे श्भम्‌। अ्तोक्तदिवसादौ हि समावर्वनमिष्यते ॥
segments.english_translation: The ceremony of Keshanta (first shaving of the head) is performed in the sixteenth year on the day prescribed for Chudakarana. If not done on the prescribed day, it should be done with Samavartana.

segments.sanskrit: विषमे परिवर्षे भवेद्दुःखं चैव क्षतिप्रदं भवेत्।
segments.english_translation: In an odd year, there will be sorrow and it will cause harm.

segments.sanskrit: भार्या त्रिवर्गकरणं शरीरयुक्ता लीलं शुभं भवति रुग्णवशेन तथाः।
segments.english_translation: A wife, being the means of performing the threefold duties (Dharma, Artha, Kama), brings auspiciousness according to the influence of the planets.

segments.sanskrit: आदौ संपूज्य रत्नादिभिरथ गणकं वेदयेत्स्वस्थचित्तं कन्योद्वाहं दिगीशानरविधिखे प्रारम्भाय दीप्तुः।
segments.english_translation: First, after worshipping with gems and other offerings, one should inform the astrologer with a clear mind about the marriage of the girl, following the directions of the guardians of the directions.

segments.sanskrit: विषमभांशगतौ शशिमन्दौ तदुगृदं बिना यदि पश्यतः।
segments.english_translation: When the Moon and Venus are in odd degrees, without any malefic aspect, it is auspicious for the acquisition of a bride.

segments.sanskrit: षष्ठाष्टमः प्रश्नलम्नाचदीं दुष्टे क्रूरः सप्तमे वा कुजः खलु।
segments.english_translation: If Mars is in the sixth or eighth house from the ascendant at the time of the question, or if a malefic is in the seventh, the girl will become a widow within eight years.

segments.sanskrit: प्रश्नतनोर्यदि पापनभोगः पञ्चमगो रिपुदृष्टशरीरः।
segments.english_translation: If a malefic occupies the fifth house from the ascendant at the time of the question, and is aspected by an enemy, the girl will be barren or have a dead child.

segments.sanskrit: यदि भवति सितातिरिक्तपक्षे तनुगृहतः समराशिगः शशांकः।
segments.english_translation: If the Moon is in an enemy sign during the dark fortnight, and is aspected by malefics from the sixth or eighth house, it causes the destruction of marriage.

segments.sanskrit: जन्मोत्थं च विलोक्य बालविधवायोगं विधाय्य बतं सावित्या उत पैप्पलं हि सुतया दथादिमां बा रहः।
segments.english_translation: After examining the birth chart for the presence of a child widowhood yoga, perform the prescribed rituals with Savitri or Pippala for the longevity of the husband.

segments.sanskrit: अर्दसौमाग्ये विचय इत्युक्तम्। तत्र-श्यो यो भावः स्वामिच्युतो वा सौभ्बर्वा स्यात्तस्य तस्यासि वृद्धिः। पापरेव तस्य भावस्य हानिर्निरदे्टव्या शच्छतां जन्मतो वा॥
segments.english_translation: In the Ardra and Saumya Nakshatras, it is said that if a planet is in its own sign or exalted, there is an increase in its effects. However, if it is in a malefic sign, there is a decrease in its effects, which should be noted from birth.

segments.sanskrit: सावितरीब्रतादीनि भक्तया कुर्वति याः स्त्रियः। सौभाग्यं च सुहृत्त्वं च भवेत्तासां सुसंततिः॥
segments.english_translation: Women who perform the Savitri Vrata and similar rituals with devotion attain prosperity, friendship, and good progeny.

segments.sanskrit: सुदिने शुभनक्षत्रे चन्द्रतारावलान्विते। अवैधव्यकरे योगे रभ्ने अहबलान्विते॥
segments.english_translation: On an auspicious day, under a favorable Nakshatra, with the Moon and stars aligned, and in a Yoga that prevents widowhood, the ritual should be performed.

segments.sanskrit: कन्याप्रदः पूज्यः प्रकृतिस्थः परः परः।
segments.english_translation: The giver of the bride is revered, and he should be in a natural and composed state.

segments.sanskrit: श्रद्धालक्षणे यादशापत्ययुक्ते। शेच्छया कामिनी तत्र चेदात्रजेत्‌।
segments.english_translation: In the presence of faith and auspicious signs, if a woman desires, she may conceive a child.

segments.sanskrit: शंखभेरीविपचीसै्मगलं जायते वैपरीरयं तदा लक्षयेत्‌।
segments.english_translation: When the sounds of conch, drum, and lute are heard, it indicates auspiciousness; otherwise, it suggests inauspiciousness.

segments.sanskrit: विश्वखातीविष्णवपूर्वात्यमेत्‌। वखामरेयेन करपीडोचितक्र्षैः।
segments.english_translation: In the presence of the Nakshatras Vishakha, Anuradha, and Purvashada, with offerings of fruits and flowers, the bride should be adorned and satisfied.

segments.sanskrit: धरणिदेवोऽथवा कन्यकासोदरः शुभदिने गीतवाद्यादिभिः संयुतः। वरत वस्रयज्ञोपवीतादिना धुवयुतैवदिपूरवत्रयेराचरेत्‌॥
segments.english_translation: The bride's brother or a Brahmin priest should arrange the marriage on an auspicious day with music and songs. The groom should be adorned with clothes, sacred thread, and other auspicious items, and the ceremony should be conducted with the appropriate rituals.

segments.sanskrit: गरुदद्धिवशेन कन्यकानां समवर्ेषु षडब्दकोपरिष्टात्‌। रविशद्धिवशाच्छुभो वराणायुमयोश्चद्रविदयद्धितो विवाहः॥
segments.english_translation: For girls, marriage is auspicious after the age of six years, based on the Guru's position. For boys, marriage is auspicious based on the Sun's position, and for both, it is auspicious when the Moon and Sun are in favorable positions.

segments.sanskrit: मिधुनडमस्गारिग्षाजगे मिथुनगेऽपि रषौ त्रिरवे शुचेः। अलिगृगाजगते करषीडनं मवति कातिकपोषमपुष्वपि॥
segments.english_translation: When the Sun is in Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius, or Pisces, marriage is auspicious. Even when the Sun is in Gemini, marriage is auspicious during the bright fortnight of Ashadha, Kartika, and Pausha months.

segments.sanskrit: आचगभेसुतकन्ययोदयोर्जन्ममासमतिथो करग्रहः। नोचितोऽथ बिबुधेः प्रशखते चेद्ितीयजचुषोः सुतप्रदः॥
segments.english_translation: Marriage should not be conducted in the birth month or birth tithi of the bride or groom. However, if it is conducted on the second or fourth tithi, it is considered auspicious and conducive to progeny.

segments.sanskrit: उयेषठदेदं मध्यमं संप्रदं त्रिज्ेठं चे्नेव युक्तं कदापि। ऊेचित्घयं वद्धिं प्रोह चाहूर्नवान्योन्यं व्यष्टयोः खाद्िवाहः॥
segments.english_translation: Marriage should not be conducted when both the bride and groom are born under the Jyeshtha Nakshatra, or during the Jyeshtha month. If one is under Jyeshtha, it is considered moderate, but if both are, it is not recommended.

segments.sanskrit: न्येष्टायाः कन्यकायाश्च ज्येष्ठपुत्रस्य वै मिथः। विवाहो नैव कर्तव्यो यदि स्यान्निधने तयोः॥
segments.english_translation: The marriage of a girl born under the Jyeshtha Nakshatra with a boy born under the same Nakshatra should not be performed if either of them is deceased.

segments.sanskrit: श्येष्टे ज्येष्ठ कुर्वीत भास्करे चानरस्थिते। नोत्सवादीनि कार्याणि दुष्टदिनानि च वर्जयेत्‌॥
segments.english_translation: During the Jyeshtha month, when the Sun is in the Jyeshtha Nakshatra, one should not perform auspicious activities or celebrate festivals on inauspicious days.

segments.sanskrit: दशषाहं चैव गर्भस्त्रिदशाहं च्हस्पतिः। भक्ष्यमोग्र्याभिनम्य यावन्सुनिः राहु परादारः॥
segments.english_translation: The fetus is ten days old, and the husband is thirteen days old. Until the Sun is in the Rahu's path, one should not consume food or perform auspicious activities.

segments.sanskrit: कृत्तिकास्थं रिं लक्त्वा ज्ये जयेष्ठस्य कारयेत्‌। उत्सवादीनि कार्याणि दिनानि दा वर्जयेत्‌॥
segments.english_translation: When the Moon is in the Krittika Nakshatra, one should perform the marriage of a person born under the Jyeshtha Nakshatra. However, festivals and auspicious activities should be avoided on certain days.

segments.sanskrit: मार्गशीर्षे तथा ज्येष्ठे विवाहं चौरमेव च। ज्येष्ठपुत्रहितश्च न क्वो ब्रते तथा॥
segments.english_translation: In the months of Margashirsha and Jyeshtha, marriages and other auspicious activities should be avoided, especially for those born under the Jyeshtha Nakshatra.

segments.sanskrit: माघशीर्षे तथा ज्येष्ठ कषोरं परिणय तम्‌। आभ्युत्तरदुहित्रोश्च यथतः परिवर्जयेत्‌॥
segments.english_translation: In the months of Magha and Jyeshtha, one should avoid the marriage of a young boy, and similarly, the marriage of a daughter should be postponed.

segments.sanskrit: सुतपरिणयात्पण्मासां तः सुताकरषीडने। न च निजङ्कले तद्वद्वा मंडनादपि सडनम्‌॥
segments.english_translation: After the marriage of a son, for six months, the marriage of a daughter should not be performed, nor should any other auspicious activities like Upanayana be conducted.

segments.sanskrit: न च सहजयोर्देये त्रो; सहोद्रकन्यके। न सहजसतोद्राःऽब्दार्धे शुभे न पित्क्रिया॥
segments.english_translation: The marriage of siblings or cousins should not be performed within six months of each other, nor should any auspicious activities be conducted for them.

segments.sanskrit: एकस्मिन्मण्डपे न कार्यमेव। किंतु गृहभेदादाचार्यभेदाद्वा कार्यम्। यथा वसिष्ठः—द्विश्रृङ्गे भवने द्वैकगृहेऽपि नेष्टं ततः पश्चाज्जनवभिर्दिनैश्च। भावदयकं शोभनसुस्सुकस्य द्वारेऽथ वाचार्यविभेदतोऽपि॥
segments.english_translation: In a single pavilion, no ceremony should be performed. However, it may be done due to differences in house or teacher. As Vasistha says—In a two-horned house or even in a single house, it is not desired, but later with the consent of the people and days. The auspicious ceremony of the beautiful and eager one may be done at the door or due to differences in teacher.

segments.sanskrit: वध्वा वरस्यापि कुले त्रिपुरुषे नाशं प्राप्य निश्चयोत्तरम्। मासोत्तरं तत्र विवाह इष्यते शांख्यथवा दत्तकनिरगमेऽपि॥
