segments.english_translation: If after the betrothal, in the family of the bride or groom, there is a death within three generations, then the marriage is desired after a month, or even if the adopted one departs.

segments.sanskrit: चूडा व्रतं चापि विवाहो नताचूडा च नेष्टा पुरुषत्रयांतरे। वधूप्रवेशाच सुताविनिगमः षण्मासतो बान्धविमेदतः शुभः॥
segments.english_translation: The Chudakarana, Upanayana, and marriage are not desired within three generations. The entry of the bride and the naming of the child are auspicious after six months from the separation of relatives.

segments.sanskrit: अवश्रूविनाशं विधत्तः कन्यासुतौ निरतिजौ श्वश्चरं हतौ। व्यष्टाभजातं तनया खधवाग्रजं च शक्राभिजा भवति देवरनाशकत्री॥
segments.english_translation: The bride and son born under Ashlesha destroy the mother-in-law. The daughter born under Jyeshtha destroys the elder brother-in-law, and the one born under Vishakha destroys the younger brother-in-law.

segments.sanskrit: द्विशाचपादत्रयजा कन्या देवरतौरूयदा। मूलांतयपादसापायपादजो तौ तयोः भौ॥
segments.english_translation: A girl born in the first three quarters of Vishakha is harmful to the brother-in-law. Those born in the last quarter of Mula are beneficial to the couple.

segments.sanskrit: वर्णो वयं तथा तारा योनिश ग्रहमैत्रकम्। गण्मेत्र भद्दं च नाडी चेते गुणाधिकाः॥
segments.english_translation: The qualities of Varna, Vashya, Tara, Yoni, Graha Maitri, Gana, Bhakuta, and Nadi are considered superior.

segments.sanskrit: द्विजा क्षत्रियाः ततो नृपा विक्लोऽन्धिजाः। वरस वर्णतोऽधिका वधूनं शते बुधैः॥
segments.english_translation: Brahmins are followed by Kshatriyas, then Vaishyas, and lastly Shudras. The groom should be of a higher Varna than the bride, as advised by the wise.

segments.sanskrit: हित्वा सगेन्द्रं नरराशिवर्याः स्वे तथेषां जलजास्तु भक्ष्याः। सर्वेऽपि सिंहस्य वरो विनारिं ज्ञेयं नराणां व्यवहारतोऽन्यत्॥
segments.english_translation: Excluding Leo, the human signs are superior. Among them, the water signs are consumable. All are superior to Leo, except for Aries, known through human interaction.

segments.sanskrit: कन्यरकषादरमं यावत्कन्याभ वरभादपि। गणयेन्नवहृच्छेषे ब्रीष्वद्रिभमसत्स्मृतम्॥
segments.english_translation: From the birth star of the bride to the groom's star, count. If the remainder is three, five, or seven when divided by nine, it is considered inauspicious.

segments.sanskrit: ददामैकोनर्विशातारयोस्तु निषेधो दुष्टभक्ते जेयः। सद्धकृटे ठु दोषाभाव इत्यथैः॥
segments.english_translation: The prohibition of marriage is for those with a difference of less than twenty-one years; in the case of a good match, there is no defect.

segments.sanskrit: अधिन्व॑बुपयोर्दयो निगदितः खाल्यर्कयोः कासरः। सिंहो वखजपाद्धयोः सयुदितो याम्यांत्ययोः जरः। मेषो देवपुरोहितानलभयोः कणौबुनोर्वानरः। खद्रैश्वाभिजितोस्तयथैव नङुलशांद्राजयोन्योरदिः॥
segments.english_translation: The pairs of Nakshatras are described: Ashwini and Bharani are friends, Krittika and Rohini are enemies. Leo is the sign for Dhanishta and Purvabhadra, and the sign of Aries is for Pushya and Ashlesha. The monkey is for Shravana and Purvashada, and the mongoose is for Uttara Ashada and Abhijit.

segments.sanskrit: जयेष्ठमेत्रमयोः इग उदितो मूला््रयोः श्वा तथा। माजीरोऽदितिसार्पयोरथ मधायोन्योस्तथेवो दुरः। व्याघो द्वीशभवित्रयोरपि च गोरायैम्णवुश्यक्षयो-योनिः पादगयोः परस्परमदमरं भयोन्योभेवेत्॥
segments.english_translation: For Jyeshtha and Mula, the dog is indicated, and for Magha and Ashlesha, the cat. The mongoose is for Revati and Uttara Bhadrapada, and the tiger is for Vishakha and Chitra. The cow is for Hasta and Swati, and the elephant is for Anuradha and Jyeshtha.

segments.sanskrit: मित्राणि युमणेः डजेउयशशिनः श्॒क्राकैजौ वैरिणौ। सौम्यथास्य समो विधोडधरवी मित्रे न चाय द्विषन्।
segments.english_translation: The friends of the Sun are Mars, Jupiter, and the Moon; Venus and Saturn are enemies. Mercury is neutral, and the Sun is not an enemy.

segments.sanskrit: मित्रे चाख रिपुः ची गुरुशनिकष्माजाः समा भीष्पते-मित्राण्यकवुजेदयो बुधसिती शत्रू समः स्यजः।
segments.english_translation: For the Moon, Mercury and Jupiter are friends, while Saturn and Mars are enemies. Venus is neutral.

segments.sanskrit: गक्षोनरामरगणाः क्रमतो मघादि-विद्रमूखवरुणानरतक्षराधाः। पू्त्तरात्रयविधातयमेशटभानि मैतरादिरतीदुहरिपोष्णमरुछघूनि॥
segments.english_translation: The groups of Nakshatras are sequentially: Magha, Purvaphalguni, and Uttara Phalguni for Rakshasa; Ashwini, Bharani, and Krittika for Manushya; and Anuradha, Jyeshtha, and Mula for Deva.

segments.sanskrit: निजनिजगणमध्ये प्रीतिरत्युत्तमा खा-दमरमयुजयोः सा मध्यमा संप्रदिशटा। असुरमडुजयोधन्पतयुरेव प्रदिशो दजुजविबुधयोः खाद्ैरमेकांततोऽ्॥
segments.english_translation: Within their own groups, the affection is supreme; between Deva and Manushya, it is moderate; between Rakshasa and Manushya, it is minimal.

segments.sanskrit: स्युः षट्काष्टके ज्ेयोऽपत्यहानिर्मवात्मजे। दिद्धादशे निर्धनस्व दयोरन्यत्र सौख्यञरत्॥
segments.english_translation: In the Shashtashtaka (6-8) relationship, there is loss of progeny; in the Dwadashashtaka (12-6), there is poverty; elsewhere, there is happiness.

segments.sanskrit: ्रोक्ते द्टमकरटके परिणयस्त्वैकाधिषले श्च॒मो-ऽधो राशीश्वरसोददेऽपि गदितो नाच्चृ्ष्द्िरयदि। अन्यधऽशपयोर्भरित्वससिते नाञ्यकष्॒द्धौ तथा ताराशचुद्धिवरेन राशिवशताभावे निरुक्तो बुधैः॥
segments.english_translation: In the case of a Shashtashtaka, if there is a common lordship, marriage is auspicious; otherwise, it is not. If there is a common lordship in the Navamsha, it is also auspicious.

segments.sanskrit: मित्रषडष्टकं कीटमेषयोः शजूकयोः। करिचापभयोर्मनसिंहयोः शरैगयुम्मयोः॥
segments.english_translation: The sixfold friendship (Mitra Shad Ashtaka) is between Aries and Scorpio, Taurus and Libra, Gemini and Sagittarius, Cancer and Capricorn, Leo and Aquarius, Virgo and Pisces.

segments.sanskrit: मीनालिभ्यां युते कीटे ऊभे मिथुनसंयुते। मकरे कन्यकायुक्ते न कुर्याज्नवपंचमे॥
segments.english_translation: When Pisces and Virgo are together, Scorpio and Taurus are together, Gemini and Sagittarius are together, Capricorn and Cancer are together, one should not perform activities in the ninth and fifth houses.

segments.sanskrit: वरवध्वोर्मादृषिचोर्जीवतोस्तद्विनाशकृत्। त्रिकोणे मीनकीटाद्यं न स्यादन्यत्र दोषदम्॥
segments.english_translation: For the bride and groom, if Mars and Jupiter are in the same sign, it causes destruction. If Pisces and Scorpio are in a trine, it is not considered inauspicious elsewhere.

segments.sanskrit: राशिनाथे विरुद्धेऽपि सवकार्यं दंपत्योः सुखमिच्छता॥
segments.english_translation: Even if the lords of the signs are opposed, all actions should be performed for the happiness of the couple.

segments.sanskrit: मित्राणि दयुमणेः
segments.english_translation: The friends of the luminaries (Sun and Moon).

segments.sanskrit: मैत्र्यां राशिखामिनोरंशनाथदशस्यापि खात्रणानां न दोषः। सेतारित्वं नाशयेत्सद्धकूटं खेटग्रीतिश्वापि दुष्टं भकूटम्॥
segments.english_translation: In the presence of friendly signs, even if there is a defect in the Nakshatra or the lord of the sign, there is no fault. The friendship of planets can nullify the defects of Sadhakoota and Bhakoota.

segments.sanskrit: व्यष्टायम्योकनीराधिषभयुगयुगं दासं चकनाडी। पुष्येदुत्वाष्रूमितरां तकवसुजलभं योनिवुश्ये च मध्या॥
segments.english_translation: The Nakshatras Jyeshtha, Bharani, Uttara Phalguni, Hasta, and others form the first Nadi. Pushya, Uttara Ashadha, and others form the middle Nadi. Swati, Anuradha, and others form the last Nadi.

segments.sanskrit: अकचटतपयदावगाः सगेशमाजरसिहशयनाम्। सर्पीचुखृगावीनां निजं च मचैरिणाम्॥
segments.english_translation: The groups of letters 'a', 'ka', 'cha', 'ta', 'pa', 'ya', 'da', 'va', and 'ga' represent Garuda, Lion, and others. The enmity between these groups is significant.

segments.sanskrit: राश्यैकये चेद्धिन्नमृशषं दयोः खान्नक्तरैक्ये रारियुग्मं तथेव। नाडीदोपो नो गणानां च दोषो नकत्रैकये पादभेदे श्चम खात्॥
segments.english_translation: If there is unity in the signs but difference in Nakshatras, or if there is unity in Nakshatras but difference in signs, then there is no Nadi or Gana Dosha. Even if there is a difference in the Nakshatra quarters, it is auspicious.

segments.sanskrit: एकक्षं चेकराशौ च विवाहेऽर्तवचुभः सुतः। संकोचे तु तदा कार्यो भिन्नः पादो यदा तयोः॥
segments.english_translation: If both are in the same sign, the child born will be virtuous. In a conjunction, the division should be made when there is a difference in their parts.

segments.sanskrit: रोदिण्यारदामधेद्रामी तिष्यश्नवणपौष्णभम्। उत्तरा प्रोष्टपाच्चैव नक्षत्रेऽपि शोभनाः॥
segments.english_translation: Rohini, Ardra, Magha, Tishya, Shravana, and Uttara Proshthapada are auspicious Nakshatras.

segments.sanskrit: विशाखिकप्रश्रवणभ्रजेशतिष्यांलयतत्पूर्वमघाः प्रशस्ताः। खीषुंसतारेक्यपरि्रहे तु रोषा विवर्ज्या इति संगिरते॥
segments.english_translation: Vishakha, Shravana, Bharani, Jyeshtha, Tishya, and Purva Magha are praised. In the absence of these, anger should be avoided.

segments.sanskrit: अज्ञातजन्मनां दरुणं नाममे परिकल्पना। तेनैव चितयेत्सर्वं राशिकटादि जन्मवत्॥
segments.english_translation: For those whose birth is unknown, a name should be devised. With that, everything should be considered as if the birth details are known.

segments.sanskrit: पञ्चांगदोषरहितो दोषः स्वार्थकीर्तितः। उद्यास्तञचद्धिहीनो द्वितीयः सूर्य संक्रमः॥
segments.english_translation: A day free from Panchanga defects is praised. The second defect is the absence of sunrise and sunset.

segments.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठापौष्णभसापभांत्यषटिकायुगम च मूलाधिनीपिव्यादौ घटिका निगदितं तद्धख गंडांतक्म्।
segments.english_translation: The conjunction of Jyestha, Pushya, and Ashlesha with Mula and Ashwini is known as Gandanta.

segments.sanskrit: लग्नात्पापातरज्वनुजु व्ययार्थखी यदा तदा। कर्तरी नाम सा ज्ञेया सृत्युदारसियशोकदा ॥
segments.english_translation: When malefic planets occupy the 2nd and 12th houses from the Ascendant, it is known as Kartari Dosha, which brings sorrow and loss of wealth.

segments.sanskrit: चंद्रे रयादिसंयुक्ते दारितं मरणं श्भम्‌। सौख्यं सापत्यं वैराग्यं पापद्रययुते सृतिः ॥
segments.english_translation: When the Moon is conjoined with the Sun, it leads to separation; with Mars, it causes death; with benefics, it brings happiness and progeny; with malefics, it leads to renunciation.

segments.sanskrit: जन्मरम्नभयो्ूतयुराशो नेष्टः करग्रहः। एकाधिपये रा्चीरे भत्रे वा नैव दोषकृत्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: In the 8th house from the Ascendant or Moon, malefic planets are undesirable. However, if the Ascendant and Moon are in mutual trines or have the same lord, there is no defect.

segments.sanskrit: जन्मेशा अष्टमरेन्दवौ मिथो मित्रे व्यवस्थितौ। जन्मराश्यष्टमस्थदोषो नश्यति भावतः॥
segments.english_translation: If the lord of the birth and the eighth lord are mutually friendly, the defect of the eighth house from the birth sign is nullified.

segments.sanskrit: मीनोर्कर्कारिमरगश्चियोऽष्टमं स्यं यदा नाटमगेहदोषः। अन्योन्यमित्रत्वदेन सा वधू भवेत्सुतायुः सुखभागिनी॥
segments.english_translation: When Pisces, Cancer, Aries, and Scorpio are in the eighth house, and if they are mutually friendly, the bride will have children and happiness.

segments.sanskrit: गतिभवनांशो यदि च विग्नं तदधिपतिरवा न शुभकरः। व्ययभवनं वा भवति तदंशस्तदधिपतिवौ करहकरः स्यात्॥
segments.english_translation: If the lord of the eighth house is afflicted, it is not auspicious. If the twelfth house or its lord is afflicted, it causes harm.

segments.sanskrit: खरामतो ३० ऽद्यादितिवहिपित्यभे खवेदतः ४० के रदत ३२ अ सार्पे। खचाणतो ५० श्वे रतितो १८ ऽयमांबुपे कृते २० भगत्वा्रूमविश्चजीवभे॥
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras Revati, Punarvasu, Kritika, and Magha, starting from Khara, 30 Ghatikas are considered inauspicious. In Rohini, 40 Ghatikas, in Ardra, 32, and in Ashlesha, 50 Ghatikas are inauspicious.

segments.sanskrit: मनो १४ दिदैवानिरसौम्यशाक्रमे ङुपक्षतः २१ शैवकरेऽष्टितो १६ऽजमे। युगाधितो २४ बुभ्यमतोययाम्यभे खचंद्रतो १० मित्रभवासवशुतौ॥
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras Mula, 14 Ghatikas are inauspicious; in Shravana, 21; in Shatabhisha, 16; and in Ashwini, 24. In Chitra, 10 Ghatikas are inauspicious.

segments.sanskrit: मूकेऽङ्गबाणा ५६ द्विषनाडिकाः कृता वर्ज्याः श्युमेऽथो विषनाडिका ध्रुवाः। निघ्ना भोगेन खतकं ६० भाजिताः स्फुटा मवेयुर्विषनाडिकास्तथा॥
segments.english_translation: In Mula, 56 Ghatikas are inauspicious. These should be avoided. The inauspicious Ghatikas are calculated by dividing the Nakshatra duration by 60.

segments.sanskrit: गिरिशजगमित्राः पितृवसुविशेऽभिजिदथ च विधाता इन्द्रानलो च। निक्रीतिरुदकनाथोऽप्ययमाथो मगः स्थुः क्रमश इह मुहूर्त वासरे बाण्चद्राः॥
segments.english_translation: The deities for the day are Shiva, Serpent, Mitra, Pitru, Vasu, Vishnu, Abhijit, Brahma, Indra, and Agni. These are the deities for the Muhurta on the day.

segments.sanskrit: शिवोऽजपादादष्टौ स्यर्भञ्ञा अदितिजीवकौ। विष्वकतवष्टमरूतो शुत निरि कीतिताः॥
segments.english_translation: The deities for the night are Shiva, Ajapada, Bhaga, Aditya, Jiva, Vishvakarma, Vashatkara, and Maruta. These are the deities for the night Muhurta.

segments.sanskrit: रवावर्यमा ह्रक्षश्च सोमे इजे वद्िपित्ये बुधे चाभिभित्सखात्। गुरौ तोयर्ष भृगौ बाह्मपिव्ये शनावीशसारपौ हूत निषिद्धाः॥
segments.english_translation: On Sunday, Aryama is inauspicious; on Monday, Brahma Rakshasa; on Tuesday, Vidhata; on Wednesday, Abhibhitsa; on Thursday, Toyarsha; on Friday, Brahma; and on Saturday, Ishasara are inauspicious.

segments.sanskrit: निर्वैधेरिति॥ खगरिरोदस्तमूलानुराधामवारोहिणीरेवव्युत्तराफल्गुन्युत्तराषाढोत्तराभाद्रपदास्वातीनक्षत्रः निरवेधैः वेधाख्यदोषरहितैः विवाहः शुभः।
segments.english_translation: Marriage is auspicious without the defect of Vedha in the Nakshatras Krittika, Rohini, Mrigashira, Anuradha, Uttara Phalguni, Uttara Ashadha, Uttara Bhadrapada, and Swati.

segments.sanskrit: बेधोऽन्योन्यमसौ विरिन्यभिनितोर्याम्याजुराधक्षयो-विशद्ोरईरिषपित्ययो्दृतो हसतोत्तरामाद्रयोः। खातीवारुणयोभेवेमिर्फतिभादित्योस्तथोपां त्ययोः खेटे तत्र गते तुरीयचरणाचोर्वा तृतीयद्वयोः॥
segments.english_translation: The mutual Vedha occurs between Rohini and Abhijit, Yama and Anuradha, Vishakha and Purva Ashadha, Hasta and Uttara Ashadha, Swati and Varuna, and Purva Bhadrapada and Uttara Bhadrapada. If a planet is in the fourth quarter, it affects the first quarter of the next Nakshatra.

segments.sanskrit: शेचद्ललाकाचकरे पाणिग्रहणे भवेधविधिरक्तः। शस्तः छभमित्रकृतः सतशलाकाज इतरत्र॥
segments.english_translation: In the Shakat Chakra, during the marriage ceremony, the presence of Vedha is considered inauspicious. It is auspicious when performed with the influence of friendly planets, otherwise not.

segments.sanskrit: शाक्रेञये श॒तमानिकते जररिषे पोष्णायैम्ै बसु- दीश वैश्वसुधांशुमे दयभगे सार्पालुराथे तथा।
segments.english_translation: In the Shakat Chakra, the Nakshatras are affected by Vedha when they are in mutual opposition, such as in Jyeshtha and Purvashadha, and similarly in other cases.

segments.sanskrit: ऋक्षाणि करूरविद्धानि कूरणुक्तादिकानि च। अक्त्वा चेद्रेण शुक्तानि छभादोणि प्रचक्षते॥
segments.english_translation: Nakshatras afflicted by cruel planets and those mentioned in the Kurma Chakra should be avoided. If they are not afflicted by the Moon, they are considered auspicious.

segments.sanskrit: राूरंुसिताः ख भं सप्गोजातिदररमितं दि। संर््यतेऽकशनीज्यभैमाः चयीष्टतकौभिमितं पुरस्तात्‌॥
segments.english_translation: The planets Rahu, Sun, and others, when positioned in certain Nakshatras, cause afflictions. These should be avoided during auspicious activities.

segments.sanskrit: हर्षणवैधतिसाध्यव्यतिपातकरगडशूलयोगानाम्‌। अंते यज्नकषत्रं पातेन निपातितं तत्खात्‌॥
segments.english_translation: At the end of Harshana, Vaidhriti, Sadhya, Vyatipata, Karana, and Shoola Yogas, the Nakshatra is afflicted by Pata and should be avoided.

segments.sanskrit: प॑चाखाजौ गोमरगौ तौखिंमौ कन्यामीनौ ककर्यटी चापुगमे। तत्रान्योन्यं चंद्रभान्वोनिरुक्तं कोतेः साम्यं नो शुभं मंगलेषु॥
segments.english_translation: When the Sun and Moon are in the same sign or in opposite signs such as Leo and Aquarius, Virgo and Pisces, it is considered inauspicious for auspicious activities.

segments.sanskrit: व्याघातगण्डव्यतीपातपूर्वशूलान्त्यव जे परिघातिंडे। एकागैलाख्यो मभिनित्समेतो दोषः शी चेद्धिमक्षगोऽकीत्॥
segments.english_translation: If the Moon is in a Nakshatra that is inauspicious due to Vyaghata, Ganda, Vyatipata, or Shoola, and if it is in an odd-numbered Nakshatra, then the defect known as 'Ekargala' arises.

segments.sanskrit: शराष्टदिक्शक्रनगातिधत्यसिथिशतिश प्रकृतेथ प॑च। उपग्रहाः यैमतोऽन्जताराः शुभा न देशे रुबाहिकानाम्॥
segments.english_translation: The Upagrahas, which are the shadow planets, are inauspicious when they are in the Nakshatras starting from Ashvini and ending with Revati, except in certain regions where they are considered auspicious.

segments.sanskrit: पातोपग्रदरत्तासु ने्टोऽधिः सेटपत्समः। वारल्धिभोऽ्छमित्तष्टः सेकः खादधैयामकः॥
segments.english_translation: In the presence of Pata, Upagraha, or Ratta, if the Sun is in an odd-numbered Nakshatra, it is inauspicious. The defect known as 'Khanda' arises when the day is divided into eight parts and the Sun is in the first part.

segments.sanskrit: शकरा्कदिण्वसुरसान्ध्यधिनः इलिका खेः। रात्रौ निरेकालतिथ्यंशा; शनौ चां योऽपि निंदिताः॥
segments.english_translation: The Kulika Dosha arises when the Sun is in specific parts of the day or night, varying by weekday, and is considered inauspicious.

segments.sanskrit: चापांलयगे मोघटगे पतंगे कर्काजगे स्रीमिथुनस्थिते च। सिंहारिगि नक्रधटे समाः स्युस्िथ्यो द्ितीयाप्रसुखा दग्धाः॥
segments.english_translation: The Tithis are considered 'burnt' or inauspicious when the Sun is in specific signs such as Sagittarius, Pisces, etc., and the Moon is in the second or other specific Tithis.

segments.sanskrit: लम्राचदरान्मदनभवनगे खेटे न स्यादिह परिणयनम्। किंवा बाणाश्चगमितलवगे जामित्र खादश्ुभकरमिदम्॥
segments.english_translation: Marriage should not be performed when the planet is in the seventh house from the Moon. Alternatively, if the Moon is in a specific Navamsha, it is considered inauspicious.

segments.sanskrit: कागलोपः ््बुदयास्तदोषाः एकागलोपग्रहपातलनत्ताजामित्रकतयुदयास्तदोषाः। नश्यंति चंदराकंबलोपयने रने यथाकौभ्युदये त॒ दीपा॥
segments.english_translation: Defects such as Ekargala, Upagraha, Pata, and others are nullified when the Moon is in a strong position, similar to how darkness is dispelled by the rising of the Sun.

segments.sanskrit: कैसुतिकन्यायमपि सूचयति दोषापदम्‌। वसिष्ठुवाक्यस्य मन्वादिवाक्यवस्प्रामाण्यान्न संमल्यतर पश्चा॥
segments.english_translation: The defect is indicated even in the case of the Kaishika Nyaya. The authority of Vasistha's words is not diminished by the words of Manu and others.

segments.sanskrit: उपग्रहक्षं इरुबाहिकेषु क्िगर्वगेषु च पातितं ममू। सौरा्रशार्वेषु च छत्तितं भं त्यजेत विद्धं फिर सर्वेशे॥
segments.english_translation: In the regions of Upagraha, Irubahi, and Kigravaga, the fallen is considered. In the regions of Saurashtra and Sharva, the divided should be avoided in all.

segments.sanskrit: श्चा कष्यते रोषे खभूयुगां गानि दशेशतिथ्यः। एदबोकंदुमिता नखाशेद्धवंति चेते दशयोगसंज्ञाः॥
segments.english_translation: The ten Yogas are known as the tenfold anger, the tenfold lunar days, and the tenfold Nakshatras.

segments.sanskrit: वाताभ्राभिमहीपचोरमरणं रुवजरवादाः क्षति-यगां के दिति समे मनुयुतेऽथोजे तु सेकेऽथिते। मं दास्रादथ संमितास्तु मडुभी रेखाः करमात्संलिखि-देधोऽसिन्प्रह्चद्रयोम भदः खादेकरेखास्थयोः॥
segments.english_translation: In the even numbers, the Yogas are associated with wind, clouds, earth, thieves, and death. In the odd numbers, they are associated with the moon and the sun.

segments.sanskrit: ठग्रनाढ्या याततिथ्योऽकतष्टाः शेषे नागब्न्धितर्कैदुसंस्ये। रोगो बद्ी राजचरौ च ख्युर्वाणायं दाक्षिणायप्रतिद्धः
segments.english_translation: The Banas are associated with the lunar days starting from the first day of the dark fortnight. In the remaining numbers, they are associated with disease, bondage, and theft.

segments.sanskrit: रसगुणशशिनागाश्ष्याद्वसंकरां तियातां-शकमिति रथतषटकैथेदा पच दोषाः।
segments.english_translation: The Banas are associated with taste, quality, moon, and snake. The defects are counted in the sixteenth, eighth, and fourth.

segments.sanskrit: रत्रौ चोररजै दिबाऽधिंपती व्यज्य सदा सं्ययो-मृत्युशाथ शनो दषो विदि मृति्मेमिऽश्रिचोरो रौ। रोगोऽय त्रतेदगोपदुपसेवायानपाणिग्रहे वर््याथ क्रमतो बुधं रुगनर््मापाल्चारा मृतिः॥
segments.english_translation: At night, the Banas are associated with thieves and kings. During the day, they are associated with fire and kings. In the morning and evening, they are associated with death and Saturn.

segments.sanskrit: चया तिकोणं चतुरखमसतं परयति खेटाश्रणाभिवृद्धा। भेदो गुरुूमिखुतः प्रे च रमेण संूणटशो भवति॥
segments.english_translation: The planets in the trine, square, and opposition positions are considered with their respective strengths. The differences are noted by Jupiter and Saturn.

segments.sanskrit: यदा लगरंशेक्ञो लवमथ तलं पश्यति युतो भवेद्वा बोधः श्चभफलमनल्यं रचयति। खवदयूनखामी लवमद्नमं लग्नमदनं प्रपश्येदवा वध्वाः श्यभमितरथा जेयमंशचुभम्‌॥
segments.english_translation: When the lord of the Navamsha sees the Lagna or is conjoined with it, it produces auspicious results. If the lord of the Navamsha sees the seventh house, it is auspicious for the bride.

segments.sanskrit: ठवेश्षो खं लग्नपो लग्रे प्रपद्येन्मिथो वा शुभं खाद्ररसख। लवचूनपोंऽशदयुनं चूनपोऽसतं मिथोऽवेक्षते खच्छुभं कन्यकायाः॥
segments.english_translation: If the lord of the Navamsha and the lord of the Lagna see each other, it is auspicious. If the lord of the Navamsha sees the seventh house, it is auspicious for the bride.

segments.sanskrit: उदयांशः स्वनायेन मित्रसौम्येन वा युतः। प्रेक्षितो वा तथासतांशो दैपलोः युत्रपौत्रदः॥
segments.english_translation: The rising degree, when associated with a friendly or benefic planet, or when aspected by such, bestows progeny and grandchildren.

segments.sanskrit: रवपतियभमित्रं वीक्षितंऽशं तं वा परिणयनकरं स्याच्छुभं शाज्ञच्टम्। मदनर्वपमित्र सौम्यर्मशधुन वा तनुमदनगदं वेद्वीक्षते शमं वध्वाः॥
segments.english_translation: If the Sun's degree is aspected by a friend or benefic, it becomes auspicious for marriage. If Venus or Mercury aspects the Moon's degree, it ensures happiness for the bride.

segments.sanskrit: विषुवायनेषु परपूर्वमध्यमान्दिवसांस्यजेदितरसंक्रमेषु। अचिकास्तु षोडश शुभक्रियाविधौ परतोऽपि पूर्वमपि संखजेहुधः॥
segments.english_translation: During equinoxes and solstices, avoid the days before, during, and after. In other transits, avoid the sixteen ghatis before and after for auspicious activities.

segments.sanskrit: देवकृतयोऽष्टौ नाड्योऽकाः क्रमात्‌। वर्ज्याः संक्रमेऽर्कादिः रायोऽकैस्यातिनिदिताः॥
segments.english_translation: For solar transits, avoid eight ghatis for the Sun, and similarly for other planets. The ghatis for Mars are especially inauspicious.

segments.sanskrit: स्ने तुलाटी बधिरो सृगाश्यौ रात्रौ च सिंहाजघ्षा दिनांधाः। कन्यानयुकर्कटका निशांधा दिने षरटोऽत्यो निरि पंगुसंज्ञः॥
segments.english_translation: In Aries and Libra, the signs are deaf during the day; in Leo and Sagittarius, they are blind at night. Virgo and Cancer are blind at night; Capricorn and Pisces are lame during the day.

segments.sanskrit: बधिरा धन्वितुलारयोऽपराहे मिथुनं कर्कटकोंऽगना निशाधः। दिवसांधा हरिगोक्रियास्तु कुन्जा सगछुंमातिममानि संभ्ययोिं॥
segments.english_translation: In Sagittarius and Libra, the signs are deaf in the afternoon; Gemini and Cancer are blind at night. Aries, Taurus, and Capricorn are blind during the day; Aquarius and Pisces are lame during twilight.

segments.sanskrit: दारितं मधिरतनौ दिवांधरुमने वैधव्यं रिष्चमरणं निशंधलपे। यगवगे निखिरधनानि नाशमीयुः सर्वत्राधिपगुरुदष्टिभिमं दोपः॥
segments.english_translation: Inauspicious signs cause widowhood and death; blind signs cause loss of wealth. The influence of malefic planets is detrimental in all cases.

segments.sanskrit: कार्यीकतीलिककन्यायुग्मरवे शपे वा यदि भवेदुपयामस्त्हिं सती खल कन्या॥
segments.english_translation: If the marriage takes place under the influence of Aries, Taurus, Virgo, or Gemini, the bride will be virtuous and devoted.

segments.sanskrit: अंलखनवांशे न च परिणेया काचन वत्तममिह हिता। नो चरलप्रे चरलवयोगं तोलिखगखे शशभृति ढुर्यात्‌॥
segments.english_translation: A bride should not be married in the last Navamsha of Aries, Taurus, or Virgo. Avoid the combination of Libra and Moon in the last Navamsha.

segments.sanskrit: व्यये शनिः सेऽवनिजस्तरतीये भृगुलने चदरखला न शस्ताः। ठमेट्कविर्लौथ रिपौ पतै म्हैौरतेदद्चभाराश्च मदे च सव॥
segments.english_translation: Saturn in the twelfth, Mars in the tenth, and Venus in the third are inauspicious. Malefic planets in the ascendant and the Moon in the eighth are not favorable.

segments.sanskrit: विवाहयात्राचूडासु गृहकर्मभ्रवेशने ॥
segments.english_translation: In marriage processions, house entry, and other auspicious activities.

segments.sanskrit: उष्यायाष्टषट्सु रविकेतुतमोकुत्रा- रूयायारिगः कितिसुतो दिगुणायगोऽननः। सप्तन्यया्टरहितौ ज्ञगुरू सितोऽष्ट- त्रियूनपट्न्ययगृहान्परिहय शस्तः ॥
segments.english_translation: In the third, sixth, and eighth houses, the Sun, Ketu, and Saturn are inauspicious. Mars in the third, sixth, and eleventh houses is auspicious. Mercury and Jupiter in the second, fifth, and ninth houses are auspicious. Venus in the third, sixth, and eleventh houses is auspicious.

segments.sanskrit: पापौ कैरिकारको रिपुगृहे नीचेऽस्तगो कतेरी- दोषो नैव सितेऽरिनीचगृहे तत्पष्टदोषोऽपि न। भोमेऽस्ते रिपुनीचगे न हि मवेद्धौमोऽष्टमो दोषः- नीचे नीचनवांशके शिनि रिःफाष्टारिदोषोऽपि न॥
segments.english_translation: Malefics in the sixth house, debilitated or combust, do not cause harm. Benefics in the third, sixth, and eleventh houses do not cause harm. Mars in the sixth house, debilitated or combust, does not cause harm. Saturn in the eighth house, debilitated or in a malefic Navamsha, does not cause harm.

segments.sanskrit: अब्दायनर्तुतिथिमासमपक्षदग्ध- तिथ्यंधकाणवधिरांगयुखाच दोषाः। नयति विद्धरुसितेषु केद्रकोणे तद्वच पापविधुयुक्तनवांशदोषः ॥
segments.english_translation: Year, solstice, season, lunar day, month, fortnight, burnt lunar day, and other defects are nullified when the Moon is in conjunction with Jupiter or Venus in the Kendra (angular houses). Similarly, defects caused by malefic planets in Navamsha are nullified.

segments.sanskrit: कदरे कोणे जीव आये खो वा क्म चरे वापि वर्गोत्तमे वा। स्वै दोषा नाशमायांति चंद्रे लामे तदहूहूतौशदोषाः ॥
segments.english_translation: In the Kendra or Trikona, if Jupiter is present, defects are nullified. Similarly, if the Moon is in exaltation or in a favorable Navamsha, defects are nullified.

segments.sanskrit: त्रिकोणे क्रे वा मदनरहिते दोषशतकं इरेत्सौम्यः शुक्रो द्वियुणमपि रक्षं सुरगुरुः। भवेदाये कैदरेऽङ्गप उत वेशो यदि तदा समूहं दोषाणां ददन इव तूरं शमयति ॥
segments.english_translation: In the Trikona or Kendra, if Mercury or Venus is present, they remove hundreds of defects. If Jupiter is present, it removes thousands of defects. If the Moon is in the eleventh house, it nullifies all defects like fire extinguishing fuel.

segments.sanskrit: धौ दौ ज्ञमृग्बोः पचदौ खो साधैतरयो शुरो। रामा भंदागुकेत्वारे साधकैः वि्नोपकाः ॥
segments.english_translation: For the Sun and Moon, the Vimshopaka score is 5; for Mars, Mercury, and Saturn, it is 7; for Jupiter and Venus, it is 8; and for Rahu and Ketu, it is 5.

segments.sanskrit: शशः सितोऽकः शवशुरसलुखलु्जामित्रपः खादयितो मनः शच्ची। एतद्वरं संप्रति भाव्य तांमिकलेषां सुखं सप्देदिवाहतः ॥
segments.english_translation: The Moon, Venus, and Mercury are favorable for the father-in-law, mother-in-law, and friends. This is considered auspicious for the happiness of the bride and groom after marriage.

segments.sanskrit: कृष्णे पक्षे सौरि्जार्गैऽपि च वारे वर्ज्ये नधत्रे यदि वा खात्करपीडा। संकीर्णानां तहिं सतायुर्थनलाभ- रीति परास्यै सा भवतीह सितिरेषा ॥
segments.english_translation: In the dark fortnight, on Saturdays and Tuesdays, if there is a Nakshatra or Yoga that is not prohibited, then for mixed castes, this is considered auspicious for longevity, wealth, and prosperity.

segments.sanskrit: गांभर्वादिविवादेऽकदिदधनेत्ररगुणेरेद्वः। ङश्युगां ९गादेभि३भूशरामारेसिपचामञ्भाः सभाः ॥
segments.english_translation: In Gandharva and other types of marriages, starting from the Sun's transit in the Nakshatra of Aries, the Nakshatras are counted in a specific sequence for auspiciousness.

segments.sanskrit: विधोर्बरमवीक्ष्य वा दलनकंडन वारक गृहांगणविभूषणान्यथ च वेदिकामंडपान्‌। विबाहविहितोडभिविरचयेत्तथोद्वाहतो न पूर्वमिदमाचरेत्रिनवपषप्मिते वासरे ॥
segments.english_translation: After observing the Moon's position, one should prepare the grinding of grains, the pounding of turmeric, and the decoration of the house and courtyard, as well as the altar and pavilion, on the day of marriage, not before the third, ninth, or sixth day.

segments.sanskrit: इ्तोच्छराया वेददसतैः समंताचुल्या वेदी सद्मनो वामभागे। शुग्मे घे षषठहीने च पच सप्ताहे यान्भंडपोदवासनं सत्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: The altar should be constructed on the left side of the house, with a height of one cubit, and equal on all sides. The pavilion should be erected on an even day, not on the sixth day, and on the fifth or seventh day in odd cases.

segments.sanskrit: घर्येऽगनासिंहधटेषु शवे सतंमोऽलिकोरदंडश्रगेषु वायौ। मीनाजुमे निकरतौ विवाहे खाप्योऽस्निकोणे इषयुगमयर्यः ॥
segments.english_translation: In the construction of the pavilion, the pillars should be placed in the northeast when the Sun is in Virgo, in the southeast when in Sagittarius, and in the southwest when in Pisces.

segments.sanskrit: ना्यागरक्षं न तिथिकरणं नेव र्न चिता नोवाचारो न च रवविधिनेी युहूरवख चर्चा। नोवायोमो न तिमवर्न नेव जामित्रदोषो गोधूलिः सा सुनिभिरुदिता सर्वकार्येषु शस्ता ॥
segments.english_translation: The time of cow dust (godhuli) is considered auspicious for all activities, without the need to consider Nakshatra, Tithi, Karana, Yoga, or any other astrological factors.

segments.sanskrit: गोधूलि त्रिविधां वदति सुनयो नारीविवाहादिके हेमन्ते शिशिरे श्रयाति हुतां षिंडीकृते भास्करे। ग्रीष्मेऽर्थास्तमिते वसंतसमये भानौ गतेऽस्तमिते सूरये चास्तसुपागते भगवति प्राबरदशरत्कारयोः॥
segments.english_translation: The wise describe three types of twilight (Godhuli) for activities like marriage: in Hemanta and Shishira seasons, when the sun is setting; in Grishma, when the sun has set; and in Vasanta, when the sun is about to set.

segments.sanskrit: अस्तं याते गुरुदिवसे सौरे सावित्रे केदो लग्नान्ग्रत्यौ रिपुभवने ठगने वेदो। कन्यानाशस्तनुमदश्रयुखे भौमे बोधुकामि धनसहने चंद्रे सौख्यम्॥
segments.english_translation: When the sun sets on a Thursday or Saturday, with the moon in the ascendant or in the enemy's house, or when Mars is in the ascendant, there is loss of wealth. However, if the moon is in the second house, there is happiness.

segments.sanskrit: मेषादिगेऽकैऽशरा ५८ नगाक्षाः ५७ समनेषवः ५७ सृपरश्रा ५७ गजाक्षाः ५८। गोषाः ५९ खतकौः ६० रसाः ६१ तकः ६१ क्ंगानि ६१ षष्टि ६० नैवपेच ५९ शुक्तिः॥
segments.english_translation: In the signs starting from Aries, the degrees are: 58 for Aries, 57 for Taurus, 57 for Gemini, 57 for Cancer, 58 for Leo, 59 for Virgo, 60 for Libra, 61 for Scorpio, 61 for Sagittarius, 61 for Capricorn, 60 for Aquarius, and 59 for Pisces.

segments.sanskrit: संक्रांतियातधस्राचैर्गतिनि्नी सषद् ६० हता। रन्धेनांशादिना योज्यं यात स्पष्टमारकरः॥
segments.english_translation: From the day of the solar ingress, calculate the number of days and divide by 60. Add the remainder to the degrees of the sun to find the exact position of the sun.

segments.sanskrit: तनोरिष्टां शकात्पूवं नवांशा दशसंगुणाः। रामाप्ना लब्धम तनोर्वगादिसाधने॥
segments.english_translation: Before the desired time, calculate the Navamsha and multiply by ten. This result is used in the calculation of the ascendant and other factors.

segments.sanskrit: अकीषत्रात्सायनाद्धोग्ययुक्तेभागेनिघात्सोदयात्ामिभन्सात्‌। भोग्यं शुक्तं चांतरालोदयाट्यं ष्वा भक्तं खेष्टनाञ्यो भवेयुः॥
segments.english_translation: From the Sayan position, calculate the difference and multiply by the local sunrise. Divide by the desired time to find the remaining time.

segments.sanskrit: चेटा सायनावेकरादौ तदव ्ेषमोदय्‌ः साभिभक्तः। खेटः कारो लपनं यदाकोद्रात्रः शेषोऽकत्सपदभानिश्ायाम्‌॥
segments.english_translation: If the Sayan and Nirayana positions are equal, calculate the difference and divide by the local sunrise. The result is the remaining time from sunrise.

segments.sanskrit: उत्पातान्सहपातदग्धतिथिभिंदै्ं श्च योगांसतथा चदरेव्योश्लनसामथास्तमयन तिथ्या, क्षयद्धी तथा। गंडातं च सविष्टिसंकरमदिनं तन्वंशपास्तं तथा तन्व॑दोश्षविधूनथाषटरिपुगाल्पापस्य वर्गोलथा॥
segments.english_translation: Avoid inauspicious omens, burnt Tithis, and unfavorable Yogas. Also avoid the moon's conjunction with malefics, the end of Tithis, and the presence of malefics in the ascendant.

segments.sanskrit: सेदुकरूरखभोदयांशखुदयास्ताद्धिचेडायुधा- न्वाशचूरं दशयोगयोगसदितं जामित्रर्ताव्यधम्‌। बाणोपग्रहपापकर्ैरि तथा तिथ्यक्षवारोस्थितं दु योगमथा्धेयामङ्कलिकायान्वारदोपानपि॥
segments.english_translation: Avoid the presence of malefics in the ascendant, unfavorable Yogas, and the conjunction of malefics with the moon. Also avoid unfavorable Tithis and days.

segments.sanskrit: तदच ग्रहमिन्नयुदूगतभं सवनिमान्संने- ददाह छभकमंसु ग्रदङरतोमरख दोषानपि ॥
segments.english_translation: When the planets are inauspiciously positioned, even the auspicious Nakshatras and Tithis become ineffective.

segments.sanskrit: मेषादिराशिजवधूवरयोषैटो्च तेलादिलापनविधो कथितात्र संख्या । शेकादिददीःैरदिनंगंद्विीणा- वीणाक्चैवाणगिरयो विबुधेस्तु कथित्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: In the context of the bride and groom belonging to the Aries and other signs, the number of oil applications and other rituals are specified. The wise have mentioned the numbers starting from sixty-four.

segments.sanskrit: गणनायकमाराध्य विश्चसंघनिवारकम्‌ । वधूवेशाप्रकरणं व्याख्याति विहुषां सुदे ॥
segments.english_translation: After worshipping Lord Ganesha, the remover of obstacles, the section on the bride's entry is explained for the wise.

segments.sanskrit: समाद्रिष॑चांकदिने विवादाद्वप्रवेशलोऽष्टिदिनां तराले । शुभः परस्ताद्विषमान्दमासदिनेऽश्षवर्षत्परतो यथेष्टम्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: Starting from the day of marriage, the bride's entry into the groom's house is auspicious on even days within sixteen days. After that, it is auspicious on odd months and years.

segments.sanskrit: ध॒वक्षप्रखदुश्रोत्रवसुमूलमघानिङे । वधूप्रवेश्ः सननेष्टो रिक्तारार्कै बुधे परेः ॥
segments.english_translation: The bride's entry is auspicious in the Nakshatras Rohini, Mrigashira, Ashlesha, Magha, and others, but not on Rikta Tithis or on Tuesdays and Sundays.

segments.sanskrit: जयेष्टे पतिज्यषठमथाधिके पतिं ह॑त्यादिमे भर्वगृहे वधूः शुचो । शवश्रू सहस्ये शव्यरं क्षये तयुं तातं मधो तातगरहे विवाहतः ॥
segments.english_translation: If the bride stays in the groom's house during the first month of Jyeshtha, she harms her husband's elder brother. In Ashadha, she harms her husband. In Shravana, she harms her mother-in-law. In Pausha, she harms her father-in-law. In the intercalary month, she harms herself. In Chaitra, she harms her father if she stays in her father's house.

segments.sanskrit: कन्यामन्भमीनभे नववधूयानं इषे तौखिके देवाचा्ैसितेदुसौम्यदिवसे छदे गुरौ भास्करे ॥
segments.english_translation: In Virgo, Pisces, or Taurus, the entry of a new bride is auspicious on a day ruled by Mercury, Jupiter, or the Sun.

segments.sanskrit: दैदेज्यो ह्यमिथरखदश्षिणे यदि खा-इच्छेयु्म हि शिद्यगभिणीनवोढाः । बालशेद्रजति विपद्यते नवोटा चेद्॑या भवति च गर्भिणी त्वग ॥
segments.english_translation: If Mars is in the southern direction, a pregnant woman or a newlywed should not travel, as it may lead to misfortune or miscarriage.

segments.sanskrit: स्यादभिहोत्रविधिरुत्तरगे दिनेशे मिभरघुवांलयशरिशक्तसुरेऽयधिष्ये । रिक्तासु नो शरिकुजेज्यश्रगो न नीचे नास्तंगते न विजिते न च शवुगेहे ॥
segments.english_translation: The Agnihotra ritual should be performed when the Sun is in the northern course, in the Nakshatras of Krittika, Vishakha, or Pushya, avoiding Rikta Tithis, and when Mars, Jupiter, or Saturn are not debilitated, combust, or defeated.

segments.sanskrit: नो कर्मीनक्ल्षपदंभनवांशलमे नोऽने तनो रविशशीज्यकुजे त्रिकोणे । केंद्रक्षपदत्रिभवगे च पैरैखिसाभ-पटूलस्थितेनिधनशद्धियुते विल्भरे ॥
segments.english_translation: Do not perform the ritual when the Moon is in Capricorn, Pisces, or Aquarius, or when the Sun, Moon, Jupiter, or Mars are in the 6th, 8th, or 12th houses, or when the Moon is afflicted by malefics.

segments.sanskrit: चापे जीवे तजुखे वा मेषे भोमेऽम्बरे दने। पद्त्यायेऽन्जे र वा साज्ञाताभिर्यजति शवम्॥
segments.english_translation: In Sagittarius with Jupiter, or in Aries with Mars, or in the sky with Mercury, or in the second house with Venus, or in the third or eleventh house with the Moon, or in the sixth, third, or eleventh house with the Sun, one should perform the sacrifice with certainty.

segments.sanskrit: राजाभिषेकः शुभ उत्तरायणे गुरवदुशक्ररुवितेषेलान्वितेः। मौमाकरमरेशदरेशजन्मयेना चैतररिक्तारनिशमरिम्खचे॥
segments.english_translation: The coronation of a king is auspicious during the Uttarayana when Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury are strong, and Mars, Sun, and Saturn are in their own or exalted signs, except during the month of Chaitra, Rikta Tithis, and night.

segments.sanskrit: शाक्रभ्रवःधिप्रमदुधुवोडभिः शीरपौदये वोपचये श्म तनौ॥ पाचैस्िषष्ठायगतेः श्मग्रहैः कँद्रधिकोणायधनव्रिसंयितैः॥
segments.english_translation: With the Nakshatras Jyeshtha, Shravana, Ashwini, Pushya, Hasta, and Rohini, and when the Moon is in a movable sign or in the ascendant, or when the planets are in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth houses, the coronation is auspicious.

segments.sanskrit: शुरुरश्रकोणे इजोऽरौ सितः खे स राजा सदा मोदते राजलक्ष्म्या। तृतीयायभौ सौरि्र्यो सर््॑वोुरुधेदधरित्री सिरा खाह्पस॥
segments.english_translation: When Jupiter is in the ascendant or ninth house, Mars is in the third house, and Venus is in the tenth house, the king who is crowned will always enjoy royal prosperity. Alternatively, when Saturn is in the third house, the Sun is in the eleventh house, and Jupiter is in the tenth house, the earth will remain stable under the king's rule.

segments.sanskrit: शन्निराभसंस्मौ शानितिग्मरदमी मेषूरणे ब॑घुगृहे गर्व । यस्यात्र योगे क्रियतेऽभिषेकः संपस्स्थिरा तस्य चिरायुषः स्यात्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: In the presence of Saturn and Mars in Aries or Sagittarius, if a coronation is performed during this yoga, the person will have a stable and long life.

segments.sanskrit: यात्रायां प्रविदितजन्मनां सृषाणां दातव्यं दिविसमबुद्धजन्मनां च । रभ्ायैरुदयनिमित्तमूलभूत- विज्ञाते चभञ्यमे बुधः प्रदद्यात्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: For those whose birth time is known, the day for travel should be given based on the planetary positions. For those whose birth time is unknown, the day should be determined by omens and other signs.

segments.sanskrit: जननराशितन्‌ यदि र्नगे तदधिपौ यदि वातत णव वा। त्रिरिषुखायगरहं यदि बोदयो विजय एव भवेद्रसुधापतेः ॥
segments.english_translation: If the birth sign or its lord is in a favorable position, or if the third, sixth, or eleventh house is strong, then the king will achieve victory.

segments.sanskrit: यदि प्रच्छितनो चसुधा रुचिरा भवस्तु यदि शुतिददीनगम्‌। यदि एच्छति चादरतथ शुभग्रह द्युतं चरलम्ममपि ॥
segments.english_translation: If the earth is beautiful, if auspicious objects are visible, or if the astrologer is respected, then the king will achieve victory.

segments.sanskrit: विधुड्जयुतलपरे सौरिच्ेऽथ च्रे गरतिभमदनसंसखे रगे भास्करेऽपि । दिवुकनिधनहोरा्रूनगे वापि पापे सपदि मवति भगः प्रभरकटुश्तदानीम्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: If the Moon is with Mars or Saturn, or if the Sun is in the eighth house, or if malefic planets are in the fourth, eighth, or twelfth house, then there will be obstacles or defeat.

segments.sanskrit: त्रिकोणे ईजात्सोरि्करज्ञजीवा यदैकोऽपि वा नो मोऽ्काच्छशी बा । बलीयांस्तु मध्ये तयोर्यो ग्रहः खात्‌ खकीयां दिद प्रत्युतासौ नयेच ॥
segments.english_translation: If Saturn, Mars, or Jupiter is in the ninth or fifth house, or if the Moon is in these houses, then the journey should not be undertaken in that direction. Instead, the direction indicated by the stronger planet should be chosen.

segments.sanskrit: रश्ने गम्यदिगीशात्खेटः पंचमगो यः । बोभूयाद्वलबुक्तः खामाशां नयतेऽमो ॥
segments.english_translation: If a planet is in the fifth house from the lord of the desired direction and is strong, it will lead to success in that direction.

segments.sanskrit: यात्रायां निषिद्धवाराः सभु्यताऽऽशाकथितानि भक्त्वा फलानि वीर्यान्नयति स्वकाष्ठाम्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: In the context of travel, the forbidden days are mentioned, and after considering the directions, the results are achieved according to one's strength.

segments.sanskrit: अन्यदपि योगातरं तेनैवोक्तम्‌-“परस्परं सौरिङजौ रवद त्रिकोणगो भागेव- रोहितौ वा। फर यदुक्तं तदरोषमेव विनारय पश्चान्नयति स्वकाष्टाम्‌' इति ॥
segments.english_translation: Another yoga is also mentioned by him: 'When the Sun and Mars are in mutual trine, or when they are in opposition, the results are achieved without delay according to one's strength.'

segments.sanskrit: धनुरिति ॥ रवौ धलुमैषसिदस्थिते सति यात्रा प्रशस्ता छुफफरदा । शनिक्लोशानोरारिगे मकरक्ंभकन्यामिथुनवृषतुखागते रवौ यात्रा मध्या मध्य- मफरदा, न छयभदा नाप्यञ्युभफर्देल्यथैः । करकंमीनालिसंस्थे रवावतिदीर्घा बहुकारुसाध्या यात्रा, हीनफलेत्यथः ।
segments.english_translation: In Sagittarius, when the Sun is in Aries or Sagittarius, travel is auspicious and yields good results. When Saturn is in Capricorn, Aquarius, Virgo, Gemini, or Taurus, and the Sun is in these signs, travel is moderate and yields moderate results, neither very good nor very bad. When the Sun is in Cancer, Pisces, or Aries, travel is very long and requires much effort, yielding lesser results.

segments.sanskrit: नषष्टीन च द्वाद्ची नष्टमीनो सिताचया तिथिः पूर्णिमाऽमा न रिक्ता । हयादिलयमिर््रदुजीवां तयहस्त- श्रोवासवैरेव यात्रा प्रशस्ता ॥
segments.english_translation: The sixth, twelfth, and eighth lunar days, the new moon, and the full moon are not auspicious for travel. Travel is auspicious on days ruled by Ashwini, Mrigashira, Punarvasu, Pushya, Hasta, and Shravana Nakshatras.

segments.sanskrit: न पूर्वदिशि शक्रम न विधुसोरिवारे तथा न चाजपदमे गुरौ यमदिशीनदत्येज्ययोः । न पारिदिधि धात्‌भे कुजबुषेऽर्यमभे तथा न सौम्यकठुमि व्रनेत्खजयजीविता्थी बुधः ॥
segments.english_translation: Do not travel eastward on the day of Indra (Jyeshtha Nakshatra) or on Monday. Do not travel southward on Thursday or on the day of Aja (Purva Bhadrapada Nakshatra). Do not travel westward on the day of Rohini or on Tuesday. Do not travel northward on Wednesday or on the day of Uttara Phalguni Nakshatra if you seek victory and longevity.

segments.sanskrit: ूर्वाहि धुमिशरमैन सपतेर्यात्रा न मध्याहयके तीक्ष्णार्यैरपराहके न रघुभेने पूर्वरात्रे तथा 1 भत्ास्यैन च मध्यरात्रिसमये चे्रस्तथा नो चै राते हरिदसतपुष्यश्षशिभिः स्यात्सर्वकाे शभा ॥
segments.english_translation: Travel is not auspicious during the first part of the day when the Nakshatra is Dhruva or Shravana, during midday when the Nakshatra is Tikshna or Ardra, during the afternoon when the Nakshatra is Raghu or Magha, or during the early night when the Nakshatra is Maitra or Anuradha. Travel is not auspicious during midnight when the Nakshatra is Chara or Swati, nor during the third part of the night when the Nakshatra is Haridra or Pushya. However, travel is auspicious when the Nakshatra is Shravana.

segments.sanskrit: इष्टपुष्यश्चैः सर्वकाले षष्टिवरिकात्मकेऽहोरात्ररूपे यस्मिन्कदाचित्काले क्षमा स्यात्।
segments.english_translation: In all times, under the influence of the Nakshatras Pushya and others, when the day and night are of sixty Ghatis, there is forgiveness.

segments.sanskrit: स्थिरसाधारणपुष्यैः पूर्वाह्णे नैव गमनं सत्। गमनं न दारुणक्षदिनदरसमये न कार्यं शुभं स्यात्।
segments.english_translation: Travel should not be undertaken during the first half of the day under the fixed and common Nakshatras like Pushya. It is not auspicious to travel during harsh Nakshatras or on days with unfavorable planetary positions.

segments.sanskrit: पूर्वाह्णे ध्रुवमिश्रैर्नैव गमनं तीक्ष्णैर्मध्यंदिने।
segments.english_translation: Travel should not be undertaken in the morning with fixed and mixed Nakshatras, nor at midday with harsh ones.

segments.sanskrit: पूर्वाह्णेऽह्नि ध्रुवक्षसहितेऽह्नि यात्रा शुभा नो तीक्ष्णपरांशके।
segments.english_translation: In the morning, when the day is accompanied by fixed Nakshatras, travel is auspicious, but not when harsh Nakshatras are predominant.
