segments.sanskrit: धर्मगे भास्करे वित्तमोक्षे शशी वित्तगे धर्ममोक्षसितिः श्यते। कामगे धर्ममोक्षार्थगः शोभनो मोक्षगे केवलं धर्मंगः प्रोच्यते॥
segments.english_translation: When the Sun is in the path of Dharma, and the Moon is in the path of Wealth or Liberation, it is auspicious. If the Moon is in the path of Dharma or Liberation, it is considered beneficial. When the Sun is in the path of Desire, and the Moon is in the path of Dharma, Liberation, or Wealth, it is auspicious. If the Sun is in the path of Liberation, and the Moon is only in the path of Dharma, it is also considered auspicious.

segments.sanskrit: पोषे पक्षत्यादिका द्वादशरेवं तिथ्यो माघादौ द्वितीयादिकास्ताः। कामात्तिखः स्युस्तृतीयादिवच याने प्राच्यादौ फठं तत्र वक्ष्ये॥
segments.english_translation: In the month of Pausha, starting from the first day, twelve Tithis are counted. In the month of Magha, starting from the second day, they are counted. For travel towards the east, starting from the third day, the results will be explained.

segments.sanskrit: सौख्यं शो भीतिर्थागमश् शल्यं नैःखं निःखता मिश्रता च। द्रन्यङ्केशो दुःखमिष्टापिरथो साभः सौर्यं मंगलं वित्तराभः॥
segments.english_translation: Happiness, fear, gain of wealth, pain, loss, and mixed results are indicated. The results of the directions are as follows: happiness, fear, gain, pain, loss, and mixed results.

segments.sanskrit: रामो द्रव्याधिरधनं सौख्यगुक्तं भीतिर्लमो सतयुरथोगम्। लाभः कष्टं द्रव्यलाभः सुखं च कष्ट सौख्यं छ्ेशसाभौ सुखं च॥
segments.english_translation: Rama indicates wealth, happiness, fear, and gain. Profit, difficulty, gain of wealth, happiness, and difficulty are indicated.

segments.sanskrit: सौख्यं लाभः कार्वसिद्धिथ कष्टं शः क्टास्सिद्धिरथो धनं च। सत्यभ द्रव्यनाशश शल्यं शल्यं सौख्यं श््युरत्यतकष्टम्॥
segments.english_translation: Happiness, profit, success in work, difficulty, and loss of wealth are indicated. Truthfulness, loss of wealth, pain, and happiness are indicated.

segments.sanskrit: तिथ्यक्षवारयुतिरद्रिगजाभितषटा स्थानत्रयेऽत्र वियति प्रथमेऽतिदुःखी। मध्ये धनक्षतिरथो चरमे शतिः खात्यानव्रयेऽकयुजि सौ ख्यजयौ निरुक्तौ॥
segments.english_translation: When Tithis, Nakshatras, and weekdays are combined and divided into three parts, in the first part, there is extreme sorrow. In the middle part, there is loss of wealth, and in the last part, there is gain. If there is no combination, happiness and victory are indicated.

segments.sanskrit: सरेभेतोऽजमोन्मितिर्मगावेषिता यगा। महाडलो न शखयते त्रिषण्मिता भमो भवेत्॥
segments.english_translation: If the Nakshatra of the Sun and the Moon are combined and divided by six, and the remainder is zero, it is not auspicious. If the remainder is three or six, it is considered inauspicious.

segments.sanskrit: शशञांकमं खैमतोऽतर गण्यं पश्षादितिथ्या दिनवासरेण। युतं नवारं नगशेषकं चेत्खाद्विवरं तद्वमनेऽतिशस्तम्॥
segments.english_translation: Calculate the Nakshatra of the Moon from the Nakshatra of the Sun, add the Tithi and the weekday. If the remainder when divided by nine is seven, it is considered highly auspicious for travel.

segments.sanskrit: माद्रणयेच्ादरं तिथिवारं च मिध्रितम्‌ । भक॑संख्यैदैरेदधाग नवरोषं तु गौरवम्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: In the calculation of auspicious times, consider the Nakshatra, Tithi, and weekday. The sum of these numbers, when divided by nine, gives the remainder which is considered significant.

segments.sanskrit: भूपंचांक््ंगदिग्बह्विसपेदष्टेशाको थ घाता स्यदः । मेषादीनां राजसेवानिवादे यात्रायुदधाये च नान्यत्र वञ्यैः ॥
segments.english_translation: The Ghata Chandra is calculated for the signs starting from Aries. It is avoided in royal service, disputes, travel, and warfare, but not in other activities.

segments.sanskrit: गोखीक्षये वाततिथि्तु पूणी भद्रा चृयुक्कटकेऽथ नैदा । कौरप्याजयोक्रथटे च रिक्ता जया धनुःकंमहरौ न शस्ताः ॥
segments.english_translation: The Tithis that are avoided in travel and warfare are the full moon in Taurus, Bhadra in Gemini and Cancer, Rikta in Scorpio and Capricorn, and Jaya in Sagittarius and Aquarius.

segments.sanskrit: नक्रे भौमो गोदरिखीषु मंदशवदरो ददिऽकोऽजमे ज्ञ कके । शुक्रः कोदंडारिमीनेषु ईंमजुके जीवो पातवारा न शस्ताः ॥
segments.english_translation: The weekdays that are avoided in travel are Mars in Capricorn, Saturn in Taurus and Virgo, Mercury in Gemini, Jupiter in Aries, Venus in Sagittarius and Pisces, and the Moon in Cancer.

segments.sanskrit: मघाफरखातिैत्रमूरधुलयबुपांयमम्‌ । याम्यत्राह्मेशसापं च मेषादेर्थातभं न सत्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: The Nakshatras that are avoided in travel are Magha for Aries, Hasta for Taurus, Swati for Gemini, Anuradha for Cancer, Mula for Leo, Shravana for Virgo, Revati for Scorpio, Bharani for Sagittarius, Rohini for Capricorn, and Ashlesha for Pisces.

segments.sanskrit: नवभूम्यः शिववह्योऽक्षविशेऽ्ककृताः शक्ररसास्तुरंगतिथ्यः । दिदिश्ोऽमावसवश पर्वतः स्युस्तिथयः संयुखवामगा न शस्ताः
segments.english_translation: The Tithis that are avoided in travel are the ninth Tithi in the east, the eleventh in the southeast, the fifth in the south, the twelfth in the southwest, the fourth in the west, the full moon in the northwest, the second in the north, and the eighth in the northeast.

segments.sanskrit: भानि खाप्यान्यन्धिदिश्च सप्तसप्तानटैतः। वायव्याम्नेयदिक्संखं पारिषं नेव ंघयेत्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: The stars are placed in the four directions starting from Krittika in the east, Magha in the south, Anuradha in the west, and Dhanishta in the north. The line connecting the northwest and northeast directions should not be crossed.

segments.sanskrit: अगनदिशं चप इयातपुरुहूतदिग्भरेवं प्रदक्षिणगता विदिचोऽथ कृत्ये। आवश्यकेऽपि परिषं प्रविरलष्य गच्छेच्छलं विहाय यदि दिक्तलुशुद्धिरसि ॥
segments.english_translation: One should travel in the direction of Agni (southeast) starting from the Krittika Nakshatra. Even if there is a necessity, one should not cross the Parigha line unless the direction is free from obstacles.

segments.sanskrit: मैत्ाकुप्याश्चिनमे्निरुक्ता यात्रा श्भा सर्वदिशासु तज्जः। वक्री ग्रहः कैद्रगतोऽख वरग लग्रे दिनं चाख गमे निषिद्धम्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: Travel is considered auspicious in all directions under the Maitra, Pushya, Ashwini, and Magha Nakshatras. However, it is prohibited when a retrograde planet is in the same direction, or when the day is afflicted by a malefic planet.

segments.sanskrit: वसुभस्योत्तरार्धाच पंचधिष्ण्येषु सर्वदा। याम्यदिग्यायिनां णां न मुहूर्तो जयभ्रदः॥
segments.english_translation: From the northern half of Dhanishta, always in the five Dhishnyas, there is no victorious Muhurta for those traveling southward.

segments.sanskrit: हसतः घष्यः इत्यादिना पुष्यस्य सवेदि्ारगत्वुक्स्वा नक्षत््रकरणे -श्रदेण विद्धोऽप्यञ्यभान्वितोऽपि विरुद्ध तारोऽपि विरूरेमगोऽपि। करोत्यवस्यं सकका्थसिरधि विहाय पाणिग्रहमेव पुष्यः॥
segments.english_translation: Even if Pushya is afflicted by a malefic, associated with another planet, or in a contrary star, it still ensures success in marriage ceremonies.

segments.sanskrit: स्वस्वोदयक्षान्नवमेऽषटमे वा सषक्षगे वा क्षितिजे ध्रतीपे। तद्वकसुष्णाह्यमेव तत्र वद्यं व्याधिभयं जनानाम्‌॥
segments.english_translation: When Mars is in the 9th, 8th, or 6th house from the ascendant, it causes fear of disease and harm to people.

segments.sanskrit: एकागेरुहतं धिष्ण्ये करूराक्रंतं च विद्धभम्‌। उत्पातदूषितं यत्तद्यान्रायां भंगदं सदा॥
segments.english_translation: When a malefic is in the 4th house or afflicted, it causes constant obstacles and destruction in journeys.

segments.sanskrit: सौम्यायने शर्यविभू तदोत्तरां प्राचीं वजेत्तौ यदि दक्षिणायने। भ्रत्यग्यमाशां च तयोदिंबानिशं भिन्नायनत्वेऽथ वधोऽन्यथा वेत्‌॥
segments.english_translation: In the northern solstice, travel towards the north or east; in the southern solstice, travel towards the south or west. If the sun and moon are in different solstices, travel day and night; otherwise, it leads to destruction.

segments.sanskrit: उदेति यस्यां दिशि यत्र याति गोलस्रमाद्राथ कङुन्भंषे। त्रिधोच्यते संख एव श्युक्रो यत्रोदितस्तां तु दिं न यायात्‌॥
segments.english_translation: In the direction where Venus rises, or where it moves in the zodiac, or where it is in conjunction with a malefic, one should not travel in that direction.

segments.sanskrit: चक्रास्तनी चोपगते भगोः सुते राजा व्रजन्याति वशं हि विद्विषां। बुधोऽलक्रो यदि तत्र संचलन्‌ रिपूज्ञयेननैव जयः प्रतीदुजे॥
segments.english_translation: When Venus is retrograde or combust, the king becomes subject to enemies. If Mercury is afflicted, there is no victory in battles.

segments.sanskrit: यावच्चन्द्रः पूष्भार्गृत्तिकायां पादे शुक्रोऽन्धो न दुष्टोऽग्रदक्षे। मध्येमार्गे भार्वास्तेऽपि राजा तावच्चिष्टं संयुतस्तेऽपि तत्र॥
segments.english_translation: As long as the Moon is in the Nakshatras from Pushya to Krittika, Venus is considered blind and not harmful in the front or right side. Even if the king is in the middle of the path, he should stay there until Venus rises.

segments.sanskrit: संसुखे चन्द्रजे यत्र मार्गमध्योदितो यदि। यावदस्तमगते तस्मिन्तावत्तत्रैव संवसेत्॥
segments.english_translation: When the Moon rises in the middle of the path, the king should stay there until it sets.

segments.sanskrit: भुभा शकौ याज्यौ सर्वथा यततो बुधैः। तत्र प्रयातुं न पतेरर्थनाशः पदे पदे॥
segments.english_translation: The wise should always avoid traveling during the conjunction of Bhuba and Shaka, as it leads to loss of wealth at every step.

segments.sanskrit: अथ मीनराशौ उत वा तदशके चरितं वक्रमिह वर्त्म जायते। जनिलम्नजन्मभपती मग्रहौ भवतस्तदा तदुदये शमो गमः॥
segments.english_translation: In the Pisces sign or its division, the path becomes crooked. If the lord of the birth sign and the planet are in the ascendant, then the journey should be avoided.

segments.sanskrit: जन्मराशितयुतोऽष्टमे तथा खारिभाच रिपुं तच्छिते। षष्ठगास्तद्धिपा यदाथवा स्यर्गतं हि चपतेरृतिप्रदम्॥
segments.english_translation: If the birth sign is in the eighth house or the enemy's sign is in the sixth, the journey will lead to defeat and fear from enemies.

segments.sanskrit: वर्गोत्तमांशगे चन्द्रे वापि यात्रा प्रोक्ता वांछितार्थदात्री। अंभोराशौ का तदे भ्रशषसतं नौकायां सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायि॥
segments.english_translation: When the Moon is in the exalted division, the journey is said to fulfill desires. In the ocean, it grants success in a boat journey.

segments.sanskrit: विष्कम्भे लग्नगते प्रशस्ता यात्रार्थदात्री जयकारिणी च। हानिं विना रिपुतो भयं च इर्यात् तथा दिक्प्रतिलोमरे॥
segments.english_translation: When the ascendant is in Vishkambha, the journey is auspicious, granting wealth and victory. In reverse directions, it causes loss and fear from enemies.

segments.sanskrit: राशिः खजन्मसमये शुभसंयुतो यो यः खारिभान्निधनगोऽपि च वेरिरंञः। सम्नोपगः स गमने जयदोऽथ भूषयोगेगैमो विजयदो जनिभिः अ्दिषटः॥
segments.english_translation: The sign at birth, if conjoined with benefics, or the eighth from the enemy's sign, or the second from the Sun, if in the ascendant, grants victory in travel. In auspicious combinations, it is praised by the wise.

segments.sanskrit: मृगे गत्या शिषे सिखाऽदितौ गच्छज्ञयेद्विपून्‌। मैत्रे प्राय शाक्रे हि खित्वा मूते बर्जस्तथा॥
segments.english_translation: In Mrigashira, travel is auspicious; in Shishya, one should go to the east. In Maitra, travel is favorable; in Shakra, avoid travel.

segments.sanskrit: म्रश्याय हत्तेऽनिरुतक्षधिष्ण्ये खित्वा जयाथ प्रवसेष्धिदैवे। वखत्यपुष्ये निजसीन्नि चैकरात्रोपितः क्मां लभतेऽवनीशषः॥
segments.english_translation: In Mrigashira, travel is auspicious; in Hasta, avoid travel. In Anuradha, travel is favorable; in Pushya, if one stays for a night, the king will gain the earth.

segments.sanskrit: उषधकारो विना पूर्वा गोधूरिः पथिमां विना। विनोत्तरां निशीथः सन्‌ याने याम्यां विनाऽभिजित्‌॥
segments.english_translation: Travel without Purva is not auspicious; without Godhuli, avoid the path. Without Uttara, avoid night travel; without Abhijit, avoid southern travel.

segments.sanskrit: कदरे कोणे सौम्यखेटाः श॒भाः स्युर्यानि पापादयायप्ट्खेषु चद्रः। नेष्टो र्ना यारिरभर शनिः खेऽ्ते शुक्रो र्मरेण्नगांयारिरप्र॥
segments.english_translation: In the angles and trines, benefic planets are auspicious for travel; in malefic houses, the Moon is not favorable. Saturn in the tenth is not auspicious; Venus in the seventh is not favorable.

segments.sanskrit: योगास्सिद्ध्यर्थरणिपतीनां शकुनैरपि भूदेवानाम्‌। चोराणामपि शकुनैरुक्ता भवति मुहूर्तादपि मनुजानाम्‌॥
segments.english_translation: Yogas are for the success of kings, even through omens for earthly gods. For thieves too, omens are spoken of, and for humans, even from a Muhurta.

segments.sanskrit: सहजे रविरदशममे शशी तथा शनिमंगरौ रुगे सितः सुते। हिबुके बुधो गुरुरपीह लम्रगः स जयत्यरीन्प्रचकितोऽचिराञ्चुपः॥
segments.english_translation: When the Sun is in the third house, the Moon in the tenth, Saturn and Mars in the sixth, Venus in the fifth, Mercury in the fourth, and Jupiter in the seventh, the king embarks on a journey and quickly conquers his enemies.

segments.sanskrit: भ्रातरि सौरिभूमिखुतो वैरिणि लम देवगुरुः। आयगतेऽ शघचुजयशरदजुङूलो देखगुरुः॥
segments.english_translation: When the Sun is in the third house, Mars in the sixth, Jupiter in the seventh, and the Moon in the eleventh, the king embarks on a journey and achieves victory over his enemies.

segments.sanskrit: तनौ जीव इुर्मती वैरिगोऽकैः। प्रयाता महींदरो जयलेव शबरून्‌॥
segments.english_translation: When Jupiter is in the first house, the Moon in the eighth, and the enemy's planet in the sixth, the king embarks on a journey and conquers his enemies.

segments.sanskrit: जीवाकचद्वा लश्नारिरंधरगा यदि गच्छतः तस्या खरमैत्रीव न स्थिरा रिषुवाहिनी ॥
segments.english_translation: If Jupiter and Mars are in the ascendant, the friendship with enemies is not stable, like the friendship of a donkey.

segments.sanskrit: लस्नगतः खादेवपुरोधाः । रामधन्ेः शेषनमोगेः ॥
segments.english_translation: When the ascendant is occupied by Jupiter, and the Moon is in the 10th house, the king achieves victory.

segments.sanskrit: धने चरे सञ्ुदयगेऽवै जीवे शुके विदि धनसंसे । ईद्ग्योगे चरति नरेश्ो जेता शबरून्गरूड इवादीन्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: When the Moon is in the 2nd house, Jupiter in the ascendant, and Venus in the 11th, the king conquers enemies like Garuda conquers serpents.

segments.sanskrit: वित्तगतः शिपुत्रो भ्रातरि वासरनाथः । सग्नगते भूयुपुतरे स्युः शरभा इव स्वे ॥
segments.english_translation: When Mercury is in the 2nd house, the Sun in the 3rd, and Mars in the 4th, enemies fall like moths into a flame.

segments.sanskrit: उदये रविर्यदि सोरिररिगः शी दञ्षमेऽपि । वसुधापतियैदि याति रिपुवाहिनी वशमेति ॥
segments.english_translation: If the Sun is in the ascendant, Saturn in the 6th, and the Moon in the 10th, the king's army subdues the enemy.

segments.sanskrit: तनौ शनि रविर्दशमभे बुधो भृगुखुतोऽपि साभदशमे । त्रिाभरिपुभेषु भूयुतशनी युरजञश्रयुजास्तथा बलयुतः ॥
segments.english_translation: If Saturn and Mars are in the ascendant, the Sun in the 10th, Mercury in the 11th, and Venus in the 12th, the king achieves victory.

segments.sanskrit: सञुदयगे बिबुधगुरौ मदनगते हिमकिरणे । दिबुकगतो बुधभगुजौ सहजगताः खरुखचराः ॥
segments.english_translation: When Jupiter is in the ascendant, the Moon in the 7th, and Mercury and Venus in the 4th, the king's army subdues the enemy.

segments.sanskrit: त्रिदुरुस्तलुगो मदने हिमफिरणो रविरायगतः । सितशशिजावपि कर्मगतौ रविसुतभूमिषुतौ सहजे ॥
segments.english_translation: If Jupiter is in the 7th, the Moon in the 10th, and Saturn and Mars in the 3rd, the king achieves victory.

segments.sanskrit: देवयुरौ वा शशिनि तयु वासरनाथे रिपुभवनखे । पंचमगेहे दिमकरपुत्रः कर्मणि सौरिः सुहृदि सित ॥
segments.english_translation: If Jupiter or the Moon is in the ascendant, the Sun in the 6th, and Saturn in the 5th, the king achieves victory.

segments.sanskrit: दिमकिरणसुतो बली चेत्तनो त्रिद्शपतिगुरुहिं केद्रसथितः। व्ययगृहसहजारिषर्मसितो यदि च भवति निर्मलधद्रमाः
segments.english_translation: If Mars is in the ascendant, Jupiter in the 4th, and Mercury in the 12th, the king achieves victory.

segments.sanskrit: अश्चभखगेरनवाष्टमदसटिबुकसदोद्रलामयदस्यः । कविरिह कैद्रगमीष्पतिदृ्टो बसुचयलामकरः खड योगः ॥
segments.english_translation: If Venus is in the 4th, Jupiter in the 10th, and Saturn in the 6th, the king achieves victory.

segments.sanskrit: रिपुरशरकरमटिदुके शशिजे परिवीक्िते श्चभनभोगमनेः । व्ययलप्रमन्मथगहेषु जयः परिविजितेष्वद्यमनामधीरः ।
segments.english_translation: If the Moon is in the 6th, Jupiter in the 10th, and Saturn in the 12th, the king achieves victory.

segments.sanskrit: लम यदि जीवः पापा यदि लामे कर्मण्यपि वेद्राज्याधिगमः ख्यात्‌ चयने बुधशुक्रौ चंद्रो चिबुके वा तद्रत्फलयुक्तं सैरयनिवैः
segments.english_translation: If Jupiter is in the 11th, and malefics in the 10th, the king achieves victory.

segments.sanskrit: रिपुतजुनिधने शुकरजीरदषो ह्यथ बुधभरगुजौ तुर्यगेदं सितौ । मदनमवनगशंद्रमा वांबुगः शरिसुतभरगुजांतर्गतद्रमाः
segments.english_translation: If Venus is in the 6th, Jupiter in the 7th, and Mercury in the 4th, the king achieves victory.

segments.sanskrit: शुक्रभार्गवमध्यगते हिमगौ दिदकोपगते च इः भवसेत्‌।
segments.english_translation: When Venus and Mercury are in the middle of the sky, and the Moon is in conjunction with Jupiter, it is auspicious.

segments.sanskrit: सितजीवभौमबुधमादुतनूजास्तलुमन्मथारिदिवुकत्रिगृरे चेत्‌। ऋमतोऽरिसोद्रखन्ात्रवहोरा दिुकायगी्गुरुदिनेऽखिरुखेटैः॥
segments.english_translation: If Venus, Jupiter, Mars, Mercury, and Saturn are in specific houses, it is auspicious for the king's victory.

segments.sanskrit: सहजे ङजो निधनगथ मागवो मदने बुधो रविररौ तनो गुरुः। अथ चेत्स्युरिज्यसितभानवो जलत्रिगताहि सौरिरुधिरो रिपुखितौ॥
segments.english_translation: When Mars is in the third house, Venus in the eighth, Mercury in the seventh, Sun in the sixth, and Jupiter in the first, it is auspicious for victory.

segments.sanskrit: एको ज्ेन्यसितेषु पचमतपःकेद्रेषु योगस्तथा दधौ चेततेष्वधियोग एषु सकला योगाधियोगः स्मरतः। योगे क्षेममथाधियोगगमने कषेमं रिपुणां वधं चाथो क्षेमयश्लोवनीश्च खमते योगाधियोगे जन्‌॥
segments.english_translation: In the presence of specific planetary positions, there are different types of Yogas that bring prosperity and victory over enemies.

segments.sanskrit: इषमासि सिता दशमी विजया शुभकमैसु सिद्धिकरी कथिता। श्रवणर्धयुता सुतरां छभदा चृपतेस्तु गमे जयसंधिकरी॥
segments.english_translation: The tenth day of the bright fortnight in the month of Ashwin, when associated with the Shravan Nakshatra, is highly auspicious for victory.

segments.sanskrit: चेतोनिमित्तशङधनरतिसुभ्रशस्तज्ञारया विर्रदुव्यैधिपः प्रयाति। सिद्धिमैवेदथ पुनः शङ्नादितोऽपि चेतोविशछद्धिरथिका न च तां विनेयात्‌॥
segments.english_translation: The king should proceed with the journey when omens and mental signs are favorable, as they ensure success.

segments.sanskrit: अतनधनदेवतपरतिष्ठाकरषीडोतसवद्चतकासमापतौ। न कदापि चरेदकालविद्युदधनवर्षातुहिनेऽपि सप्तरात्रम्‌॥
segments.english_translation: One should not undertake a journey during inauspicious times such as eclipses, lightning, or heavy rain, even for seven nights.

segments.sanskrit: श्रयाणसमये यस्य विदयुन्नीहारदृष्टयः। भकालजा भवंत्येते तदा भंगकरा चृणाम्‌॥
segments.english_translation: At the time of departure, if there are lightning and misty visions, these are considered inauspicious and cause obstacles.

segments.sanskrit: महीपतेरेकदिने पुरात्पुरे यदा भवेतां गमनप्रवेशको। भवारशचूलग्रतिञ्क्रयोगिनीविचारयेन्नैव कदापि पंडितः॥
segments.english_translation: When a king plans to travel from one city to another in a single day, a wise person should not consider the Nakshatra, Tithi, Yoga, or Karana.

segments.sanskrit: यचेकस्मिन्द्विसे महीपते निर्गमप्रवेशौ स्तः। तर्हिं विचार्यः सुधिया प्रवेचकालो न यात्रिकस्तत्र॥
segments.english_translation: If on a single day, the king has both departure and entry, then the wise should consider the time of entry, not the traveler.

segments.sanskrit: प्रवेशानिर्गमं तसात्प्रवेशं नवमे तिथौ। नक्षत्रेऽपि तथा वारे नैव यायात्कदाचन॥
segments.english_translation: One should not enter or exit on the ninth Tithi, nor should one travel on such a Nakshatra or weekday.

segments.sanskrit: अग्निं हुत्वा देवतां पूजयित्वा नत्वा विप्रानभिवन्द्य विगीशम्‌। दत्वा दानं ब्राह्मणेभ्यो विगीदौ ध्यात्वा चित्ते भूमिपालोऽभिगच्छेत्‌॥
segments.english_translation: After offering oblations to the fire, worshipping the deities, bowing to the Brahmins, and giving gifts, the king should proceed with a focused mind.

segments.sanskrit: आज्यं तिलौदनं माषं पयश्चापि यथाक्रमम्‌। भक्षयेद्दोहदं दिश्यां आशां पूर्वादिकां जेत्‌॥
segments.english_translation: Consume ghee, sesame rice, lentils, and milk in the respective directions to fulfill the desires of the directions and achieve success in the intended direction.

segments.sanskrit: रसालां पायसं कांजीं शृतं दुग्धं तथा दधि। पयोऽभ्रतं तिलान्नं च भक्षयेद्वारदोहदम्॥
segments.english_translation: On Sundays, consume Rasala (a sweet dish), on Mondays and Thursdays, consume Payasa (sweet rice pudding) and Kanji (fermented rice water), on Tuesdays, consume boiled milk, on Wednesdays, consume curd, on Thursdays, consume milk, on Fridays, consume sesame rice, and on Saturdays, consume mixed rice with sesame.

segments.sanskrit: पक्षादितोऽकदतंदुलवारि सर्पिः श्राणा हविष्यमपि हेमजं त्वपूपम्। भुक्त्वा बजेदुचकं च भेदुमूत्र यावान्नपायसगुडानसुगन्नयुद्रान्॥
segments.english_translation: From the first day of the lunar fortnight, consume Akshata (unbroken rice), on the second day, consume rice water, on the third day, consume ghee, on the fourth day, consume Yavagu (barley gruel), on the fifth day, consume Havishya (sacrificial food), on the sixth day, consume gold, on the seventh day, consume Apupa (sweet cake), on the eighth day, consume Uchaka (cucumber), on the ninth day, consume cow urine, on the tenth day, consume horse urine, on the eleventh day, consume barley, on the twelfth day, consume Payasa, on the thirteenth day, consume jaggery, on the fourteenth day, consume blood, and on the fifteenth day, consume mixed rice.

segments.sanskrit: उद्धृख प्रथमत एव दक्षिणां ढात्रंशत्पदमभिगलय दिश्ययान। आरोदेत्तिरघ्रतहेमताम्रपा््र दच्वादौ गणकवराय च प्रगच्छेत्॥
segments.english_translation: At the beginning of the journey, the king should first step with his right foot, then walk a hundred steps, and then mount the vehicle. He should donate gold and copper vessels to the astrologer and others before proceeding.

segments.sanskrit: आच्यां गच्छेद्रनेनेव दक्षिणां खनि। दिशि ्रतीच्यामश्ेन तथोदीच्यां नरैपः॥
segments.english_translation: In the eastern direction, travel by chariot; in the southern direction, travel by horse; in the western direction, travel by elephant; and in the northern direction, travel by foot.

segments.sanskrit: देवगहाद्या गुरुसदनाद्वा खगृहान्युख्यकलत्रगृहाद्या। प्राय हवि्य विप्राचुमतः पश्यन्कण्वन्मंगलमेयात्॥
segments.english_translation: Depart from a temple, a teacher's house, or one's own house. After offering Havishya (sacrificial food) and receiving blessings from a Brahmin, proceed while observing auspicious omens.

segments.sanskrit: भ्र्ानमत्र धुषा हि शतानि प॑च केचिच्छतद्वयञु्ोति दरीन चान्ये। संप्रसितो य इह मंदिरितः प्रयातो गंतव्यदिष्वु तदपि यतेन कार्यम्॥
segments.english_translation: Some say the journey should be five hundred bows (Dhanushas), others say two hundred bows, and some say as far as an arrow can be shot. The journey should be undertaken in the direction intended.

segments.sanskrit: गहा्ेदातरमपि गमस्तटिं यात्रेति गगः सीन्नः सीमांतरमपि भरगुर्वाणविक्षेपमात्रम्। श्र्ानं खादिति कथयतेऽथो भरद्वाज एवं यात्रा कार्या बहिरिह पुरार्खाद्वसिष्ठो बवीति॥
segments.english_translation: Even if the journey is within the house, it is considered a journey. Some say it should be up to the village boundary, others say as far as an arrow can be shot. Bharadvaja says it should be outside the city, and Vasistha says it should be outside the town.

segments.sanskrit: भ्रधाने भूमिपालो दशदिवसमभिव्याप्य नैकत्र तिष्ठ त्सामतः सप्षरात्रं तदितरमजः पंचरात्रं तथैव। उध्वं गच्छेच्छुमादेऽप्यथ गमनदिनात्सप्त रात्राणि पूर्वं चाशक्तौ तदिनेऽसो रिपुविजयमना मे नेव कुर्यात्॥
segments.english_translation: In a journey, a king should not stay in one place for more than ten days, a regional ruler for more than seven nights, and others for more than five nights. If unable to proceed, he should return on the seventh day from the day of departure.

segments.sanskrit: न्यथो सक्ष च मांडलीकः । यः राजतः सोऽपि न पचरात्ने भद्रेण यात्रा परतः भयः ॥
segments.english_translation: If the king is not in a favorable position, then the journey should not be undertaken due to fear of obstacles.

segments.sanskrit: दुग्धं यान्यं पमेव विरात्रं त्याज्यं चरतं च प्म । षो तेटं बासरेऽसिन्वमिश्रं त्याज्यं यलाद्धूमिपालेन नूलम्‌।।
segments.english_translation: Milk, curd, and ghee should be avoided on the day of travel. The king should also avoid consuming mixed food.

segments.sanskrit: वपनं वमनं क्षौद्रं तेरं चैव विवभयेत्‌ । तद्‌इश्चावरोषाणि सप्ताहं मैथुनं यजेत्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: Shaving, vomiting, honey, and oil should be avoided. These should be abstained from for a week, including sexual intercourse.

segments.sanskrit: भुक्त्वा गच्छति यदि चेत्तेटगुडक्षारपक्रमांसानि । विनिवर्तते स रूणः सिद्धिजमवमान्य गच्छतो मरणम्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: If one consumes sour, salty, or meat dishes and then travels, they will face obstacles and may even face death if they disrespect the learned.

segments.sanskrit: यदि मस्य चतरु पौपमासादिषु वष्टि भवेद्कालबृष्टिः । पञ्चुमल्येपदांकिता न यावहसुधा खान हि तावदेव दोषः ॥
segments.english_translation: If rain occurs in the months of Pausha and others, it is considered untimely rain. The land should not be marked by the footprints of cattle or humans until then.

segments.sanskrit: अव्पायां शष्टौ दोषोऽल्यो भूयस्यां दोषो भूयान्‌ जीमूतानां निरपोषे इष्टौ वा जातायां मृषः ।
segments.english_translation: In the case of untimely rain, the defect is minor, but in excessive rain, the defect is greater. If clouds are not fully formed, the rain is considered false.

segments.sanskrit: यदाऽपबान पदयेद्विपरीतसुपस्थितम्। सतं कंचन दत्वा निविंशौकसखतो बजेत्॥
segments.english_translation: When the planets are inauspiciously placed, one should give something to a Brahmin and then proceed with the journey.

segments.sanskrit: विप्राचमफलान्रदुग्धदधिगोसिदार्थपञ्चाम्बरं वेश्यावामयूरचायनङृला वद्वैकपशामिपम्। सदाक्यं इसुमेशवुपूर्णकलरच्छत्राणि सृत्कन्यकारलोणीषसितोश्चमचसरुतसीदीस्यैश्वानराः॥
segments.english_translation: Brahmins, fruits, milk, curd, cows, mustard seeds, cloth, courtesans, peacocks, mongoose, tied animals, auspicious words, full pots, umbrellas, girls, white horses, and dogs are auspicious omens for travel.

segments.sanskrit: आदक्लौजनधौतवस्रजका मीनाज्यरसिंहासनं शावं रोदनव्जितं ध्वजमधुच्छागास्रगोरोचनम्। मारद्राजक्यानवेदनिनदा मांगरयगीतांङशा दष्टाः सत्फरदाः प्रयाणसमये रिक्तो घटः खाचुगः॥
segments.english_translation: Clean clothes, fish, ghee, lion seats, crying children, flags, honey, goats, yellow pigment, Brahmins chanting Vedas, and empty pots are auspicious omens for travel.

segments.sanskrit: वष्याचर्मतुषासिसपेरवणांगारेधनङ्कीबविद्। तेलोन्मत्तवसौषधारिजटिरप्रतरार् दणव्याधिताः।
segments.english_translation: Leather, husk, snakes, fire, oil, mad people, fat, herbs, ascetics, and sick people are inauspicious omens.

segments.sanskrit: काषायी गुडतक्रपकविधवाङन्जाः ङटवे करिवखादेः स्खलनं लुसायसमरं कृष्णानि धान्यानि च।
segments.english_translation: Red clothes, jaggery, buttermilk, widows, and black grains are inauspicious omens.

segments.sanskrit: नद्युचारमयम्रवेशसमरे नष्टार्थसंबीशषणे व्यस्ताः शकना तृपेश्षणविधो यात्रोदिताः शोभनाः॥
segments.english_translation: In river crossings, battles, and when seeking lost items, the omens are reversed and should be interpreted accordingly.

segments.sanskrit: वामांगे कोकिला पट्टी पोतकी करी रला। पिंगला छुच्छुकाः श्रेष्ठा; शिवाः पुरुषसंकतिताः॥
segments.english_translation: On the left side, cuckoos, parrots, and other birds are auspicious omens.

segments.sanskrit: ठिकरः पिकको भासः श्रीक॑ठो वानरो रुरः। सीसंज्ञकाः काकक्रक्षशवानः स्युदधिणाः शमाः॥
segments.english_translation: On the right side, owls, crows, and dogs are auspicious omens.

segments.sanskrit: यात्रायां गजभूपादेः दक्षिणभागगताः भाः शुभफलदाः।
segments.english_translation: During a journey, planets positioned on the southern side of the king or elephant are auspicious.

segments.sanskrit: प्रदक्षिणेति। रूरभ्यतिरिक्ताः गाः पक्षिणश्च यात्रायां प्रादक्षिण्येन गताश्चकिताः श्रेष्ठाः शुभफलदाः स्युः।
segments.english_translation: In a journey, except for deer, animals and birds moving in a clockwise direction are considered auspicious and bring good results.

segments.sanskrit: आयेऽपर्वदिने सत्वा प्राणानेकादशं जेत्‌। द्वितीये षोडश प्राणांस्तृतीये न कदाचिद्रजेत्‌॥
segments.english_translation: On encountering an inauspicious omen on the first day, one should perform a ritual with eleven breaths. On the second day, with sixteen breaths, and on the third day, one should not proceed at all.

segments.sanskrit: यात्रानिवृत्तो शुभदं प्रवेशनं मृदुधुवैः शिप्रचैरः पुनरेव। दारुणभे तथोग्रभे सरीगेहपुत्रात्मविनाशं क्रमात्‌॥
segments.english_translation: Returning from a journey, entering during gentle or swift Nakshatras is auspicious. In harsh or fierce Nakshatras, it leads to the destruction of wealth, house, children, and self, respectively.

segments.sanskrit: उत्पातान्सहपातदग्धतिथिमृत्यंश्च योगस्तथा चन्द्रे ज्योष्णसामथासलमयनं तिथ्याः क्षयर्धी तथा। गण्डान्तं च सविष्टि संक्रमदिनं तन्वंरापास्तं तथा तन्वंदोराविधूनधाष्टरिपुगान्‌ पापस्य वर्गासथा॥
segments.english_translation: The presence of omens, conjunctions with malefic planets, burnt Tithis, death-inflicting Yogas, the Moon's waning phase, and the end of a Tithi are considered inauspicious. Additionally, the end of a Nakshatra, the presence of Vishti Karana, the day of Sankranti, and the presence of malefic planets in the Navamsa are to be avoided.

segments.sanskrit: सङ्करूरखगोदयांरखुदयास्ताञ्चद्धिचंडायुधान्‌ खाजैरं दशायोगयोगसहितं जामित्ररत्ताग्यधम्र्‌। बाणोपग्रहपापकतेरि तथा तिषथ्यृक्षवारोत्थितं दुष्टं योगमथाधयामङुछिका्यान्वारदोषानपि॥
segments.english_translation: The rising of Rahu and Ketu, the presence of malefic planets, the combination of unfavorable Dashas and Yogas, and the presence of malefic planets in the Navamsa are considered inauspicious. Additionally, the presence of malefic planets in the Nakshatra, Tithi, and weekday are to be avoided.

segments.sanskrit: ऋूराकरंतविमुक्तमं अह्णमं यत्ूरग॑तम्यभं त्रेधोत्पातहतं च केतुहतभं संष्योदितं भं तथा। तद्वच्च अहभिश्रयुद्धगतभं सर्वानिमान्संलजेदुद्वादे छभकर्म॑सु ग्रहकर्तौलशरस्य दोषानपि॥
segments.english_translation: Days free from the influence of malefic planets, free from the presence of Rahu and Ketu, and free from the presence of omens are considered auspicious. Additionally, days free from the influence of malefic planets in the Navamsa and free from the presence of malefic planets in the Nakshatra are to be chosen for auspicious activities.

segments.sanskrit: अयेदरवंशोत्तरार्धेन ध्वजान्वदन्नायै्वणैपरत्वेन च द्वारनिवेशनं उपजाल्यादाया ध्वजो धूमहरिश्वगोखरेभध्वांश्षकाः पिंड इहाष्टशेषिते ॥
segments.english_translation: In the latter half of the Ayodhya dynasty, the placement of flags and other symbols is determined by the remainder when divided by eight, with symbols like smoke, lion, dog, cow, donkey, elephant, crow, and dog.

segments.sanskrit: ध्वजादिकाः सर्वदिशि ध्वजे युखं कार्य हरो पूर्वयमोत्तरे तथा । प्राच्यां इषे प्राग्यमयोगजेऽथवा पचादुदक्पूर्वयमे द्विजादितः ॥
segments.english_translation: Flags and other symbols should be placed in all directions, with the lion in the east, and similarly in the south and north. In the east, it is auspicious to have the flag, and in the west, the placement should be according to the Brahmin's direction.

segments.sanskrit: गृेशतत्खीसुखवित्तनाजोऽकेन्द्िज्यश्क्रे विवरेऽस्तनीचे । कतुः सितिर्ना विधुवास्तुनोरभ पुरःस्थिते पृष्ठगते खनिः खात्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: The destruction of the house, happiness, and wealth occurs when the lord of the house is weak, combust, or in a debilitated position. If the Moon is in front or behind, it leads to excavation and loss.

segments.sanskrit: मृ नागृतष्ट व्यय ईरितोऽसो धुवादिनामाक्षरयुक्‌ सपिंडः । तष्टो गुणेरिदरङृतांतभुपा यंशा भवेयुने श्मोऽन्तकोऽतर ॥
segments.english_translation: The expenditure is indicated by the remainder when the number of the house is divided by eight. The result, when multiplied by the qualities, gives the auspicious or inauspicious outcome, with the remainder indicating the lord of death.

segments.sanskrit: दिश पूर्वादितः शालाधुवा भूद छता गजाः । शालाधरुवांकस॑योगः सेको वेहम धुवादिकम्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: Starting from the east, the numbers for the doors are one, two, four, and eight. The sum of these numbers, when added to the base number, gives the auspicious or inauspicious result.

segments.sanskrit: तिथ्यकराटादिगोरकृ, नामृ्वरं तरैयम्‌ । भूजैन्धीषवंमदिम्वंिविश्ेषु ढो नगेऽन्धयः ॥
segments.english_translation: The names of the houses are determined by the number of letters, with three letters for numbers like fifteen, twelve, eight, sixteen, nine, eleven, and fourteen. For other numbers, the name is determined by two or four letters.

segments.sanskrit: न जयनेदौ खरकांतमनोरमं खुखखदुचखोग्र च । अहिते धनदं नाकं चाक्रदं विपुविजयाख्यं स्यात्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: The names of the sixteen houses are: Dhruva, Dhanya, Jaya, Nanda, Khara, Kaustubha, Manorama, Sukhakha, Dukhakha, Ugra, Ahita, Dhanada, Naka, Chakra, Vipu, and Vijaya.

segments.sanskrit: शुभसङ्गं यथा स्वाङ्गं धनधान्यसुखप्रदम्। धान्यं धनप्रदं गेहं जयं स्याद्विजयप्रदम्॥
segments.english_translation: A house with auspicious alignment brings wealth, grains, and happiness. A house that is prosperous in grains and wealth leads to victory and success.

segments.sanskrit: पिण्डे नवाङ्गैर्गणितं क्षेत्रफलं नवभिः। विभाजितं नागादिभिरष्टभिः शिष्टं भवेत्॥
segments.english_translation: The area of the plot is calculated using nine parts and divided by eight, leaving a remainder that is significant.

segments.sanskrit: आयो वारः खको द्रव्यं तिथिः योगः क्षयः। आयुः स्वामिगृहक्षेत्रे गृहभेयं स्फुटं भवेत्॥
segments.english_translation: The lifespan, weekday, wealth, tithi, yoga, and decay are calculated for the house and its owner, providing clear results.

segments.sanskrit: गेहाद्यारम्भेऽकं भाद्रपदं वृषे स्थिते। शल्यं वेदैः स्थिरं रामः श्रीः दक्षिणकक्षौ॥
segments.english_translation: At the start of house construction, when the Sun is in Bhadrapada and Taurus, the house is stable and prosperous, with wealth in the southern quadrant.

segments.sanskrit: लाभो रमः पुच्छगेः खाभिनादो वेदनं वामङ्कषौ सखयैः। रामैः पीडा संततं बाकेधिष्ण्यादश्च रर दि्भिरु्त छसत्सत्॥
segments.english_translation: Prosperity comes from the tail, with pain in the left quadrant, and constant suffering in the northern direction.

segments.sanskrit: मेऽ फाल्गुने परागपरयुखगृं श्रावणे सिंहकक्यौः। पोषे नके च याम्योत्तरगुखसदनं गोऽजगेऽक च राधे॥
segments.english_translation: In the month of Phalguna, a house facing east or west is auspicious. In Shravana, a house facing east or west is favorable. In Pausha, a house facing north or south is beneficial.

segments.sanskrit: ग्रहवेदो कारविरोषमाह ज्योतिर्वै सिष्ठः--भथातः संप्रवक्ष्यामि सूतिकागारवेयानम्‌। मासे तु नवमे प्राति पूर्वपक्षे भे दिने॥ प्रसूतिसंभवे काठे सद्य एव प्रवेदायेत्‌॥
segments.english_translation: The sage Jyotirvaishishta speaks of the construction of a maternity house. In the ninth month, during the bright fortnight, on a suitable day, the construction should commence immediately upon the birth.

segments.sanskrit: कैथिन्मेषरयौ मधो वरपमगे ज्येष्टे यचो कर्कटे। माद्रे सिंहगते धटेऽश्वयुनि चोर्जऽलौ मृगे पौषके। माषे नक्रघटे शुभ निगदितं गेहे, तथोजौ न सन्‌ कन्यायां च तपा धयुप्यपि न सन्‌ कृष्णादिमासाद्धवेत्‌॥
segments.english_translation: In Aries, the house construction is auspicious in the month of Chaitra; in Taurus, during Jyeshtha; in Cancer, during Ashadha; in Leo, during Bhadrapada; in Virgo, during Ashwin; in Scorpio, during Kartika; in Capricorn, during Pausha. However, it is not auspicious in Virgo during Tapasya, nor in Sagittarius during Magha. This is based on the Krishnaadi month system.

segments.sanskrit: पूरणेदुतः प्राग्बदनं नवम्यादिपृत्तराखं त्वथ पश्चिमाखमर्‌। दकौदितः शदे नवम्यादौ दक्षिणाखयं न शुभं वदंति॥
segments.english_translation: From the full moon to the eighth day, a house facing east is not auspicious. From the ninth to the fourteenth day, a house facing north is not auspicious. From the new moon to the eighth day, a house facing west is not auspicious. From the ninth to the fourteenth day, a house facing south is not auspicious.

segments.sanskrit: मोमार्वरिक्तामाूने चरोनेऽ्ध विष॑चके। व्य्टंयसैः च्भेगेहयारंभद्धयायारिगेः खरः॥
segments.english_translation: During the days of Monday, Amavasya, Rikta Tithis, and in the Panchaka, house construction should be avoided. It is auspicious to start construction in movable signs (Aries, Cancer, Libra, Capricorn) and with benefic planets in the ascendant.

segments.sanskrit: देवारये गेहविधो जलाशये रादोधखं रदिश विलोमतः। मीना्कसिहाकखगाकतसिमे खाते युखारषठविदिकश्चभा भवेत्‌।
segments.english_translation: For temple construction, house construction, and water reservoirs, the direction of Rahu's head should be considered. In Pisces, Aries, Taurus, the head is in the northeast; in Gemini, Cancer, Leo, it is in the northwest; in Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, it is in the southwest; in Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius, it is in the southeast.

segments.sanskrit: कूपे वासोर्मष्यदेशोऽथनाशस्त्ैशान्यादौ पुष्टिधरथवृद्धिः। छनोनाशः खीविनाशः खृतिश् संपत्‌ थीडा शघ्ुतः साच सौर्यम्‌॥
segments.english_translation: In the house, if a well is constructed in the center, it leads to loss of wealth. In the northeast, it brings prosperity and growth. In the southeast, it causes loss of progeny. In the south, it leads to loss of cattle. In the southwest, it brings destruction. In the west, it brings prosperity. In the northwest, it causes enmity. In the north, it brings happiness.

segments.sanskrit: सरानख पाकशयनासखयुजेथ धान्य- भांडारैवतगृहाणि च पूर्वतः स्युः। तन्मध्यतस्तु मथनाज्यपुरीषविचा- अभ्यासारूयरोदनरतोषधसर्भधाम ॥
segments.english_translation: In the east, there should be a place for water, cooking, sleeping, and storing grains. In the center, there should be places for churning, ghee, excrement, study, and medicinal herbs.

segments.sanskrit: जीवाकेविच्छुक्रशनेश्वरेषु ठग्रारिजामित्रसुखत्रिगेषु। सितिः शतं स्याच्छरदां सिताकोरेज्ये तदुत्यगसुते शते दे॥
segments.english_translation: If Jupiter is in the ascendant, Sun in the sixth, Moon in the fourth, Venus in the seventh, and Saturn in the third, the house will last for a hundred years. If Venus is in the ascendant, Mars in the third, and Jupiter in the fifth, it will last for two hundred years.

segments.sanskrit: रशरंबरायेषु भगुज्ञभादुभिः कद्र गुरो वर्पशतायुराख्यः बंधो गुरु्योन्नि शी कुजाकंजो लाभे तदाश्ीतिसमायुरार्यः॥
segments.english_translation: If Moon is in the ascendant, Jupiter in the fourth, and Venus in the seventh, the house will last for a hundred years. If Jupiter is in the fourth, Moon in the tenth, and Mars and Saturn in the eleventh, it will last for eighty years.

segments.sanskrit: खो शुक्रे रपरगे वा गुरौ वेर्मगतेऽथवा। शनो खोचे लाभगे वा लक्ष्म्या युक्तं चिरं गृहम्‌॥
segments.english_translation: If Venus is exalted, or Jupiter is in the fourth, or Saturn is exalted in the eleventh, the house will be prosperous and long-lasting.

segments.sanskrit: द्यूनांबरे यदैकोऽपि परांशाखो ग्रहो गृहम्‌। अन्दांतः परस्तं इुयंचेद्वर्णपोऽरः॥
segments.english_translation: If any planet is exalted in the tenth or eleventh house, the house will be prosperous and bring wealth.

segments.sanskrit: पुष्यधुवदुदरिसर्जकैः सजीव , सदवासरेण च कृतं सुतराव्यदं खात्‌। दीशधितक्षिसुपारिशिषेः सथकर- वोरे सितस्य च गहं धनधान्यदं खात्‌॥
segments.english_translation: If the house is constructed under the Pushya, Dhruva, or other auspicious Nakshatras with Jupiter, it will bring sons and prosperity. If constructed under Ashwini, Bharani, or other auspicious Nakshatras with Venus, it will bring wealth and grains.

segments.sanskrit: सारः करज्यांसमवांवुमूरैः कोजेऽदि वेदमाभनिसुतातिदं स्यात्‌। सज्ञे; कदाखार्य मतशषदस्लस्येव वारे सखपुत्रदं खात्‌॥
segments.english_translation: If the house is constructed under the auspicious Nakshatras with Mars, it will bring harm and distress. If constructed under Rohini, Ashwini, or other auspicious Nakshatras with Mercury, it will bring happiness and progeny.

segments.sanskrit: अनेकपादरिरभ्यश्चकरमित्रानिरां तैः। अजे समेदेमदवारे स्याद्रक्षोभूतयुतं गृहम्‌॥
segments.english_translation: If the house is constructed under the auspicious Nakshatras with Saturn, it will be haunted by spirits and bring distress.

segments.sanskrit: हानिः पुत्रविनाशनम्। तृतीया रोगदा ज्ञेया चतुर्थी भंगकारिणी॥
segments.english_translation: The third Tithi is known to cause disease, and the fourth Tithi causes destruction.

segments.sanskrit: षष्ठी दशमी धननासिनी। निरोधकृदमा पूर्णा न स्याच्छाखावरोपणम्॥
segments.english_translation: The sixth and tenth Tithis lead to loss of wealth. The full moon is not suitable for planting branches.

segments.sanskrit: सौम्यायने ज्येष्ठतपोऽन्त्यमाधवे यात्रानिवृत्तौ दपतेर्मवे गृहे।
segments.english_translation: In the Northern Solstice, during the months of Jyestha, Tapas, and Madhava, after the return from a journey, one should enter the house.

segments.sanskrit: वेशोऽम्बुपेञ्यानिलवासवेषु नावश्यमस्तादिविचारणाञ्॥
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras of Shatabhisha, Pushya, Swati, and Dhanishta, there is no need to consider the positions of the Sun and other planets.

segments.sanskrit: त्रिकोणकेद्रायधनवरिगेः श्भैरंमे विषष्ठायगतैथ पापकैः ॥
segments.english_translation: In the presence of malefic planets in the trines, angles, or wealth houses, the auspiciousness is diminished.

segments.sanskrit: शदधाबुरप्रे बिजलुर्ममृखौ व्य्काररिक्ताचरददचैत्रे । वामं रविं पूर्णयटं पुरश्च कृत्वा पिरेद्ेर्म भक्ूटश्चद्धम्‌ ।
segments.english_translation: Avoid the presence of malefic planets in the 6th, 8th, or 12th houses, and ensure the Moon is full and in a favorable position. Place the Sun to the left and perform the entry with auspicious rituals.

segments.sanskrit: वामो रविभरत्युसुता्थलामतो्ः पचे प्राग्बदनादिर्मदिरे । पूणौतिथौ प्राग्बदने गृहे मो नंदादिके याम्यजलोत्तरानने
segments.english_translation: When the Sun is positioned to the left, and the Moon is full, entry into the house should be done facing east. On auspicious Tithis like Nanda, the entry should be from the south, west, or north.

segments.sanskrit: वक्ते भरविभातपवेशसमये इंमेऽभिदाहः कृताः पराच्याञुद्वसने छता यमगता लाभः कृताः पिमे । विदाः करिरुततरे युगमिता गर्भे विनाशो युदे रामाः सैयैमतः सिथिरत्वमनलाः कंठे भवेत्सर्दा ॥
segments.english_translation: During the house entry, if the Sun is in the east, it brings prosperity. If in the south, it brings wealth. If in the west, it brings destruction. If in the north, it brings stability. If in the center, it brings loss. If in the neck, it brings stability.

segments.sanskrit: अकन्नितोयादितिद खविष्णुकरस्चे प्रविष्टं नव्मदिरं यत्‌ । अब्दन्नयात्तस्परहस्तयातं शेषेषु धिष्ण्येषु च खत्युदं स्यात्‌ ॥
segments.english_translation: If the house is entered without the proper rituals, it will lead to inauspicious results. The house should be entered with the right hand first, and the remaining rituals should be performed in the proper order.

segments.sanskrit: एलं सुरमे खगं प्रविदय वितानुष्पशचुतियोषयुक्तम्‌ । रिव्पक्ञदेवज्ञविधिज्ञयोरात्राजाऽ्चयेदधमिदिरण्यवसेः ॥
segments.english_translation: The house should be entered with auspicious rituals, accompanied by the chanting of mantras and the presence of learned Brahmins and astrologers. The king should enter the house with offerings of gold and other auspicious items.

segments.sanskrit: आसीदधमपुरे पटंगनिगमाध्येतद्विजैमंडिते ज्योतिवित्तिरुकः फणीदररचिते माष्ये कृतातिश्रमः ।
segments.english_translation: In the city of Dharma, adorned with learned Brahmins well-versed in the Vedas, there was a renowned astrologer who had studied the great works of Phanindra with great diligence.

segments.sanskrit: न्योतिविद्गणवंदितांधिकमरुसत्घजुरासीव्छृती नान्नाऽनेत इति प्रथामधिगतो भूमंडलादस्करः ।
segments.english_translation: He was revered by groups of astrologers and was known as the illuminator of the earth, like the sun, due to his profound knowledge and teachings.

segments.sanskrit: तदात्मज उदारधीर्विबुधनीसकण्ठाजुजो गणेशपदपंकजं हदि निधाय रामाभिधः ।
segments.english_translation: His son, named Rama, was a wise and generous scholar, who kept the lotus feet of Lord Ganesha in his heart.

segments.sanskrit: तीर्थानि क्षेत्राणि विष्णुभक्तिश्च नारद्। अंतःकरणसंशुद्धिं जनयंति न संशयः॥
segments.english_translation: Holy places, sacred fields, and devotion to Vishnu, O Narada, undoubtedly purify the inner self.

segments.sanskrit: वाराणस्यां तु जंतुः साक्षात्सारूप्यमश्नुते॥
segments.english_translation: In Varanasi, a being directly attains similarity in form.

segments.sanskrit: अकामो वा सकामो वा तिर्यग्योनिगतोऽपि वा। अविमुक्ते यजन्प्राणान्मम लोके महीयते॥
segments.english_translation: Whether one is desireless or desirous, even if born in a lower species, if one leaves the body in Avimukta (Varanasi), they are honored in my world.

segments.sanskrit: सालोक्यं साश्चात्थामोति सत्तमः। ततः सरूपतां याति ततः सान्निध्यमश्नुते॥
segments.english_translation: The noble one attains proximity, then similarity in form, and finally closeness.

segments.sanskrit: ततो ब्रह्मैकतां याति न परावर्तते पुनः॥
segments.english_translation: Then one attains oneness with Brahman and does not return again.

segments.sanskrit: काश्यां सर्वाध्वादोऽयं ते विद्रकीटा युगे युगे॥
segments.english_translation: In Kashi, this path is for you, the wise ones, through the ages.

segments.sanskrit: मा जानीद्यथावादस्वं कार्यां मुक्तिविनिर्णये॥
segments.english_translation: Do not doubt the decision of liberation in Kashi.

segments.sanskrit: अकचटतपयशवर्गाः
segments.english_translation: The groups of Aksharas (letters) starting with 'Aka', 'Cha', 'Ta', 'Pa', and 'Ya'.

segments.sanskrit: अजैकपाददिषुश्य
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras starting with Ajaykapada.

segments.sanskrit: अर्कादिवारे संक्रान्तौ
segments.english_translation: On the days starting with Sunday, during the Sankranti.

segments.sanskrit: अश्िन्य॑डुपयोहंयो निग
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatras Ashwini and others, the auspiciousness is determined.

segments.sanskrit: आदौ संपूज्य रल्ादि
segments.english_translation: First, worship the deities starting with Ganapati.

segments.sanskrit: आयगसैसुतकन्ययोद्रं
segments.english_translation: In the conjunction of Ayana and Kanya (Virgo), the auspiciousness is considered.

segments.sanskrit: उत्पातान्सहपात
segments.english_translation: The omens and their conjunctions are considered.

segments.sanskrit: उपम्रहक्ौ ऊरुवाद्धिकेषु
segments.english_translation: In the Upagrahas and in the positions of the thighs.

segments.sanskrit: ऋक्षाणि करूरविद्धानि
segments.english_translation: The Nakshatras that are afflicted by malefic influences.

segments.sanskrit: एकागेरोपभ्रदपातकूत्ता
segments.english_translation: The single Nakshatra is considered for auspiciousness.

segments.sanskrit: कदालमे व्वाष्टवायू
segments.english_translation: The time when the wind is favorable.

segments.sanskrit: कन्यक्षाह्रभ यावत्कन्या
segments.english_translation: In the time of Virgo, until the end of Virgo.

segments.sanskrit: कवीज्यचंदरक्षपा रिपौ
segments.english_translation: The poet, the Moon, and the protector are considered inauspicious.

segments.sanskrit: गणेज्ञाविष्णुवा्रमाः
segments.english_translation: The days dedicated to Ganesha and Vishnu are auspicious.

segments.sanskrit: गांधवदिबिवाहे
segments.english_translation: In the Gandharva marriage, the auspiciousness is considered.

segments.sanskrit: गुररैश्नकोणे कुजो
segments.english_translation: When Jupiter is in the corner, Mars is considered.

segments.sanskrit: गृहेशतत््ीसुख
segments.english_translation: The happiness of the house is considered.

segments.sanskrit: गोऽजांलङकेभेतर
segments.english_translation: The auspiciousness of the cow and the elephant is considered.

segments.sanskrit: चरे सूर्यादिसंयुक्ते
segments.english_translation: In the moving signs, when combined with the Sun and others.

segments.sanskrit: चिनत्राद्रीो शिवाश्वर्काः
segments.english_translation: The auspiciousness of the Nakshatras starting with Chitra and others.

segments.sanskrit: मेषेऽर्के सद्रतोद्वाहो गङ्गायां
segments.english_translation: In Aries, when the Sun is present, marriage ceremonies are auspicious on the banks of the Ganges.

segments.sanskrit: मैत्रेण पुष्येण शशिनि
segments.english_translation: When the Moon is in the Nakshatra of Pushya, it is auspicious for friendly endeavors.

segments.sanskrit: मैन्यां राशिस्वामिनोरंशे
segments.english_translation: In the month of Maithuna, when the lord of the sign is in its own Navamsa, it is auspicious.

segments.sanskrit: यदि षष्ठितनौ वसुमति
segments.english_translation: If the sixth Tithi falls on a Tuesday, it is considered inauspicious.

segments.sanskrit: यदि भवति सितातिरक्त
segments.english_translation: If the Moon is excessively red, it indicates unfavorable outcomes.

segments.sanskrit: यदि मास्सु चतुषु
segments.english_translation: If in the four months, certain conditions are met, specific results are expected.

segments.sanskrit: यं द्रयंकसुतेश
segments.english_translation: The day ruled by the deity of wealth is auspicious for financial activities.

segments.sanskrit: अचेकसिन्दविसे
segments.english_translation: When the Moon is in the Nakshatra of Aslesha, it is suitable for secretive actions.

segments.sanskrit: यात्रानिचत्तो छमदं
segments.english_translation: Journeys undertaken during the Chaturthi Tithi are considered successful.

segments.sanskrit: यान्नायां भरनिदितजन्मनां
segments.english_translation: In the Nakshatra of Bharani, births are considered auspicious.
